SELECT t.team_name, AVG(g.scoring_margin) AS average_scoring_margin
FROM games g
JOIN teams t ON g.home_team_id = t.team_id
JOIN team_metrics tm ON g.home_team_id = tm.team_id AND g.season = tm.season
WHERE g.season = 2021
AND tm.average_possession_time > 30
GROUP BY g.home_team_id
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN g.pick_right = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= COUNT(g.game_id) / 2;

WITH HighConfidenceGames AS (
    SELECT gp.game_id, gp.confidence_level
    FROM game_predictions gp
    WHERE gp.confidence_level > 0.9
),
GamesWithSignificantSpread AS (
    SELECT g.game_id, g.home_team_id, g.away_team_id, g.location, g.betting_spread
    FROM games g
    WHERE ABS(g.betting_spread) > 5
),
LocationMatch AS (
    SELECT game_id, distance
    FROM games
    WHERE location_embedding MATCH '[0.1, 0.5, 0.3, ...]' -- Example vector
    ORDER BY distance
    LIMIT 3
),
GameTeams AS (
    SELECT gws.game_id, t1.team_name AS home_team, t2.team_name AS away_team
    FROM GamesWithSignificantSpread gws
    JOIN teams t1 ON gws.home_team_id = t1.team_id
    JOIN teams t2 ON gws.away_team_id = t2.team_id
)
SELECT gt.game_id, gt.home_team, gt.away_team, hc.confidence_level
FROM GameTeams gt
JOIN HighConfidenceGames hc ON gt.game_id = hc.game_id
JOIN LocationMatch lm ON gt.game_id = lm.game_id
ORDER BY hc.confidence_level DESC;

SELECT 
  g.game_id,
  ht.team_name AS home_team_name,
  at.team_name AS away_team_name,
  AVG(tm.wdvoa) AS avg_wdvoa
FROM games g
INNER JOIN teams ht ON g.home_team_id = ht.team_id
INNER JOIN teams at ON g.away_team_id = at.team_id
INNER JOIN team_metrics tm ON (ht.team_id = tm.team_id OR at.team_id = tm.team_id) AND tm.season = g.season
WHERE g.game_id IN (
  SELECT game_id
  FROM games
  WHERE pick_right = -1  -- Incorrect prediction
)
GROUP BY g.game_id, ht.team_name, at.team_name
HAVING AVG(tm.wdvoa) > 0.5; -- Example condition on aggregated wdvoa

WITH TeamPerformance AS (
    SELECT 
        t.team_id,
        t.team_name,
        SUM(g.pick_right) AS total_right_picks,
        COUNT(g.game_id) AS total_games
    FROM teams t
    INNER JOIN games g ON t.team_id IN (g.home_team_id, g.away_team_id)
    GROUP BY t.team_id, t.team_name
),
TeamMetrics AS (
    SELECT
        tp.team_id,
        tp.team_name,
        tm.season,
        AVG(tm.wdvoa) AS avg_wdvoa,
        AVG(tm.srd) AS avg_srd
    FROM TeamPerformance tp
    INNER JOIN team_metrics tm ON tp.team_id = tm.team_id
    GROUP BY tp.team_id, tp.team_name, tm.season
),
PredictionAccuracy AS (
    SELECT 
        gp.game_id,
        gp.prediction_id,
        gp.confidence_level,
        g.pick_right
    FROM game_predictions gp
    INNER JOIN games g ON gp.game_id = g.game_id
    WHERE g.pick_right = 1
),
TopPerformingTeams AS (
    SELECT 
        tm.team_id,
        tm.team_name,
        AVG(tm.avg_wdvoa) AS overall_avg_wdvoa,
        AVG(tm.avg_srd) AS overall_avg_srd
    FROM TeamMetrics tm
    GROUP BY tm.team_id, tm.team_name
    HAVING AVG(tm.avg_wdvoa) > 0
),
TopPredictions AS (
    SELECT 
        pa.prediction_id,
        pa.confidence_level
    FROM PredictionAccuracy pa
    WHERE pa.confidence_level > 0.8
    ORDER BY pa.confidence_level DESC
    LIMIT 5
)
SELECT tp.overall_avg_wdvoa
FROM TopPerformingTeams tp
INNER JOIN TopPredictions tpr ON tp.team_id = tpr.prediction_id
ORDER BY tp.overall_avg_wdvoa DESC;

SELECT 
    g.game_id,
    t.team_name AS home_team_name,
    tm.wdvoa
FROM 
    games g
INNER JOIN 
    teams t ON g.home_team_id = t.team_id
INNER JOIN 
    team_metrics tm ON t.team_id = tm.team_id AND g.season = tm.season
WHERE 
    g.pick_right = 1
    AND g.season = 2019
ORDER BY 
    g.game_id;

WITH TeamPerformance AS (
    SELECT
        t.team_id,
        t.team_name,
        tm.wdvoa,
        AVG(CASE WHEN g.pick_right = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS prediction_accuracy
    FROM teams t
    INNER JOIN team_metrics tm ON t.team_id = tm.team_id
    INNER JOIN games g ON t.team_id IN (g.home_team_id, g.away_team_id)
    WHERE tm.season = 2019
    GROUP BY t.team_id, t.team_name, tm.wdvoa
),
RankedTeams AS (
    SELECT
        tp.team_id,
        tp.team_name,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY tp.wdvoa DESC, tp.prediction_accuracy DESC) AS team_rank
    FROM TeamPerformance tp
)
SELECT team_rank
FROM RankedTeams
ORDER BY team_rank;

SELECT AVG(tm.average_possession_time) AS average_possession_time
FROM games g
INNER JOIN team_metrics tm ON g.home_team_id = tm.team_id AND g.season = tm.season
WHERE g.pick_right = 1;

WITH GameResults AS (
  SELECT
    g.home_team_id,
    t.team_name AS home_team_name,
    COUNT(*) AS total_home_games,
    SUM(CASE WHEN g.pick_right = 1 AND g.scoring_margin > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS home_wins
  FROM games g
  JOIN teams t ON g.home_team_id = t.team_id
  WHERE g.pick_right = 1
  GROUP BY g.home_team_id
),
WinRateRanking AS (
  SELECT
    home_team_id,
    home_team_name,
    home_wins,
    total_home_games,
    (home_wins * 1.0 / total_home_games) AS win_rate,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (home_wins * 1.0 / total_home_games) DESC) AS rank
  FROM GameResults
)
SELECT home_team_name, win_rate
FROM WinRateRanking
WHERE rank <= 5;

SELECT 
  g.scoring_margin, 
  t.team_name
FROM 
  games g
INNER JOIN 
  teams t ON g.home_team_id = t.team_id
INNER JOIN 
  team_metrics tm ON t.team_id = tm.team_id AND g.season = tm.season
WHERE 
  tm.wdvoa > 20
  AND g.pick_right = 1
  AND g.season = 2019
ORDER BY 
  g.scoring_margin DESC;

SELECT t.team_name, AVG(g.scoring_margin) AS average_scoring_margin
FROM games g
INNER JOIN teams t ON g.home_team_id = t.team_id
WHERE g.pick_right = 1
GROUP BY t.team_name
ORDER BY average_scoring_margin DESC;

WITH TeamPerformance AS (
    SELECT
        g.season,
        t.team_id,
        t.team_name,
        AVG(g.scoring_margin) AS avg_scoring_margin
    FROM games g
    INNER JOIN teams t ON g.home_team_id = t.team_id OR g.away_team_id = t.team_id
    GROUP BY g.season, t.team_id
),
BettingAccuracy AS (
    SELECT
        g.season,
        t.team_id,
        t.team_name,
        AVG(g.betting_spread) AS avg_betting_spread,
        AVG(CASE WHEN g.pick_right = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS accuracy_rate
    FROM games g
    INNER JOIN teams t ON g.home_team_id = t.team_id OR g.away_team_id = t.team_id
    GROUP BY g.season, t.team_id
),
GamePredictionAnalysis AS (
    SELECT
        gp.game_id,
        gp.wdvoa_delta,
        gp.spread_to_ego_diff,
        gp.margin_to_ego_diff,
        gp.confidence_level,
        gp.prediction_timestamp
    FROM game_predictions gp
),
LocationAnalysis AS (
    SELECT g.game_id, g.location, distance
    FROM games g
    WHERE location_embedding MATCH '[0.1, 0.2, 0.3, ..., 0.384]' -- Random vector of same dimension
    ORDER BY distance
    LIMIT 5
)
SELECT tp.team_name
FROM TeamPerformance tp
INNER JOIN BettingAccuracy ba ON tp.team_id = ba.team_id AND tp.season = ba.season
INNER JOIN GamePredictionAnalysis gpa ON tp.team_id = gpa.game_id
INNER JOIN LocationAnalysis la ON gpa.game_id = la.game_id
WHERE tp.avg_scoring_margin > 0
ORDER BY ba.accuracy_rate DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH TeamPerformance AS (
    SELECT
        t.team_name,
        tm.wdvoa,
        tm.ego,
        tm.turnover_rate,
        gp.confidence_level,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY tm.season ORDER BY (tm.wdvoa + tm.ego - tm.turnover_rate + gp.confidence_level) DESC) AS performance_rank
    FROM
        teams t
    INNER JOIN
        team_metrics tm ON t.team_id = tm.team_id
    INNER JOIN
        game_predictions gp ON tm.season = gp.game_id
    WHERE
        gp.confidence_level > 0.7
)
SELECT
    team_name
FROM
    TeamPerformance
WHERE
    performance_rank = 1;

SELECT 
  t.team_name, 
  AVG(g.scoring_margin) AS average_scoring_margin
FROM 
  teams t
JOIN 
  games g ON t.team_id = g.home_team_id OR t.team_id = g.away_team_id
WHERE 
  g.season = 2022 -- Example season
GROUP BY 
  t.team_name
HAVING 
  AVG(g.scoring_margin) > 5; -- Example threshold for average scoring margin

WITH TeamScoringMargin AS (
    SELECT
        t.team_id,
        t.team_name,
        g.season,
        AVG(g.scoring_margin) AS avg_scoring_margin
    FROM games AS g
    INNER JOIN teams AS t ON (g.home_team_id = t.team_id OR g.away_team_id = t.team_id)
    GROUP BY t.team_id, g.season
),
RankedTeams AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY season ORDER BY avg_scoring_margin DESC) AS team_rank
    FROM TeamScoringMargin
)
SELECT
    r.team_name,
    r.avg_scoring_margin,
    p.confidence_level
FROM RankedTeams AS r
INNER JOIN game_predictions AS p ON r.team_id = 
    (SELECT CASE 
             WHEN g.home_team_id = r.team_id THEN g.home_team_id 
             ELSE g.away_team_id END
     FROM games AS g
     WHERE g.game_id = p.game_id)
WHERE r.team_rank <= 3 AND r.season = 2023;

WITH GameDetails AS (
    SELECT 
        g.game_id, 
        g.scoring_margin, 
        g.home_team_id, 
        g.away_team_id, 
        g.pick, 
        gp.confidence_level
    FROM games g
    INNER JOIN game_predictions gp ON g.game_id = gp.game_id
    ORDER BY g.scoring_margin DESC
    LIMIT 5
),
HomeTeamInfo AS (
    SELECT 
        t.team_id, 
        t.team_name AS home_team_name, 
        t.conference AS home_conference
    FROM teams t
),
AwayTeamInfo AS (
    SELECT 
        t.team_id, 
        t.team_name AS away_team_name, 
        t.conference AS away_conference
    FROM teams t
)
SELECT 
    gd.game_id, 
    ht.home_team_name, 
    at.away_team_name,
    gd.scoring_margin, 
    gd.pick, 
    gd.confidence_level,
    ht.home_conference, 
    at.away_conference
FROM GameDetails gd
INNER JOIN HomeTeamInfo ht ON gd.home_team_id = ht.team_id
INNER JOIN AwayTeamInfo at ON gd.away_team_id = at.team_id
ORDER BY gd.scoring_margin DESC;

WITH RecentGames AS (
    SELECT 
        g.game_id,
        g.season,
        g.week,
        g.home_team_id,
        g.away_team_id,
        t1.team_name AS home_team_name,
        t2.team_name AS away_team_name,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY g.home_team_id ORDER BY g.season DESC, g.week DESC) AS home_rank,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY g.away_team_id ORDER BY g.season DESC, g.week DESC) AS away_rank
    FROM 
        games g
    INNER JOIN 
        teams t1 ON g.home_team_id = t1.team_id
    INNER JOIN 
        teams t2 ON g.away_team_id = t2.team_id
)
SELECT 
    rp.game_id,
    (tm1.wdvoa - tm2.wdvoa) AS wdvoa_difference
FROM 
    RecentGames rg
INNER JOIN 
    team_metrics tm1 ON rg.home_team_id = tm1.team_id AND rg.season = tm1.season
INNER JOIN 
    team_metrics tm2 ON rg.away_team_id = tm2.team_id AND rg.season = tm2.season
INNER JOIN 
    game_predictions rp ON rp.game_id = rg.game_id
WHERE 
    rg.home_rank = 1 AND rg.away_rank = 1
ORDER BY 
    wdvoa_difference DESC
LIMIT 5;

WITH RecentGames AS (
    SELECT game_id, season, week, day, time, home_team_id, away_team_id, scoring_margin
    FROM games
    WHERE season = 2023 AND week <= 6
),
TeamPerformance AS (
    SELECT tm.team_id, tm.team_name, COUNT(rg.game_id) AS games_played,
           AVG(rg.scoring_margin) AS avg_scoring_margin
    FROM teams tm
    LEFT JOIN RecentGames rg ON tm.team_id = rg.home_team_id OR tm.team_id = rg.away_team_id
    GROUP BY tm.team_id
),
HighConfidencePredictions AS (
    SELECT gp.game_id, gp.confidence_level, gp.make_pick
    FROM game_predictions gp
    WHERE gp.confidence_level > 0.8 AND gp.make_pick = 1
),
RefereeInfluence AS (
    SELECT g.referee, COUNT(g.game_id) AS games_officiated, AVG(g.scoring_margin) AS avg_margin
    FROM games g
    GROUP BY g.referee
),
AccessActivity AS (
    SELECT al.user_id, COUNT(al.access_id) AS access_count
    FROM access_logs al
    WHERE al.access_type = 'view'
    GROUP BY al.user_id
)
SELECT tp.team_name, tp.avg_scoring_margin
FROM TeamPerformance tp
JOIN HighConfidencePredictions hcp ON tp.team_id = hcp.game_id
JOIN AccessActivity aa ON hcp.game_id = aa.user_id
JOIN RefereeInfluence ri ON hcp.game_id = ri.games_officiated
WHERE ri.avg_margin > 10
ORDER BY tp.avg_scoring_margin DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH CorrectPicks AS (
    SELECT 
        g.game_id,
        g.season,
        g.week,
        g.home_team_id,
        g.away_team_id,
        g.betting_spread,
        g.scoring_margin,
        g.pick_right
    FROM 
        games g
    WHERE 
        g.pick_right = 1  -- Correct picks
), 
FavoredHomeGames AS (
    SELECT
        cp.game_id,
        cp.scoring_margin
    FROM
        CorrectPicks cp
    JOIN
        games g ON cp.game_id = g.game_id
    WHERE
        g.betting_spread < 0  -- Favorable betting spread for home team
)
SELECT 
    AVG(f.scoring_margin) AS average_correct_margin
FROM 
    FavoredHomeGames f;

WITH TeamSeasonMetrics AS (
    SELECT
        t.team_id,
        t.team_name,
        m.season,
        AVG(m.wdvoa) AS avg_wdvoa,
        AVG(m.ego) AS avg_ego,
        AVG(m.srd) AS avg_srd
    FROM teams t
    JOIN team_metrics m ON t.team_id = m.team_id
    GROUP BY t.team_id, m.season
),
GamePredictionsWithMetrics AS (
    SELECT
        gp.game_id,
        gp.wdvoa_delta,
        gp.spread_to_ego_diff,
        gp.margin_to_ego_diff,
        tm.team_name,
        tm.avg_ego
    FROM game_predictions gp
    JOIN games g ON gp.game_id = g.game_id
    JOIN TeamSeasonMetrics tm ON g.home_team_id = tm.team_id AND g.season = tm.season
    WHERE gp.confidence_level > 0.7
),
TopPredictions AS (
    SELECT
        game_id,
        team_name,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY game_id ORDER BY avg_ego DESC) AS rank
    FROM GamePredictionsWithMetrics
)
SELECT
    tp.game_id,
    tp.team_name
FROM TopPredictions tp
WHERE tp.rank = 1;

WITH RecentSeason AS (
    SELECT MAX(season) AS latest_season
    FROM games
),
RankedGames AS (
    SELECT 
        g.game_id,
        g.season,
        g.week,
        t_home.team_name AS home_team,
        t_away.team_name AS away_team,
        p.confidence_level,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY g.season ORDER BY p.confidence_level DESC) AS confidence_rank
    FROM games g
    JOIN teams t_home ON g.home_team_id = t_home.team_id
    JOIN teams t_away ON g.away_team_id = t_away.team_id
    JOIN game_predictions p ON g.game_id = p.game_id
    WHERE g.season = (SELECT latest_season FROM RecentSeason)
)
SELECT 
    game_id,
    season,
    week,
    home_team,
    away_team
FROM RankedGames
WHERE confidence_rank <= 5
ORDER BY confidence_level DESC;

WITH RecentGames AS (
    SELECT g.game_id, g.season, g.week, t.team_name AS home_team, t2.team_name AS away_team 
    FROM games g
    INNER JOIN teams t ON g.home_team_id = t.team_id
    INNER JOIN teams t2 ON g.away_team_id = t2.team_id
    WHERE g.season = 2023 AND g.week <= 5
),
FilteredGames AS (
    SELECT rg.game_id, rg.home_team, rg.away_team, p.confidence_level
    FROM RecentGames rg
    INNER JOIN game_predictions p ON rg.game_id = p.game_id
    WHERE p.confidence_level > 0.8
),
KNNResults AS (
    SELECT bd.game_id, 
           bd.betting_odds,
           bd.betting_spread,
           distance
    FROM betting_data bd
    WHERE bd.target_spreads_embedding MATCH '[0.1, 0.2, 0.3, ..., 0.384]' 
    ORDER BY distance
    LIMIT 5
)
SELECT f.home_team
FROM FilteredGames f
INNER JOIN KNNResults kr ON f.game_id = kr.game_id
ORDER BY kr.distance ASC;

WITH GamePredictions AS (
    SELECT 
        gp.game_id,
        gp.wdvoa_delta,
        gp.spread_to_ego_diff,
        gp.confidence_level,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY gp.confidence_level DESC) AS rank
    FROM game_predictions gp
    WHERE gp.confidence_level > 0.5
),
TeamPerformance AS (
    SELECT 
        tm.team_id,
        tm.season,
        tm.wdvoa,
        tm.ego,
        tm.srd,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY tm.team_id ORDER BY tm.season DESC) AS recent_season_rank
    FROM team_metrics tm
),
RecentGames AS (
    SELECT 
        g.game_id,
        g.home_team_id,
        g.away_team_id,
        g.scoring_margin,
        t1.team_name AS home_team_name,
        t2.team_name AS away_team_name
    FROM games g
    JOIN teams t1 ON g.home_team_id = t1.team_id
    JOIN teams t2 ON g.away_team_id = t2.team_id
    WHERE g.season = 2023 AND g.week > 8
),
AccessedGames AS (
    SELECT 
        al.user_id,
        al.game_id,
        al.access_date,
        u.user_name
    FROM access_logs al
    JOIN users u ON al.user_id = u.user_id
    WHERE al.access_type = 'view'
)
SELECT 
    rg.game_id,
    rg.home_team_name,
    rg.away_team_name
FROM RecentGames rg
JOIN GamePredictions gp ON rg.game_id = gp.game_id
JOIN AccessedGames ag ON rg.game_id = ag.game_id
WHERE gp.rank <= 10
  AND ag.access_date > '2023-10-01'
ORDER BY gp.rank, rg.scoring_margin DESC;

WITH TeamPerformance AS (

        t.team_id,
        t.team_name,
        tm.season,
        AVG(tm.wdvoa) AS avg_wdvoa,
        AVG(tm.ego) AS avg_ego,
        AVG(tm.srd) AS avg_srd
    FROM teams t
    JOIN team_metrics tm ON t.team_id = tm.team_id
    WHERE tm.season >= 2020
    GROUP BY t.team_id, tm.season
),
GameAnalysis AS (
    SELECT
        g.game_id,
        g.season,
        g.home_team_id,
        g.away_team_id,
        g.scoring_margin,
        gp.wdvoa_delta,
        gp.spread_to_ego_diff,
        gp.margin_to_ego_diff,
        gp.confidence_level
    FROM games g
    JOIN game_predictions gp ON g.game_id = gp.game_id
    WHERE gp.confidence_level > 0.8
),
PerformanceImpact AS (
    SELECT
        ga.game_id,
        ga.season,
        ga.home_team_id,
        ga.away_team_id,
        tp_home.avg_wdvoa AS home_avg_wdvoa,
        tp_away.avg_wdvoa AS away_avg_wdvoa,
        ga.scoring_margin - (tp_home.avg_wdvoa - tp_away.avg_wdvoa) AS wdvoa_effect
    FROM GameAnalysis ga
    JOIN TeamPerformance tp_home ON ga.home_team_id = tp_home.team_id AND ga.season = tp_home.season
    JOIN TeamPerformance tp_away ON ga.away_team_id = tp_away.team_id AND ga.season = tp_away.season
)
SELECT 
    ROUND(AVG(wdvoa_effect), 2) AS average_wdvoa_effect
FROM PerformanceImpact
WHERE season = (SELECT MAX(season) FROM games)

    INNER JOIN
        games g ON gp.game_id = g.game_id

)

WITH GameDifferences AS (

        g.game_id,
        t_home.team_name AS home_team_name,
        t_away.team_name AS away_team_name,
        g.scoring_margin,
        tm_home.ego,
        ABS(g.scoring_margin - tm_home.ego) AS margin_ego_diff
    FROM 
        games g
    INNER JOIN teams t_home ON g.home_team_id = t_home.team_id
    INNER JOIN teams t_away ON g.away_team_id = t_away.team_id
    INNER JOIN team_metrics tm_home ON g.home_team_id = tm_home.team_id AND g.season = tm_home.season

        g.pick_right = -1
),
TopGameDifferences AS (
    SELECT 
        gd.home_team_name,
        gd.away_team_name,
        gd.margin_ego_diff,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY gd.margin_ego_diff DESC) AS rank
    FROM 
        GameDifferences gd
)
SELECT 
    tgd.home_team_name,
    tgd.away_team_name,
    tgd.margin_ego_diff
FROM 
    TopGameDifferences tgd
WHERE 
    tgd.rank <= 5

        g.season,
        g.week,
        g.home_team_id,
        g.away_team_id,
        g.pick,
        t1.team_name AS home_team_name,

),
PredictionDetailsCTE AS (

)

TopGamesInfoCTE AS (

WITH TeamPerformance AS (
    SELECT 
        tm.team_id, 
        tm.season, 
        tm.wdvoa, 
        tm.ego, 
        tm.srd, 
        tm.average_possession_time, 
        tm.turnover_rate,
        t.team_name, 
        t.conference
    FROM team_metrics tm
    INNER JOIN teams t ON tm.team_id = t.team_id
),
GameAndBettingData AS (
    SELECT 
        g.game_id, 
        g.season, 
        g.week, 
        g.home_team_id, 
        g.away_team_id, 
        g.betting_spread,
        g.scoring_margin,
        bd.betting_odds
    FROM games g
    INNER JOIN betting_data bd ON g.game_id = bd.game_id
),
PredictionAnalysis AS (
    SELECT 
        gp.game_id, 
        gp.wdvoa_delta, 
        gp.spread_to_ego_diff, 
        gp.margin_to_ego_diff, 
        gp.confidence_level
    FROM game_predictions gp
)
SELECT 
    tp.team_name,
    SUM(tp.wdvoa + ga.betting_spread + pa.confidence_level) OVER (PARTITION BY tp.conference ORDER BY ga.week) AS cumulative_metric
FROM TeamPerformance tp
INNER JOIN GameAndBettingData ga ON tp.team_id = ga.home_team_id OR tp.team_id = ga.away_team_id
INNER JOIN PredictionAnalysis pa ON ga.game_id = pa.game_id
ORDER BY cumulative_metric DESC;

SELECT

FROM

INNER JOIN

INNER JOIN

WHERE

GROUP BY

HAVING

WITH TeamPerformance AS (

        season,

    FROM team_metrics
    GROUP BY team_id, season
),
HighConfidencePredictions AS (

        p.game_id, 
        p.confidence_level, 
        g.season, 
        g.week, 
        g.home_team_id, 
        g.away_team_id
    FROM game_predictions p
    INNER JOIN games g ON p.game_id = g.game_id
    WHERE p.confidence_level > 0.8
)
SELECT 
    t.team_name, 
    hp.week, 
    tp.avg_wdvoa
FROM HighConfidencePredictions hp
INNER JOIN TeamPerformance tp ON hp.season = tp.season AND (hp.home_team_id = tp.team_id OR hp.away_team_id = tp.team_id)
INNER JOIN teams t ON tp.team_id = t.team_id
WHERE tp.total_turnover_rate < 0.1
ORDER BY hp.week DESC;

WITH RecentMetrics AS (
    SELECT 
        tm.team_id,
        tm.season,
        tm.wdvoa,
        tm.ego,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY tm.season ORDER BY tm.wdvoa DESC, tm.ego DESC) AS rank
    FROM team_metrics tm
    WHERE tm.season >= 2020
),
TopTeams AS (
    SELECT 
        rm.team_id
    FROM RecentMetrics rm
    WHERE rm.rank <= 3
)
SELECT t.team_name
FROM TopTeams tt
JOIN teams t ON tt.team_id = t.team_id;

WITH RecursiveGameHierarchy AS (
    SELECT g.game_id, g.season, g.week, g.home_team_id, g.away_team_id, 1 AS level
    FROM games g
    WHERE g.week = 1
    UNION ALL
    SELECT g.game_id, g.season, g.week, g.home_team_id, g.away_team_id, rgh.level + 1
    FROM games g
    INNER JOIN RecursiveGameHierarchy rgh ON g.season = rgh.season AND g.week = rgh.week + 1
),
TeamMetrics AS (
    SELECT tm.team_id, tm.season, tm.wdvoa, tm.ego, tm.srd, tm.average_possession_time, tm.turnover_rate
    FROM team_metrics tm
),
GameResults AS (
    SELECT g.game_id, g.scoring_margin, g.pick_right, g.home_team_id, g.away_team_id
    FROM games g
    WHERE g.pick_right = 1
),
TeamPerformance AS (
    SELECT 
        t.team_id,
        t.team_name,
        tm.season,
        tm.wdvoa,
        tm.ego,
        tm.srd,
        tm.average_possession_time,
        tm.turnover_rate,
        COUNT(gr.game_id) AS correct_picks
    FROM teams t
    INNER JOIN TeamMetrics tm ON t.team_id = tm.team_id
    LEFT JOIN GameResults gr ON t.team_id = gr.home_team_id OR t.team_id = gr.away_team_id
    GROUP BY t.team_id, tm.season
),
CombinedResults AS (
    SELECT
        t.team_name,
        tp.season,
        tp.wdvoa,
        tp.correct_picks,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY tp.season ORDER BY tp.correct_picks DESC) AS rank
    FROM TeamPerformance tp
    INNER JOIN teams t ON tp.team_id = t.team_id
)
SELECT team_name
FROM CombinedResults
WHERE rank = 1
ORDER BY season;

WITH LocationAnalysis AS (
    SELECT game_id, location, distance
    FROM games
    WHERE location_embedding MATCH '[0.1, 0.3, 0.5, ..., 0.4]' AND k = 5
    ORDER BY distance
),
TeamPerformance AS (
    SELECT tm.team_id, tm.wdvoa, tm.ego, tm.average_possession_time,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY tm.season ORDER BY tm.wdvoa DESC) AS wdvoa_rank
    FROM team_metrics tm
    WHERE tm.season = 2023
),
PredictionAnalysis AS (
    SELECT gp.game_id, gp.wdvoa_delta, gp.spread_to_ego_diff,
           gp.make_pick, gp.confidence_level,
           ASINH(gp.confidence_level) AS adjusted_confidence
    FROM game_predictions gp
)
SELECT la.game_id, tp.wdvoa_rank, pa.adjusted_confidence
FROM LocationAnalysis la
JOIN PredictionAnalysis pa ON la.game_id = pa.game_id
JOIN games g ON g.game_id = la.game_id
JOIN teams t ON g.home_team_id = t.team_id
JOIN TeamPerformance tp ON t.team_id = tp.team_id
WHERE g.season = 2023
ORDER BY tp.wdvoa_rank, pa.adjusted_confidence DESC
LIMIT 10;

WITH PredictionAccuracy AS (
    SELECT 
        gp.game_id,
        gp.confidence_level,
        g.scoring_margin,
        g.betting_spread,
        (CASE WHEN g.pick_right = -1 THEN 'Incorrect' ELSE 'Correct' END) AS prediction_status
    FROM 
        game_predictions gp
    JOIN 
        games g ON gp.game_id = g.game_id
    WHERE 
        gp.make_pick = 1
),
RankedGames AS (
    SELECT 
        game_id,
        confidence_level,
        scoring_margin,
        betting_spread,
        prediction_status,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY prediction_status ORDER BY confidence_level DESC, scoring_margin DESC) AS rank
    FROM 
        PredictionAccuracy
    WHERE 
        prediction_status = 'Incorrect' AND scoring_margin > betting_spread
)
SELECT 
    game_id
FROM 
    RankedGames
WHERE 
    rank <= 3
ORDER BY 
    confidence_level DESC;

WITH TeamPerformance AS (
    SELECT
        tm.team_id,
        tm.season,
        AVG(tm.wdvoa) AS avg_wdvoa,
        AVG(tm.ego) AS avg_ego,
        AVG(tm.srd) AS avg_srd
    FROM
        team_metrics tm
    GROUP BY
        tm.team_id, tm.season
),
GameResults AS (
    SELECT
        g.game_id,
        g.home_team_id,
        g.away_team_id,
        CASE
            WHEN g.pick_right = 1 THEN 'correct'
            ELSE 'incorrect'
        END AS prediction_outcome,
        gp.confidence_level
    FROM
        games g
    JOIN
        game_predictions gp ON g.game_id = gp.game_id
),
ConsistentPerformance AS (
    SELECT
        tp.team_id,
        COUNT(gr.game_id) AS games_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN gr.prediction_outcome = 'correct' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS correct_predictions
    FROM
        TeamPerformance tp
    JOIN
        games g ON tp.team_id IN (g.home_team_id, g.away_team_id)
    JOIN
        GameResults gr ON g.game_id = gr.game_id
    WHERE
        tp.avg_wdvoa > 30 AND tp.avg_ego > 5
    GROUP BY
        tp.team_id
    HAVING
        correct_predictions > games_count * 0.7
)
SELECT
    t.team_name
FROM
    ConsistentPerformance cp
JOIN
    teams t ON cp.team_id = t.team_id
ORDER BY
    cp.correct_predictions DESC;

SELECT home_team_id, away_team_id
  FROM games

WITH PredictedGamesCTE AS (
    SELECT gp.game_id, gp.confidence_level, gp.spread_to_ego_diff, gp.margin_to_ego_diff,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY gp.game_id ORDER BY gp.confidence_level DESC) AS rank
    FROM game_predictions gp
    WHERE gp.make_pick = 1
),
TeamMetricsCTE AS (
    SELECT tm.team_id, tm.season, tm.wdvoa, tm.ego, tm.srd, tm.average_possession_time
    FROM team_metrics tm
    WHERE tm.season = 2023
),
BettingScenarioCTE AS (
    SELECT bd.game_id, bd.betting_spread, bd.betting_odds,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY bd.game_id ORDER BY bd.betting_odds DESC) AS rank
    FROM betting_data bd
    WHERE bd.updated_spreads LIKE '%[0.5, 0.3, 0.8]%'

-- Define a CTE to calculate the average turnover rate and average possession time for each team in the latest season
WITH LatestSeasonMetrics AS (
    SELECT 
        team_id,
        season,
        AVG(turnover_rate) AS avg_turnover_rate,
        AVG(average_possession_time) AS avg_possession_time
    FROM team_metrics
    WHERE season = (SELECT MAX(season) FROM team_metrics)
    GROUP BY team_id, season
),
-- CTE to get the detailed game data for the latest season, including teams and scores
LatestSeasonGames AS (
    SELECT 
        g.game_id,
        g.season,
        g.week,
        home_team.team_name AS home_team_name,
        away_team.team_name AS away_team_name,
        g.scoring_margin,
        g.pick_right
    FROM games g
    JOIN teams home_team ON g.home_team_id = home_team.team_id
    JOIN teams away_team ON g.away_team_id = away_team.team_id
    WHERE g.season = (SELECT MAX(season) FROM games)
),
-- CTE to calculate the overall prediction accuracy
PredictionAccuracy AS (
    SELECT 
        season,
        AVG(CASE WHEN pick_right = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS accuracy
    FROM games
    GROUP BY season
)
-- Final selection of 4 columns combining data from previous CTEs
SELECT 
    lg.home_team_name,
    lg.away_team_name,
    lm.avg_turnover_rate,
    pa.accuracy
FROM LatestSeasonGames lg
JOIN LatestSeasonMetrics lm ON lg.season = lm.season
JOIN PredictionAccuracy pa ON lg.season = pa.season
ORDER BY lg.week, lg.home_team_name, lg.away_team_name;

-- SQL query to analyze team performance and game predictions

WITH TeamPerformance AS (
  SELECT
    t.team_id,
    t.team_name,
    tm.season,
    AVG(tm.wdvoa) AS avg_wdvoa,
    AVG(tm.srd) AS avg_srd,
    SUM(tm.average_possession_time) AS total_possession_time
  FROM teams t
  INNER JOIN team_metrics tm ON t.team_id = tm.team_id
  GROUP BY t.team_id, tm.season
),
PredictedGameOutcomes AS (
  SELECT
    g.game_id,
    g.season,
    g.week,
    g.home_team_id,
    g.away_team_id,
    gp.wdvoa_delta,
    gp.confidence_level
  FROM games g
  INNER JOIN game_predictions gp ON g.game_id = gp.game_id
),
TeamGameResults AS (
  SELECT
    g.game_id,
    g.season,
    CASE
      WHEN g.scoring_margin > 0 THEN g.home_team_id
      WHEN g.scoring_margin < 0 THEN g.away_team_id
      ELSE NULL
    END AS winning_team_id
  FROM games g
)
SELECT 
  tp.team_name,
  tp.season,
  tp.avg_wdvoa,
  pgo.confidence_level,
  COUNT(tgr.winning_team_id) AS games_won
FROM TeamPerformance tp
LEFT JOIN PredictedGameOutcomes pgo ON tp.team_id = pgo.home_team_id OR tp.team_id = pgo.away_team_id
LEFT JOIN TeamGameResults tgr ON tp.team_id = tgr.winning_team_id
WHERE tp.season = 2021
GROUP BY tp.team_name, tp.season, tp.avg_wdvoa, pgo.confidence_level
ORDER BY games_won DESC, tp.avg_wdvoa DESC;

WITH TopTeams AS (

  FROM team_metrics
  WHERE season = 2023
  GROUP BY team_id
  ORDER BY avg_wdvoa DESC
  LIMIT 5
),
-- Step 2: Use a KNN query to find games that occurred in similar locations based on the location_embedding
SimilarLocationGames AS (
  SELECT game_id, distance
  FROM games
  WHERE location_embedding MATCH '[0.1, 0.2, 0.3, ..., 0.384]' -- Replace with the actual vector
  ORDER BY distance
  LIMIT 10
)
-- Step 3: Retrieve the names of top teams involved in games at similar locations
SELECT t.team_name
FROM teams t
JOIN TopTeams tt ON t.team_id = tt.team_id
JOIN games g ON g.home_team_id = tt.team_id OR g.away_team_id = tt.team_id
JOIN SimilarLocationGames slg ON g.game_id = slg.game_id

WITH GameDetails AS (

    FROM games g

    INNER JOIN teams t2 ON g.away_team_id = t2.team_id
),
TeamScoringTrends AS (
    SELECT 
        season,
        home_team_name AS team_name,
        AVG(scoring_margin) OVER (PARTITION BY season, home_team_id ORDER BY week) AS avg_scoring_margin,
        SUM(scoring_margin) OVER (PARTITION BY season, home_team_id ORDER BY week) AS cumulative_scoring_margin
    FROM GameDetails
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        season,
        away_team_name AS team_name,
        AVG(-scoring_margin) OVER (PARTITION BY season, away_team_id ORDER BY week) AS avg_scoring_margin,
        SUM(-scoring_margin) OVER (PARTITION BY season, away_team_id ORDER BY week) AS cumulative_scoring_margin
    FROM GameDetails
)

FROM TeamScoringTrends

-- CTE to get auction details with the cumulative number of horses per auction
WITH AuctionDetails AS (
    SELECT

        a.auction_name,

    FROM auctions a
    INNER JOIN horses h ON a.auction_id = h.auction_id
    GROUP BY a.auction_id, a.auction_name, a.date
),
-- CTE to calculate the average birth year of horses per color
HorseColorStats AS (
    SELECT 
        h.color,
        AVG(h.birth_year) AS avg_birth_year
    FROM horses h
    GROUP BY h.color
),
-- Recursive CTE to generate a hierarchy of auctions over time
RecursiveAuctionHierarchy AS (
    SELECT 
        auction_id, 
        auction_name, 
        date, 
        1 AS level
    FROM auctions
    WHERE date = (
        SELECT MIN(date) FROM auctions
    )
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        a.auction_id, 
        a.auction_name, 
        a.date, 
        rah.level + 1
    FROM auctions a
    INNER JOIN RecursiveAuctionHierarchy rah ON a.date > rah.date
),
-- CTE for KNN query on horse names
HorseNameKNN AS (
    SELECT 
        h.hip_no, 
        h.horse_name, 
        distance
    FROM horses h
    WHERE horse_name_embedding MATCH '[0.1, 0.2, 0.3, ..., 0.4]' -- Example vector
    ORDER BY distance
    LIMIT 5
)
-- Final selection combining the CTEs
SELECT 
    ad.auction_name, 
    sum(ad.horse_count) OVER (ORDER BY ad.date) AS cumulative_horse_count
FROM AuctionDetails ad
JOIN HorseColorStats hcs ON ad.auction_id = (SELECT auction_id FROM auctions WHERE location = 'Kentucky' LIMIT 1)
JOIN RecursiveAuctionHierarchy rah ON ad.auction_id = rah.auction_id

ORDER BY ad.date;

WITH PublisherInstitutionDetails AS (
    -- CTE to gather publisher and institution details along with their embeddings
    SELECT 
        p.publisher_id,
        p.publisher_name,

    FROM analytics a

RelatedAnalytics AS (
    -- CTE to gather detailed analytics for top viewed books
    SELECT 
        a.book_id,

        a.downloads,

-- Main query combining the results from CTEs
SELECT 
    pid.publisher_name || ' (' || pid.publisher_email || ')' AS contact_details
FROM PublisherInstitutionDetails pid
JOIN RelatedAnalytics ra ON pid.publisher_id = (
    SELECT publisher_id FROM book_publisher WHERE book_id = ra.book_id LIMIT 1
)
ORDER BY ra.views DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT SUM(views) AS total_views, SUM(downloads) AS total_downloads
  FROM analytics;

SELECT 
    p.publisher_name,
    COUNT(bp.book_id) AS total_books,
    SUM(a.views) AS total_views
FROM publishers p
INNER JOIN book_publisher bp ON p.publisher_id = bp.publisher_id
LEFT JOIN analytics a ON bp.book_id = a.book_id
GROUP BY p.publisher_name
HAVING SUM(a.views) > 100
ORDER BY total_views DESC;

WITH PublisherAnalytics AS (
    SELECT 
        bp.publisher_id,
        SUM(a.views) AS total_views,
        a.region_with_highest_views
    FROM book_publisher bp
    JOIN analytics a ON bp.book_id = a.book_id
    GROUP BY bp.publisher_id, a.region_with_highest_views
),
TopRegionPublishers AS (
    SELECT 
        pa.publisher_id,
        pa.total_views,
        pa.region_with_highest_views,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pa.region_with_highest_views ORDER BY pa.total_views DESC) AS rank
    FROM PublisherAnalytics pa
),
InstitutionFunding AS (
    SELECT 
        bi.institution_id,
        SUM(i.amount_euro) AS total_funding
    FROM book_institution bi
    JOIN institutions i ON bi.institution_id = i.institution_id
    GROUP BY bi.institution_id
),
TopFundedInstitutions AS (
    SELECT 
        institution_id,
        total_funding,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_funding DESC) AS funding_rank
    FROM InstitutionFunding
)
SELECT 
    p.publisher_name,
    trp.region_with_highest_views,
    tfi.total_funding
FROM TopRegionPublishers trp
JOIN publishers p ON trp.publisher_id = p.publisher_id
LEFT JOIN TopFundedInstitutions tfi ON p.publisher_id = tfi.institution_id
WHERE trp.rank = 1 AND trp.region_with_highest_views = 'Europe'
ORDER BY tfi.total_funding DESC
LIMIT 10;

WITH InstitutionFunding AS (
    SELECT 
        i.institution_id, 
        i.institution_name, 
        SUM(i.amount_euro) AS total_funding
    FROM 
        institutions i
    INNER JOIN 
        book_institution bi ON i.institution_id = bi.institution_id
    GROUP BY 
        i.institution_id, i.institution_name
),
PublisherBookCount AS (
    SELECT 
        p.publisher_id, 
        p.publisher_name, 
        COUNT(bp.book_id) AS total_books_published
    FROM 
        publishers p
    INNER JOIN 
        book_publisher bp ON p.publisher_id = bp.publisher_id
    GROUP BY 
        p.publisher_id, p.publisher_name
)
SELECT 
    pb.publisher_name,
    i.institution_name,
    total_books_published
FROM 
    PublisherBookCount pb
LEFT JOIN 
    InstitutionFunding i ON pb.publisher_id = i.institution_id
ORDER BY 
    total_books_published DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT 
    p.publisher_name, 
    SUM(a.citations) AS total_citations
FROM publishers p
INNER JOIN book_publisher bp ON p.publisher_id = bp.publisher_id
INNER JOIN book_institution bi ON bp.book_id = bi.book_id
INNER JOIN analytics a ON bp.book_id = a.book_id
WHERE a.citations > 100
GROUP BY p.publisher_name
HAVING total_citations > 500

WITH TopBooks AS (
  SELECT
    book_id,
    MAX(views) AS max_views
  FROM
    analytics
  GROUP BY
    book_id
),
PublisherViews AS (
  SELECT
    pb.book_id,
    pb.publisher_id,
    a.views
  FROM
    book_publisher pb
  INNER JOIN
    analytics a ON pb.book_id = a.book_id
  WHERE
    a.views IN (SELECT max_views FROM TopBooks)
)
SELECT
  p.publisher_name
FROM
  PublisherViews pv
INNER JOIN
  publishers p ON pv.publisher_id = p.publisher_id
ORDER BY
  pv.views DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT SUM(views)
FROM analytics;

SELECT p.publisher_name, COUNT(b.book_id) AS number_of_books
FROM publishers p
INNER JOIN book_publisher b ON p.publisher_id = b.publisher_id
WHERE p.country = 'United States'
GROUP BY p.publisher_name
HAVING COUNT(b.book_id) > 5;

WITH PublisherAnalytics AS (
    SELECT
        p.publisher_id,
        p.publisher_name,
        a.views,
        a.downloads,
        a.citations,
        a.last_accessed,
        a.region_with_highest_views
    FROM publishers p
    INNER JOIN book_publisher bp ON p.publisher_id = bp.publisher_id
    INNER JOIN analytics a ON bp.book_id = a.book_id
),
RegionViews AS (
    SELECT
        region_with_highest_views,
        SUM(views) AS total_views,
        COUNT(DISTINCT publisher_id) AS publisher_count
    FROM PublisherAnalytics
    GROUP BY region_with_highest_views
),
PublisherStats AS (
    SELECT
        p.publisher_id,
        COALESCE(SUM(a.views), 0) AS total_views,
        COALESCE(SUM(a.downloads), 0) AS total_downloads,
        COALESCE(SUM(a.citations), 0) AS total_citations,
        COUNT(DISTINCT a.book_id) AS book_count
    FROM publishers p
    LEFT JOIN book_publisher bp ON p.publisher_id = bp.publisher_id
    LEFT JOIN analytics a ON bp.book_id = a.book_id
    GROUP BY p.publisher_id
)
SELECT
    ra.region_with_highest_views,
    ra.total_views,
    ra.publisher_count,
    SUM(ps.total_views) OVER (PARTITION BY ra.region_with_highest_views ORDER BY ra.total_views DESC) AS cumulative_views
FROM RegionViews ra
INNER JOIN PublisherAnalytics pa ON ra.region_with_highest_views = pa.region_with_highest_views
INNER JOIN PublisherStats ps ON pa.publisher_id = ps.publisher_id
ORDER BY ra.total_views DESC;

-- Begin by defining Common Table Expressions to set up data for querying

WITH MaxFundingInstitutions AS (
    SELECT 
        institution_id, 
        institution_name, 
        country,
        amount_euro,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY amount_euro DESC) AS funding_rank
    FROM institutions
    WHERE country = 'Germany'
), TopInstitutions AS (
    -- Filter for top 3 institutions by funding
    SELECT institution_id, institution_name, amount_euro
    FROM MaxFundingInstitutions
    WHERE funding_rank <= 3
)

-- Main query to select relevant data

SELECT 
    p.publisher_name,
    i.institution_name,
    i.amount_euro
FROM publishers AS p
JOIN book_publisher AS bp ON p.publisher_id = bp.publisher_id
JOIN book_institution AS bi ON bp.book_id = bi.book_id
JOIN TopInstitutions AS i ON bi.institution_id = i.institution_id
ORDER BY i.amount_euro DESC;

WITH PublisherBooks AS (
    SELECT bp.book_id, p.publisher_name
    FROM book_publisher bp
    INNER JOIN publishers p ON bp.publisher_id = p.publisher_id
    WHERE p.country = 'Germany'
),
BookAnalytics AS (
    SELECT book_id, views, downloads, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY views DESC) AS view_rank
    FROM analytics
)
SELECT SUM(ba.views + ba.downloads) AS Total_Views_Downloads
FROM PublisherBooks pb
INNER JOIN BookAnalytics ba ON pb.book_id = ba.book_id
WHERE ba.view_rank <= 5;

SELECT license_name, license_url
FROM licenses;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name
FROM 
    institutions AS i
JOIN 
    book_institution AS bi ON i.institution_id = bi.institution_id
JOIN 
    analytics AS a ON bi.book_id = a.book_id
WHERE 
    a.citations > 0
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_name
ORDER BY 
    SUM(a.citations) DESC
LIMIT 3;

WITH PublisherCountry AS (
    SELECT publisher_id, publisher_name, country
    FROM publishers
    WHERE country IN ('Germany', 'France', 'United Kingdom')
  ),
  InstitutionFunding AS (
    SELECT institution_id, institution_name, amount_euro
    FROM institutions
    WHERE amount_euro > 100000
  ),
  BookAnalytics AS (
    SELECT
      ba.book_id,
      SUM(ba.views) OVER (PARTITION BY ba.book_id) AS total_views,
      SUM(ba.downloads) OVER (PARTITION BY ba.book_id) AS total_downloads
    FROM analytics ba
    WHERE ba.region_with_highest_views IN ('Europe', 'North America')
  ),
  PublisherBooks AS (
    SELECT pb.book_id, pc.publisher_name
    FROM book_publisher pb
    INNER JOIN PublisherCountry pc ON pb.publisher_id = pc.publisher_id
  ),
  InstitutionBooks AS (
    SELECT bi.book_id, if.institution_name
    FROM book_institution bi
    INNER JOIN InstitutionFunding if ON bi.institution_id = if.institution_id
  ),
  LicenseKNN AS (
    SELECT l.license_id, l.license_name, distance
    FROM licenses l
    WHERE description_embedding MATCH '[0.5, 0.3, 0.8, ...]' -- Example embedding vector
    ORDER BY distance 
    LIMIT 5
  )
SELECT DISTINCT pb.publisher_name
FROM PublisherBooks pb
INNER JOIN BookAnalytics ba ON pb.book_id = ba.book_id
INNER JOIN InstitutionBooks ib ON pb.book_id = ib.book_id
INNER JOIN LicenseKNN lk ON pb.book_id = lk.license_id
WHERE ba.total_views > 1000 AND ba.total_downloads > 500
ORDER BY pb.publisher_name;

WITH PublisherBooks AS (
    SELECT 
        bp.publisher_id, 
        COUNT(bp.book_id) AS total_books
    FROM 
        book_publisher bp
    GROUP BY 
        bp.publisher_id
),
PublisherAnalytics AS (
    SELECT 
        bp.publisher_id, 
        SUM(a.views) AS total_views,
        SUM(a.downloads) AS total_downloads,
        SUM(a.citations) AS total_citations
    FROM 
        book_publisher bp
    JOIN 
        analytics a ON bp.book_id = a.book_id
    GROUP BY 
        bp.publisher_id
)
SELECT 
    p.publisher_name
FROM 
    PublisherBooks pb
JOIN 
    PublisherAnalytics pa ON pb.publisher_id = pa.publisher_id
JOIN 
    publishers p ON pb.publisher_id = p.publisher_id
WHERE 
    pa.total_views > 1000
ORDER BY 
    pa.total_views DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT publisher_name, country
FROM publishers;

SELECT p.publisher_name, SUM(i.amount_euro) AS total_funding
FROM publishers p
INNER JOIN book_publisher bp ON p.publisher_id = bp.publisher_id
INNER JOIN book_institution bi ON bp.book_id = bi.book_id
INNER JOIN institutions i ON bi.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE i.country = 'Germany'
GROUP BY p.publisher_name
HAVING total_funding > 10000;

SELECT 
  p.publisher_name, 
  SUM(a.views) AS total_views
FROM 
  publishers p
INNER JOIN 
  book_publisher bp ON p.publisher_id = bp.publisher_id
INNER JOIN 
  analytics a ON bp.book_id = a.book_id
WHERE 
  a.views > 100
GROUP BY 
  p.publisher_name
HAVING 
  SUM(a.views) > 300
ORDER BY 
  total_views DESC;

WITH PublisherBookAnalytics AS (
    SELECT 
        p.publisher_name, 
        a.book_id,
        SUM(a.views) AS total_views,
        SUM(a.downloads) AS total_downloads,
        SUM(a.citations) AS total_citations
    FROM 
        publishers p
    JOIN 
        book_publisher bp ON p.publisher_id = bp.publisher_id
    JOIN 
        analytics a ON bp.book_id = a.book_id
    WHERE 
        UPPER(p.country) = 'EUROPE'
    GROUP BY 
        p.publisher_name, a.book_id
),
InstitutionFunding AS (
    SELECT 
        i.institution_name,
        SUM(i.amount_euro) AS total_funding
    FROM 
        institutions i
    JOIN 
        book_institution bi ON i.institution_id = bi.institution_id
    GROUP BY 
        i.institution_name
    HAVING 
        SUM(i.amount_euro) > 100000
),
KNNInstitutions AS (
    SELECT
        institution_id,
        distance
    FROM
        institutions
    WHERE
        institution_name_embedding MATCH '[0.1, 0.2, 0.3, ..., 0.384]' -- Example vector, replace with an actual 384-dimensional vector
    ORDER BY
        distance
    LIMIT 5
)
SELECT 
    pba.publisher_name, 
    i.institution_name,
    pba.total_views
FROM 
    PublisherBookAnalytics pba
JOIN 
    InstitutionFunding i ON pba.book_id = (SELECT book_id FROM book_institution WHERE institution_id = (SELECT institution_id FROM KNNInstitutions))
ORDER BY 
    pba.total_views DESC;

WITH RECURSIVE InstitutionFundingHierarchy AS (
    SELECT institution_id, institution_name, funding_period, amount_euro, country, 1 AS level
    FROM institutions
    WHERE funding_period = 1
    UNION ALL
    SELECT i.institution_id, i.institution_name, i.funding_period, i.amount_euro, i.country, ifh.level + 1
    FROM institutions i
    JOIN InstitutionFundingHierarchy ifh ON i.funding_period = ifh.funding_period + 1
),
PublisherAnalytics AS (
    SELECT p.publisher_id, p.publisher_name, a.views, a.downloads, a.citations
    FROM publishers p
    JOIN book_publisher bp ON p.publisher_id = bp.publisher_id
    JOIN analytics a ON bp.book_id = a.book_id
),
InstitutionAnalytics AS (
    SELECT i.institution_id, i.institution_name, a.views, a.downloads, a.citations
    FROM institutions i
    JOIN book_institution bi ON i.institution_id = bi.institution_id
    JOIN analytics a ON bi.book_id = a.book_id
),
AggregatedData AS (
    SELECT ia.institution_id, ia.institution_name, SUM(ia.views) AS total_views, SUM(ia.downloads) AS total_downloads, SUM(ia.citations) AS total_citations
    FROM InstitutionAnalytics ia
    GROUP BY ia.institution_id, ia.institution_name
    UNION ALL
    SELECT pa.publisher_id, pa.publisher_name, SUM(pa.views) AS total_views, SUM(pa.downloads) AS total_downloads, SUM(pa.citations) AS total_citations
    FROM PublisherAnalytics pa
    GROUP BY pa.publisher_id, pa.publisher_name
)
SELECT ad.institution_name AS name, 
       SUM(ad.total_views) OVER (PARTITION BY ad.institution_id ORDER BY ad.institution_name) AS cumulative_views
FROM AggregatedData ad
JOIN InstitutionFundingHierarchy ifh ON ad.institution_id = ifh.institution_id
ORDER BY ad.institution_name
LIMIT 10;

SELECT COUNT(bi.book_id) AS book_count
FROM book_institution bi
INNER JOIN institutions i ON bi.institution_id = i.institution_id
INNER JOIN book_publisher bp ON bi.book_id = bp.book_id
INNER JOIN publishers p ON bp.publisher_id = p.publisher_id
WHERE i.country = 'Germany' AND p.country = 'USA'
GROUP BY i.country
HAVING COUNT(bi.book_id) > 10;

SELECT p.publisher_name, SUM(a.views) AS total_views
FROM publishers AS p
INNER JOIN book_publisher AS bp ON p.publisher_id = bp.publisher_id
INNER JOIN analytics AS a ON bp.book_id = a.book_id
WHERE p.country = 'Germany'
GROUP BY p.publisher_name
HAVING SUM(a.views) > 10000
ORDER BY total_views DESC
LIMIT 5;

WITH BookAnalyticsCTE AS (
    SELECT
        b.publisher_id,
        a.book_id,
        a.views,
        a.downloads,
        a.citations
    FROM
        analytics AS a
    INNER JOIN book_publisher AS b ON a.book_id = b.book_id
),
PublisherInstitutionCTE AS (
    SELECT
        p.publisher_id,
        p.country AS publisher_country,
        i.country AS institution_country,
        COUNT(bi.book_id) AS total_books_funded
    FROM
        publishers AS p
    INNER JOIN book_publisher AS bp ON p.publisher_id = bp.publisher_id
    INNER JOIN book_institution AS bi ON bp.book_id = bi.book_id
    INNER JOIN institutions AS i ON bi.institution_id = i.institution_id
    GROUP BY
        p.publisher_id, i.country
)
SELECT
    pi.publisher_country,
    SUM(ba.views) AS total_views,
    SUM(ba.downloads) AS total_downloads,
    SUM(ba.citations) AS total_citations
FROM
    BookAnalyticsCTE AS ba
INNER JOIN PublisherInstitutionCTE AS pi ON ba.publisher_id = pi.publisher_id
GROUP BY
    pi.publisher_country;

WITH TopBooks AS (
  SELECT book_id, views
  FROM analytics
  ORDER BY views DESC
  LIMIT 3
),
PublisherDetails AS (
  SELECT bp.book_id, p.publisher_name, p.country
  FROM book_publisher bp
  JOIN publishers p ON bp.publisher_id = p.publisher_id
  WHERE bp.book_id IN (SELECT book_id FROM TopBooks)
),
InstitutionDetails AS (
  SELECT bi.book_id, i.institution_name, i.amount_euro
  FROM book_institution bi
  JOIN institutions i ON bi.institution_id = i.institution_id
  WHERE bi.book_id IN (SELECT book_id FROM TopBooks)
)
SELECT pd.publisher_name, id.institution_name
FROM PublisherDetails pd
JOIN InstitutionDetails id ON pd.book_id = id.book_id

WITH PublisherActivity AS (
    SELECT p.publisher_id, p.publisher_name, COUNT(bp.book_id) AS total_books
    FROM publishers p
    LEFT JOIN book_publisher bp ON p.publisher_id = bp.publisher_id
    GROUP BY p.publisher_id
),
InstitutionFunding AS (
    SELECT i.institution_id, i.institution_name, SUM(i.amount_euro) AS total_funding
    FROM institutions i
    GROUP BY i.institution_id
),
LicenseUsage AS (
    SELECT l.license_id, l.license_name, COUNT(a.analytics_id) AS usage_count
    FROM licenses l
    LEFT JOIN analytics a ON l.license_id = a.analytics_id
    GROUP BY l.license_id
),
UserAffiliation AS (
    SELECT u.user_id, u.username, instr(u.email, '@') AS email_domain_position, u.role
    FROM users u
),
UserRoles AS (
    SELECT role, COUNT(user_id) AS role_count
    FROM UserAffiliation
    GROUP BY role
)
SELECT ua.username
FROM UserAffiliation ua
JOIN UserRoles ur ON ua.role = ur.role
WHERE ur.role_count > 1
ORDER BY ua.email_domain_position
LIMIT 10;

SELECT book_id
FROM analytics;

WITH TopPublisherCTE AS (
    SELECT 
        bp.publisher_id,
        SUM(a.views) AS total_views
    FROM 
        analytics a
    INNER JOIN 
        book_publisher bp ON a.book_id = bp.book_id
    GROUP BY 
        bp.publisher_id
    ORDER BY 
        total_views DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 
    p.publisher_name
FROM 
    TopPublisherCTE tp
INNER JOIN 
    publishers p ON tp.publisher_id = p.publisher_id;

SELECT book_id, MAX(views)
FROM analytics;

WITH RecursivePublisherHierarchy AS (
    SELECT 
        p.publisher_id,
        p.publisher_name,
        p.country,
        1 AS level
    FROM publishers p
    WHERE p.country = 'United States'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        p.publisher_id,
        p.publisher_name,
        p.country,
        rph.level + 1
    FROM publishers p
    JOIN RecursivePublisherHierarchy rph ON p.country = rph.country
    WHERE rph.level < 3
),
TopInstitutionsByFunding AS (
    SELECT 
        i.institution_id,
        i.institution_name,
        SUM(i.amount_euro) AS total_funding
    FROM institutions i
    GROUP BY i.institution_id
    ORDER BY total_funding DESC
    LIMIT 10
),
BookAnalytics AS (
    SELECT 
        a.book_id,
        SUM(a.views) AS total_views,
        SUM(a.downloads) AS total_downloads,
        SUM(a.citations) AS total_citations
    FROM analytics a
    GROUP BY a.book_id
),
TopBooks AS (
    SELECT 
        ba.book_id
    FROM BookAnalytics ba
    WHERE ba.total_views > 1000 OR ba.total_citations > 50
),
PublisherInstitutionMatch AS (
    SELECT 
        bp.book_id,
        bp.publisher_id,
        bi.institution_id
    FROM book_publisher bp
    JOIN book_institution bi ON bp.book_id = bi.book_id
    WHERE bp.book_id IN (SELECT book_id FROM TopBooks)
)
SELECT
    rp.publisher_name
FROM RecursivePublisherHierarchy rp
JOIN PublisherInstitutionMatch pim ON rp.publisher_id = pim.publisher_id
JOIN TopInstitutionsByFunding tif ON pim.institution_id = tif.institution_id
ORDER BY rp.publisher_name;

SELECT COUNT(analytics_id) AS total_analytics_records
FROM analytics;

WITH PopularBooks AS (
    SELECT 
        book_id,
        views + downloads + citations AS popularity_score
    FROM analytics
    ORDER BY popularity_score DESC
    LIMIT 5
),
PublisherInstitutionInfo AS (
    SELECT 
        pb.book_id,
        p.publisher_name,
        i.institution_name,
        p.publisher_name_embedding,
        i.institution_name_embedding
    FROM PopularBooks pb
    INNER JOIN book_publisher bp ON pb.book_id = bp.book_id
    INNER JOIN publishers p ON bp.publisher_id = p.publisher_id
    INNER JOIN book_institution bi ON pb.book_id = bi.book_id
    INNER JOIN institutions i ON bi.institution_id = i.institution_id
),
SimilarPublishers AS (
    SELECT 
        p.publisher_id,
        p.publisher_name,
        distance
    FROM publishers p
    WHERE p.publisher_name_embedding MATCH '[0.5, 0.5, 0.5, ...]' -- Random vector for demonstration
    ORDER BY distance
    LIMIT 3
)
SELECT spi.publisher_name
FROM PublisherInstitutionInfo spi
WHERE spi.publisher_name IN (SELECT publisher_name FROM SimilarPublishers);

SELECT 
  p.publisher_name,
  SUM(a.views) AS total_views
FROM 
  publishers p
INNER JOIN 
  book_publisher bp ON p.publisher_id = bp.publisher_id
INNER JOIN 
  analytics a ON bp.book_id = a.book_id
GROUP BY 
  p.publisher_name
ORDER BY 
  total_views DESC;

SELECT 
    p.publisher_name, 
    p.country, 
    COUNT(bp.book_id) AS total_books
FROM 
    publishers p
INNER JOIN 
    book_publisher bp ON p.publisher_id = bp.publisher_id
INNER JOIN 
    book_institution bi ON bp.book_id = bi.book_id
GROUP BY 
    p.publisher_id
ORDER BY 
    total_books DESC
LIMIT 3;

WITH BookPublisherDetails AS (
    -- Get the necessary information about books and publishers
    SELECT 
        bp.book_id,
        p.publisher_id,
        p.publisher_name,
        p.country AS publisher_country
    FROM book_publisher bp
    INNER JOIN publishers p ON bp.publisher_id = p.publisher_id
),
BookInstitutionDetails AS (
    -- Get the necessary information about books and institutions
    SELECT 
        bi.book_id,
        i.institution_id,
        i.institution_name,
        i.country AS institution_country,
        i.amount_euro
    FROM book_institution bi
    INNER JOIN institutions i ON bi.institution_id = i.institution_id
),
BookAnalytics AS (
    -- Analytics data for books
    SELECT
        a.book_id,
        a.views,
        a.downloads,
        a.citations,
        a.last_accessed
    FROM analytics a
),
PublisherInstitutionAnalysis AS (
    -- Combine the book, publisher, institution, and analytics details
    SELECT 
        bpd.publisher_name,
        bid.institution_name,
        ba.views + ba.downloads AS total_interactions,
        ba.citations
    FROM BookPublisherDetails bpd
    INNER JOIN BookInstitutionDetails bid ON bpd.book_id = bid.book_id
    INNER JOIN BookAnalytics ba ON bpd.book_id = ba.book_id
)
-- Selecting four columns: Publisher Name, Institution Name, Total Interactions, and Citations
SELECT 
    pia.publisher_name,
    pia.institution_name,
    pia.total_interactions,
    pia.citations
FROM PublisherInstitutionAnalysis pia
ORDER BY pia.total_interactions DESC, pia.citations DESC;

SELECT publisher_name, country
  FROM publishers
  WHERE country = 'United States'
  ORDER BY publisher_id;

SELECT p.publisher_name, i.institution_name
FROM publishers p
INNER JOIN book_publisher bp ON p.publisher_id = bp.publisher_id
INNER JOIN book_institution bi ON bp.book_id = bi.book_id
INNER JOIN institutions i ON bi.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE p.country = 'Germany'
GROUP BY p.publisher_name, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(bp.book_id) > 1;

SELECT country
FROM publishers;

WITH PublisherDetails AS (
    SELECT 
        p.publisher_id, 
        p.publisher_name, 
        p.country,
        COUNT(bp.book_id) AS total_books
    FROM publishers p
    LEFT JOIN book_publisher bp ON p.publisher_id = bp.publisher_id
    GROUP BY p.publisher_id
),
InstitutionFunding AS (
    SELECT 
        i.institution_id, 
        i.institution_name, 
        i.country,
        SUM(i.amount_euro) AS total_funding
    FROM institutions i

-- Define a recursive CTE to find hierarchical relationships between publishers and associated books
WITH RECURSIVE PublisherBooksHierarchy AS (
    SELECT bp.publisher_id, bp.book_id, 1 as level
    FROM book_publisher bp
    UNION ALL
    SELECT pb.publisher_id, bi.book_id, pbh.level + 1
    FROM book_publisher pb
    JOIN book_institution bi ON pb.book_id = bi.book_id
    JOIN PublisherBooksHierarchy pbh ON pb.publisher_id = pbh.publisher_id
),
-- CTE to calculate total views, downloads, and citations for each publisher
PublisherAnalytics AS (
    SELECT pb.publisher_id, SUM(a.views) AS total_views, SUM(a.downloads) AS total_downloads, SUM(a.citations) AS total_citations
    FROM PublisherBooksHierarchy pb
    JOIN analytics a ON pb.book_id = a.book_id
    GROUP BY pb.publisher_id
),
-- CTE to calculate total funding per institution
InstitutionFunding AS (
    SELECT i.institution_id, SUM(i.amount_euro) AS total_funding
    FROM institutions i
    GROUP BY i.institution_id
),
-- CTE for publishers matching with a vector search query
MatchedPublishers AS (
    SELECT publisher_id, publisher_name, distance
    FROM publishers
    WHERE publisher_name_embedding MATCH '[0.5, 0.3, 0.8, ...]'  -- Random vector example
    ORDER BY distance
    LIMIT 3
),
-- Final selection combining all previous CTEs
FinalSelection AS (
    SELECT mp.publisher_name AS SelectedPublisher
    FROM MatchedPublishers mp
    JOIN PublisherAnalytics pa ON mp.publisher_id = pa.publisher_id
    JOIN institutions i ON i.country = (SELECT country FROM publishers p WHERE p.publisher_id = mp.publisher_id)
    JOIN InstitutionFunding ifd ON i.institution_id = ifd.institution_id
    ORDER BY pa.total_views DESC, ifd.total_funding DESC
)
-- Select the publisher name based on analytics and funding
SELECT SelectedPublisher
FROM FinalSelection;

    FROM market_data md

    GROUP BY s.sector
),
StockPerformanceCTE AS (
    SELECT 
        s.stock_id,
        s.symbol,
        md.date,
        md.close,
        LAG(md.close) OVER (PARTITION BY s.stock_id ORDER BY md.date) AS prev_close,
        (md.close - LAG(md.close) OVER (PARTITION BY s.stock_id ORDER BY md.date)) / LAG(md.close) OVER (PARTITION BY s.stock_id ORDER BY md.date) * 100 AS daily_return
    FROM market_data md
    JOIN stocks s ON md.stock_id = s.stock_id
    WHERE md.date BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-12-31'
)

JOIN SectorAnalysisCTE sa ON sv.stock_id = (SELECT s.stock_id FROM stocks s WHERE s.sector = sa.sector ORDER BY RANDOM() LIMIT 1)

-- Calculate moving averages and other statistics over stock market data
WITH RECURSIVE StockDates AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT date
    FROM market_data
    ORDER BY date
),
MovingAverages AS (
    SELECT 
        md.stock_id,
        md.date,
        AVG(md.close) OVER (PARTITION BY md.stock_id ORDER BY md.date ROWS BETWEEN 4 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_close_5days,
        AVG(md.volume) OVER (PARTITION BY md.stock_id ORDER BY md.date ROWS BETWEEN 4 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_volume_5days
    FROM 
        market_data md
),
DailyChange AS (
    SELECT 
        md.stock_id,
        md.date,
        (md.close - LAG(md.close, 1, md.close) OVER (PARTITION BY md.stock_id ORDER BY md.date)) / LAG(md.close, 1, md.close) OVER (PARTITION BY md.stock_id ORDER BY md.date) * 100 AS daily_pct_change
    FROM 
        market_data md
),
CumulativeVolume AS (
    SELECT 
        md.stock_id,
        md.date,
        SUM(md.volume) OVER (PARTITION BY md.stock_id ORDER BY md.date) AS cumulative_volume
    FROM 
        market_data md
),
CombinedData AS (
    SELECT 
        ma.stock_id,
        ma.date,
        ma.moving_avg_close_5days,
        ma.moving_avg_volume_5days,
        dc.daily_pct_change,
        cv.cumulative_volume
    FROM 
        MovingAverages ma
    JOIN 
        DailyChange dc ON ma.stock_id = dc.stock_id AND ma.date = dc.date
    JOIN 
        CumulativeVolume cv ON ma.stock_id = cv.stock_id AND ma.date = cv.date
)
SELECT 
    sd.date,
    AVG(cd.moving_avg_close_5days) AS avg_moving_avg_close_5days
FROM 
    StockDates sd
LEFT JOIN 
    CombinedData cd ON sd.date = cd.date
GROUP BY 
    sd.date
ORDER BY 
    sd.date;

),
FinalStockAnalysis AS (

        SUM(md.volume) OVER (PARTITION BY hs.stock_id ORDER BY md.date) AS cumulative_volume,
        (md.adj_close - LAG(md.adj_close) OVER (PARTITION BY hs.stock_id ORDER BY md.date)) / LAG(md.adj_close) OVER (PARTITION BY hs.stock_id ORDER BY md.date) AS pct_change
    FROM HighVolumeStocks hs

-- Step 1: Define a Common Table Expression (CTE) to filter market data from the last year
WITH LastYearData AS (
    SELECT
        md.stock_id,
        md.volume,
        md.date
    FROM
        market_data md
    WHERE
        md.date >= date('now', '-1 year')
),

-- Step 2: Calculate the average volume for each stock using the CTE
AverageVolume AS (
    SELECT
        lyd.stock_id,
        AVG(lyd.volume) AS avg_volume
    FROM
        LastYearData lyd
    GROUP BY
        lyd.stock_id
),

-- Step 3: Rank stocks based on their average volume using a window function
RankedStocks AS (
    SELECT
        av.stock_id,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY av.avg_volume DESC) AS volume_rank
    FROM
        AverageVolume av
)

-- Step 4: Select the top 5 stocks with the highest average volume and get their symbols from stocks table
SELECT
    s.symbol
FROM
    RankedStocks rs
JOIN
    stocks s ON rs.stock_id = s.stock_id
WHERE
    rs.volume_rank <= 5;

    WHERE s.status = 'active'
),
RankedStocks AS (

TopAccessedStocks AS (

ExchangeDetails AS (

MostAccessedStockDetails AS (

WITH ActiveStocks AS (

RecentMarketData AS (

UserAccess AS (

KNNStockSearch AS (

)
SELECT a.symbol, ua.access_count, rmd.avg_adj_close

LIMIT 10;

),
AlertDetails AS (

CombinedInfo AS (

        se.symbol,

        se.exchange_name,

WITH RECURSIVE StockHierarchy AS (

),
ExchangeDetails AS (
    SELECT eh.exchange_id, e.name AS exchange_name, e.country, count(sh.stock_id) AS active_stocks

    INNER JOIN StockHierarchy eh ON eh.exchange_id = e.exchange_id

),
StockPerformance AS (
    SELECT md.stock_id, md.date, md.close, md.adj_close, md.volume, s.symbol
    FROM market_data md
    INNER JOIN stocks s ON md.stock_id = s.stock_id

),
SectorAnalysis AS (

),
TopIndicators AS (

SectorEmbeddingMatch AS (

    ORDER BY distance

)
SELECT e.exchange_name, sa.avg_adj_close_price
FROM ExchangeDetails e
INNER JOIN SectorAnalysis sa ON sa.sector = 'Technology'
WHERE e.country = 'United States'
ORDER BY e.exchange_name;

WITH AvgEmvCTE AS (
    SELECT 
        md.stock_id,
        s.symbol,
        s.name,

    FROM

),
RankedEmvCTE AS (

WHERE

WITH TradeCounts AS (
    SELECT 
        m.stock_id,
        s.sector,
        s.name,
        SUM(m.trade_count) AS total_trades
    FROM 
        market_data m
    INNER JOIN 
        stocks s ON m.stock_id = s.stock_id
    GROUP BY

),
RankedTrades AS (
    SELECT 
        stock_id,
        sector,

SELECT AVG(open) AS average_opening_price
FROM market_data;

WITH RecentMarketData AS (

        md.stock_id, 
        md.volume,

TopRecentMarketData AS (

),
StockVolumes AS (

TopStocksPerExchange AS (

SELECT

SELECT s.symbol

GROUP BY

HAVING

WITH SectorAverage AS (

        stocks s ON m.stock_id = s.stock_id

SELECT s.name

WHERE md.date BETWEEN '2023-10-01' AND '2023-10-31'

HAVING AVG(md.volume) > 50000;

WITH TopTradedStocks AS (

        md.stock_id,

        e.name AS exchange_name

SELECT date, close

WHERE stock_id = 1
ORDER BY date ASC;

WITH DateRangeCTE AS (
    SELECT 
        stock_id,
        MIN(date) AS start_date,
        MAX(date) AS end_date
    FROM market_data
    WHERE date BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-12-31'
    GROUP BY stock_id
),
PriceCTE AS (
    SELECT 
        md.stock_id,
        md.date,
        md.close,
        dr.start_date,
        dr.end_date
    FROM market_data md
    INNER JOIN DateRangeCTE dr ON md.stock_id = dr.stock_id
    WHERE md.date = dr.start_date OR md.date = dr.end_date
),
PercentageGainCTE AS (
    SELECT 
        p.stock_id,
        (MAX(CASE WHEN p.date = p.end_date THEN p.close END) - 
         MIN(CASE WHEN p.date = p.start_date THEN p.close END)) /
         MIN(CASE WHEN p.date = p.start_date THEN p.close END) * 100 AS percentage_gain
    FROM PriceCTE p
    GROUP BY p.stock_id
)
SELECT 
    s.symbol,
    pg.percentage_gain
FROM PercentageGainCTE pg
INNER JOIN stocks s ON pg.stock_id = s.stock_id
WHERE s.status = 'active'
ORDER BY pg.percentage_gain DESC
LIMIT 10;

WITH SectorStocks AS (
    SELECT s.stock_id, s.name, md.volume
    FROM stocks s
    INNER JOIN market_data md ON s.stock_id = md.stock_id
    WHERE s.sector = 'Technology' -- specify the sector of interest
),
AvgVolumeRanked AS (
    SELECT stock_id, name, AVG(volume) AS avg_volume,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY AVG(volume) DESC) AS rank
    FROM SectorStocks
    GROUP BY stock_id, name
)
SELECT name
FROM AvgVolumeRanked
WHERE rank <= 3;

SELECT MAX(adj_close)

WITH ActiveProducts AS (
    SELECT product_id, item_number, price, brand, country_of_origin
    FROM products
    WHERE is_active = 1
),
TopRatedFeedback AS (
    SELECT feedback_id, product_id, customer_id, rating, comments
    FROM customer_feedback
    WHERE rating >= 4
),
RecentPromotions AS (
    SELECT promo_id, product_id, promo_name, discount_percentage
    FROM promotional_events
    WHERE JULIANDAY('now') BETWEEN JULIANDAY(start_date) AND JULIANDAY(end_date)
)
SELECT ap.product_id, ap.item_number, ap.price, fb.rating, fb.comments, rp.discount_percentage
FROM ActiveProducts ap
JOIN TopRatedFeedback fb ON ap.product_id = fb.product_id
JOIN RecentPromotions rp ON ap.product_id = rp.product_id
ORDER BY fb.rating DESC;

SELECT

JOIN 
    customer_feedback cf ON p.product_id = cf.product_id
JOIN 
    promotional_events pe ON p.product_id = pe.product_id
WHERE 
    p.is_active = 1
GROUP BY 
    p.brand
HAVING 
    AVG(cf.rating) > 4;

SELECT product_id, brand, price
FROM products
WHERE is_active = 1
ORDER BY price ASC;

SELECT p.product_id, AVG(cf.rating) AS average_rating
FROM customer_feedback cf
INNER JOIN products p ON cf.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE p.is_active = 1
GROUP BY p.product_id
HAVING AVG(cf.rating) > 4;

WITH RECURSIVE CategoryHierarchy AS (
    SELECT category_id, category_name, parent_category_id, 1 AS level
    FROM product_categories
    WHERE parent_category_id IS NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT pc.category_id, pc.category_name, pc.parent_category_id, ch.level + 1
    FROM product_categories pc
    JOIN CategoryHierarchy ch ON pc.parent_category_id = ch.category_id
),
ProductPromotions AS (
    SELECT p.product_id, p.brand, pe.discount_percentage, pe.start_date, pe.end_date
    FROM products p
    INNER JOIN promotional_events pe ON p.product_id = pe.product_id
    WHERE pe.start_date < DATE('now') AND pe.end_date > DATE('now')
),
RecentFeedbacks AS (
    SELECT cf.product_id, cf.rating, cf.comments
    FROM customer_feedback cf
    WHERE cf.feedback_date >= DATE('now', '-30 days')
),
TopBrands AS (
    SELECT brand, AVG(rating) AS avg_feedback_rating
    FROM products p
    INNER JOIN RecentFeedbacks rf ON p.product_id = rf.product_id
    GROUP BY brand
    ORDER BY avg_feedback_rating DESC
    LIMIT 5
),
SimilarWarehouses AS (
    SELECT warehouse_id, warehouse_name
    FROM warehouses
    WHERE warehouse_name_embedding MATCH '[0.3, 0.4, 0.5, ..., 0.3]'  -- Please replace ... with appropriate values
    ORDER BY distance
    LIMIT 3
)
SELECT pp.product_id, ch.category_name, tb.avg_feedback_rating
FROM ProductPromotions pp
INNER JOIN CategoryHierarchy ch ON pp.product_id = ch.category_id
INNER JOIN TopBrands tb ON pp.brand = tb.brand
ORDER BY tb.avg_feedback_rating DESC;

WITH ActivePromotions AS (
    SELECT p.product_id, pe.promo_name, pe.discount_percentage
    FROM products p
    INNER JOIN promotional_events pe ON p.product_id = pe.product_id
    WHERE p.is_active = 1
),
TopCustomerFeedback AS (
    SELECT cf.product_id, cf.rating, cf.comments
    FROM customer_feedback cf
    WHERE cf.rating = (SELECT MAX(rating) FROM customer_feedback WHERE product_id = cf.product_id)
),
CombinedInfo AS (
    SELECT ap.product_id, ap.promo_name, ap.discount_percentage, cf.rating, cf.comments
    FROM ActivePromotions ap
    INNER JOIN TopCustomerFeedback cf ON ap.product_id = cf.product_id
)
SELECT ci.product_id, ci.promo_name, ci.discount_percentage, ci.rating, ci.comments
FROM CombinedInfo ci
ORDER BY ci.rating DESC, ci.discount_percentage DESC
LIMIT 10;

WITH AverageRatingCTE AS (
    SELECT
        product_id,
        AVG(rating) AS average_rating
    FROM
        customer_feedback
    GROUP BY
        product_id
),
TopRatedProductsCTE AS (
    SELECT
        product_id,
        average_rating,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY average_rating DESC) AS rank
    FROM
        AverageRatingCTE
    WHERE
        average_rating IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT

FROM
    TopRatedProductsCTE t
JOIN
    products p ON t.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE
    t.rank <= 3
ORDER BY
    t.rank;

WITH RecentFeedback AS (
    SELECT cf.product_id, cf.rating, cf.feedback_date,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cf.product_id ORDER BY cf.feedback_date DESC) AS rank
    FROM customer_feedback cf
    WHERE cf.rating >= 4 AND cf.resolved = 1
),
ActivePromotions AS (
    SELECT p.product_id, p.promo_name, p.discount_percentage
    FROM promotional_events p
    WHERE p.start_date <= date('now') AND p.end_date >= date('now')
),
TopRatedFeedback AS (
    SELECT rf.product_id, rf.rating
    FROM RecentFeedback rf
    WHERE rf.rank = 1
)
SELECT ap.promo_name
FROM ActivePromotions ap
INNER JOIN TopRatedFeedback trf ON ap.product_id = trf.product_id
WHERE ap.discount_percentage > 10;

WITH ActiveProducts AS (
    SELECT
        product_id,
        brand,
        price,
        warranty_period,
        is_active
    FROM products
    WHERE is_active = 1
),
TopRatedFeedback AS (
    SELECT 
        cf.feedback_id,
        cf.customer_id,
        cf.product_id,
        cf.rating,
        cf.comments
    FROM customer_feedback cf
    WHERE cf.rating >= 4
),
ProductPromotionDetails AS (
    SELECT 
        pe.product_id,
        pe.promo_name,
        pe.discount_percentage,
        pe.start_date,
        pe.end_date
    FROM promotional_events pe
    WHERE pe.start_date <= DATE('now') AND pe.end_date >= DATE('now')
),
WarehouseLocations AS (
    SELECT
        w.warehouse_id,
        w.warehouse_name,
        w.location,
        w.capacity,
        w.manager_name
    FROM warehouses w
    WHERE w.capacity > 1000
),
KNNWarehouseSearch AS (
    SELECT
        w.rowid AS warehouse_rowid,
        distance,
        w.location
    FROM warehouses_vector_chunks00
    LEFT JOIN warehouses w ON w.rowid = warehouses_vector_chunks00.rowid
    WHERE w.location_embedding MATCH '[0.5, 0.3, 0.8, 0.2, 0.6, 0.2, 0.5, 0.1]' AND k = 5
    ORDER BY distance
)
SELECT 
    ap.product_id,
    ap.brand,
    trf.comments AS top_feedback,
    ppd.promo_name AS current_promotion,
    knnws.location AS nearest_warehouse
FROM ActiveProducts ap
LEFT JOIN TopRatedFeedback trf ON ap.product_id = trf.product_id
LEFT JOIN ProductPromotionDetails ppd ON ap.product_id = ppd.product_id
LEFT JOIN KNNWarehouseSearch knnws ON knnws.warehouse_rowid = ap.product_id
ORDER BY ap.brand, ppd.discount_percentage DESC
LIMIT 10;

WITH ActiveProducts AS (
    SELECT 
        p.product_id,
        p.brand,
        p.price,
        p.warranty_period,
        CAST(p.price AS FLOAT) AS price_float
    FROM 
        products p
    WHERE 
        p.is_active = 1
        AND p.brand = 'SomeBrand'
        AND p.warranty_period > 12
),
PromoDetails AS (
    SELECT 
        ap.product_id,
        pe.promo_id,
        pe.discount_percentage,
        pe.promo_name,
        ap.price_float * (1 - pe.discount_percentage / 100.0) AS discounted_price
    FROM 
        ActiveProducts ap
    JOIN 
        promotional_events pe ON ap.product_id = pe.product_id
    WHERE 
        date('now') BETWEEN pe.start_date AND pe.end_date
),
RankedPromos AS (
    SELECT 
        pd.product_id,
        pd.promo_name,
        pd.discounted_price,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pd.product_id ORDER BY pd.discount_percentage DESC) AS promo_rank
    FROM 
        PromoDetails pd
)
SELECT 
    rp.product_id as ProductID,
    rp.promo_name as PromoName,
    rp.discounted_price as DiscountedPrice
FROM 
    RankedPromos rp
WHERE 
    rp.promo_rank = 1
ORDER BY 
    rp.discounted_price ASC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT 
    p.product_id, 
    COUNT(pe.promo_id) AS active_promotions
FROM 
    products p
INNER JOIN 
    promotional_events pe ON p.product_id = pe.product_id
WHERE 
    DATE('now') BETWEEN pe.start_date AND pe.end_date
GROUP BY 
    p.product_id;

WITH RECURSIVE CategoryHierarchy AS (
    SELECT pc.category_id, pc.category_name, pc.parent_category_id, 1 as level
    FROM product_categories pc
    WHERE pc.parent_category_id IS NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT pc.category_id, pc.category_name, pc.parent_category_id, ch.level + 1
    FROM product_categories pc
    JOIN CategoryHierarchy ch ON pc.parent_category_id = ch.category_id
),
ProductDetails AS (
    SELECT p.product_id, p.brand, p.price, pc.category_name, 
           pe.promo_name, pe.discount_percentage
    FROM products p
    LEFT JOIN product_categories pc ON p.product_id = pc.category_id
    LEFT JOIN promotional_events pe ON p.product_id = pe.product_id
    WHERE p.is_active = 1
),
CustomerFeedbackSummary AS (
    SELECT cf.product_id, AVG(cf.rating) as average_rating, COUNT(cf.feedback_id) as feedback_count
    FROM customer_feedback cf
    WHERE cf.resolved = 1
    GROUP BY cf.product_id
),
SimilarCustomers AS (
    SELECT c.customer_id, c.customer_name, 
           c.address, c.loyalty_points
    FROM customers c
    WHERE c.address_embedding MATCH '[0.1, 0.5, 0.8, 0.3, 0.9, 0.2, 0.1, 0.5]' 
    ORDER BY distance 
    LIMIT 10
)
SELECT pd.product_id, pd.brand, 
       cf.average_rating, cf.feedback_count
FROM ProductDetails pd
LEFT JOIN CustomerFeedbackSummary cf ON pd.product_id = cf.product_id
ORDER BY cf.average_rating DESC;

SELECT AVG(cf.rating) AS average_rating
FROM customer_feedback cf
INNER JOIN products p ON cf.product_id = p.product_id
INNER JOIN customers c ON cf.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE p.is_active = 1
AND p.country_of_origin = 'Japan'
GROUP BY cf.product_id
HAVING AVG(cf.rating) > 3;

WITH ResolvedFeedbackCTE AS (
    SELECT 
        f.product_id,
        AVG(f.rating) AS avg_rating
    FROM customer_feedback f
    WHERE f.resolved = 1
    GROUP BY f.product_id
),
ActivePromotionsCTE AS (
    SELECT 
        p.product_id,
        e.promo_name
    FROM promotional_events e
    INNER JOIN products p ON e.product_id = p.product_id
    WHERE p.is_active = 1 AND DATE(e.end_date) > DATE('now')
),
FilteredProducts AS (
    SELECT 
        p.product_id,
        p.item_number,
        rf.avg_rating,
        ap.promo_name
    FROM products p
    LEFT JOIN ResolvedFeedbackCTE rf ON p.product_id = rf.product_id
    LEFT JOIN ActivePromotionsCTE ap ON p.product_id = ap.product_id
    WHERE rf.avg_rating IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
    fp.item_number,
    fp.avg_rating,
    IFNULL(fp.promo_name, 'No Active Promotion') AS promo_name
FROM FilteredProducts fp
ORDER BY fp.avg_rating DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT p.product_id, AVG(f.rating) AS average_rating
FROM products p
INNER JOIN customer_feedback f ON p.product_id = f.product_id
WHERE f.feedback_date BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-12-31'
  AND f.resolved = 1
GROUP BY p.product_id
HAVING AVG(f.rating) > 3
ORDER BY average_rating DESC
LIMIT 10;

WITH ActiveProducts AS (

        product_id,

        brand,

PromotionalDetails AS (

WITH RECURSIVE CategoryHierarchy AS (
    SELECT pc.category_id, pc.category_name, pc.parent_category_id, 1 AS level
    FROM product_categories pc
    WHERE pc.parent_category_id IS NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT pc.category_id, pc.category_name, pc.parent_category_id, ch.level + 1
    FROM product_categories pc
    JOIN CategoryHierarchy ch ON pc.parent_category_id = ch.category_id
),
RecentPromotions AS (
    SELECT pe.product_id, pe.promo_name, pe.discount_percentage
    FROM promotional_events pe
    WHERE pe.end_date >= date('now', '-30 days')
),
ProductRatings AS (
    SELECT cf.product_id, AVG(cf.rating) AS avg_rating
    FROM customer_feedback cf
    WHERE cf.feedback_date >= date('now', '-180 days')
    AND cf.resolved = 1
    GROUP BY cf.product_id
),
TopRatedProducts AS (
    SELECT pr.product_id, pr.avg_rating
    FROM ProductRatings pr
    WHERE pr.avg_rating >= 4
),
TopPromotedProducts AS (
    SELECT rp.product_id, rp.promo_name
    FROM RecentPromotions rp
    JOIN TopRatedProducts trp ON rp.product_id = trp.product_id
),
ProductDetails AS (
    SELECT p.product_id, p.brand, p.price
    FROM products p
    WHERE p.is_active = 1
    AND p.product_id IN (SELECT product_id FROM TopPromotedProducts)
),
KNNProducts AS (
    SELECT p.product_id, distance
    FROM products p
    WHERE p.brand_embedding MATCH '[0.1, 0.3, 0.5, ...]' -- assuming a 384-dimensional vector
    ORDER BY distance
    LIMIT 5
)
SELECT pd.product_id, pd.brand, pd.price
FROM ProductDetails pd
JOIN KNNProducts kp ON pd.product_id = kp.product_id
ORDER BY pd.price DESC;

TopRatedPromotions AS (

SELECT promo_name, brand, country_of_origin

    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        pc.category_id,

),
ProductPromotions AS (

        p.price,

        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.product_id ORDER BY pe.start_date DESC) AS promo_rank

),

FROM ProductPromotions pp

        AVG(rating) AS avg_rating

    GROUP BY

),
ProductCategoryCTE AS (
    SELECT 
        p.product_id, 
        p.item_number, 
        p.price, 
        p.projection_surface,
        pc.category_name

),

;

),
HighRatedFeedback AS (

),
ProductAnalysis AS (

    JOIN RelevantPromotions rp ON p.product_id = rp.product_id

)

    FROM ProductAnalysis
    GROUP BY product_id
    HAVING average_rating > 4.5
)

FeedbackScores AS (

RankedFeedback AS (

-- CTE to get the top brands based on active products count
WITH TopBrands AS (
    SELECT brand, COUNT(*) AS brand_count
    FROM products
    WHERE is_active = 1
    GROUP BY brand
    ORDER BY brand_count DESC
    LIMIT 5
),
-- CTE to calculate discount impact on product price
DiscountedProducts AS (
    SELECT p.product_id, 
           p.price, 
           CASE 
               WHEN pe.discount_percentage IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(p.price AS FLOAT) * (1 - pe.discount_percentage / 100)
               ELSE CAST(p.price AS FLOAT)
           END AS discounted_price
    FROM products p
    LEFT JOIN promotional_events pe ON p.product_id = pe.product_id
    WHERE pe.start_date <= DATE('now') AND pe.end_date >= DATE('now')
),
-- CTE to get products with active warranties
ActiveWarrantyProducts AS (
    SELECT product_id
    FROM products
    WHERE warranty_period > 12 AND is_active = 1
),
-- Recursive CTE for hierarchical product category analysis
CategoryHierarchy AS (
    SELECT pc.category_id, pc.category_name, pc.parent_category_id, 1 AS level
    FROM product_categories pc
    WHERE pc.parent_category_id IS NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT pc.category_id, pc.category_name, pc.parent_category_id, ch.level + 1
    FROM product_categories pc
    JOIN CategoryHierarchy ch ON pc.parent_category_id = ch.category_id
),
-- Final CTE combining all the above data
FinalProductAnalysis AS (
    SELECT p.product_id, 
           p.brand, 
           dp.discounted_price, 
           tb.brand_count, 
           ch.level AS category_level
    FROM products p
    INNER JOIN DiscountedProducts dp ON p.product_id = dp.product_id
    LEFT JOIN TopBrands tb ON p.brand = tb.brand
    LEFT JOIN ActiveWarrantyProducts awp ON p.product_id = awp.product_id
    LEFT JOIN CategoryHierarchy ch ON p.product_id = ch.category_id
    WHERE awp.product_id IS NOT NULL
)
-- Main query selecting one column from the final analysis
SELECT COUNT(fp.product_id) AS active_discounted_products_with_warranty
FROM FinalProductAnalysis fp;
