        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ct.section_id ORDER BY ct.year_to DESC) as rn
    FROM crop_transitions ct
),
LatestTrendAnalysis AS (
    SELECT 
        ca.section_id,
        ca.crop_code,
        ca.year,
        ca.trend_analysis
    FROM crop_analytics ca
    INNER JOIN (
        SELECT section_id, MAX(year) as max_year
        FROM crop_analytics
        GROUP BY section_id
    ) latest ON ca.section_id = latest.section_id AND ca.year = latest.max_year
)
SELECT 
    RT.section_id
FROM RecentTransitions RT
JOIN LatestTrendAnalysis LTA ON RT.section_id = LTA.section_id
WHERE RT.rn = 1;

WITH LandSectionDetails AS (
    SELECT 
        ls.section_id,
        ls.identifier,
        ls.area_size,
        ls.soil_type,
        COUNT(p.pixel_id) AS total_pixels
    FROM land_sections ls
    INNER JOIN pixels p ON ls.section_id = p.section_id
    GROUP BY ls.section_id
),
CropTransitionDetails AS (
    SELECT
        ct.transition_id,
        ct.section_id,
        ct.area_affected,
        ct.crop_code_from,
        ct.crop_code_to,
        ct.transition_type,
        c.crop_name AS crop_from_name,
        c2.crop_name AS crop_to_name
    FROM crop_transitions ct
    INNER JOIN crops c ON ct.crop_code_from = c.crop_code
    INNER JOIN crops c2 ON ct.crop_code_to = c2.crop_code
),
RecentCropAnalytics AS (
    SELECT
        ca.section_id,
        ca.crop_code,
        ca.year,
        ca.trend_analysis,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ca.section_id ORDER BY ca.year DESC) AS rn
    FROM crop_analytics ca
    WHERE ca.year > 2020
)
SELECT 
    lcd.identifier,
    ctd.crop_from_name || ' to ' || ctd.crop_to_name AS crop_transition
FROM LandSectionDetails lcd
INNER JOIN CropTransitionDetails ctd ON lcd.section_id = ctd.section_id
INNER JOIN RecentCropAnalytics rca ON lcd.section_id = rca.section_id AND rca.rn = 1
WHERE lcd.area_size > 50
ORDER BY lcd.identifier, crop_transition;

SELECT
  ls.identifier AS land_section_identifier,
  ct.transition_type,
  SUM(ct.area_affected) AS total_area_affected
FROM
  crop_transitions ct
INNER JOIN
  land_sections ls ON ct.section_id = ls.section_id
WHERE
  ct.year_from >= 2010 AND ct.year_to <= 2020
GROUP BY
  ls.identifier, ct.transition_type
ORDER BY
  total_area_affected DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT identifier
FROM land_sections
WHERE soil_type = 'Clay'

SELECT 
    ls.section_id,
    ls.identifier,
    SUM(ct.area_affected) AS total_area_affected,
    MAX(ct.year_to) AS most_recent_transition_year
FROM 
    land_sections ls
JOIN 
    crop_transitions ct ON ls.section_id = ct.section_id
JOIN 
    crops c ON ct.crop_code_to = c.crop_code
WHERE 
    ls.soil_type = 'Loam' 
    AND c.crop_name = 'Corn'
GROUP BY 
    ls.section_id, ls.identifier
HAVING 
    total_area_affected > 10
ORDER BY 
    most_recent_transition_year DESC;

WITH RECURSIVE CropTransitionHierarchy AS (
    SELECT 
        ct.transition_id, 
        ct.section_id, 
        ct.year_from, 
        ct.year_to, 
        ct.crop_code_from, 
        ct.crop_code_to, 
        1 AS level
    FROM crop_transitions ct
    WHERE ct.year_from = (SELECT MIN(year_from) FROM crop_transitions)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        ct.transition_id, 
        ct.section_id, 
        ct.year_from, 
        ct.year_to, 
        ct.crop_code_from, 
        ct.crop_code_to, 
        cth.level + 1
    FROM crop_transitions ct
    JOIN CropTransitionHierarchy cth ON ct.year_from = cth.year_to
),
CropAnalytics AS (
    SELECT 
        ca.analytics_id, 
        ca.section_id, 
        ca.crop_code, 
        ca.year,
        ca.trend_analysis,
        ca.prediction_confidence
    FROM crop_analytics ca
    WHERE ca.prediction_confidence > 80
),
CropTransitionAnalysis AS (
    SELECT 
        cth.transition_id, 
        cth.section_id,
        cf.crop_name AS from_crop,
        ct.crop_name AS to_crop,
        cth.level,
        ca.prediction_confidence
    FROM CropTransitionHierarchy cth
    INNER JOIN crops cf ON cth.crop_code_from = cf.crop_code
    INNER JOIN crops ct ON cth.crop_code_to = ct.crop_code
    INNER JOIN CropAnalytics ca ON cth.section_id = ca.section_id AND cth.year_to = ca.year
)
SELECT 
    cta.to_crop
FROM CropTransitionAnalysis cta
WHERE cta.prediction_confidence = (
    SELECT MAX(prediction_confidence) 
    FROM CropTransitionAnalysis
)
ORDER BY cta.level;

WITH CropYieldChange AS (
    SELECT 
        ct.section_id,
        ct.year_from,
        ct.year_to,
        c1.crop_name AS crop_from,
        c2.crop_name AS crop_to,
        c2.yield_per_acre - c1.yield_per_acre AS yield_difference
    FROM 
        crop_transitions ct
    JOIN 
        crops c1 ON ct.crop_code_from = c1.crop_code
    JOIN 
        crops c2 ON ct.crop_code_to = c2.crop_code
),
RankedYieldChanges AS (
    SELECT 
        section_id,
        year_from,
        year_to,
        crop_from,
        crop_to,
        yield_difference,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY section_id ORDER BY yield_difference DESC) AS rank
    FROM 
        CropYieldChange
)
SELECT 
    c.section_id
FROM 
    RankedYieldChanges c
JOIN 
    land_sections ls ON c.section_id = ls.section_id
WHERE 
    c.rank = 1
ORDER BY 
    c.yield_difference DESC;

SELECT 
  l.identifier AS land_section,
  c.crop_name AS initial_crop,
  ct.year_from AS start_year,
  ct.year_to AS end_year,
  COUNT(ct.transition_id) AS transition_count
FROM 
  crop_transitions ct
JOIN 
  crops c ON ct.crop_code_from = c.crop_code
JOIN 
  land_sections l ON ct.section_id = l.section_id
WHERE 
  ct.transition_type = 'rotational' 
  AND ct.year_to > 2010
GROUP BY 
  l.identifier, c.crop_name, ct.year_from, ct.year_to
HAVING 
  transition_count > 5;

SELECT 
  ls.soil_type, 
  AVG(ct.area_affected) AS average_area_affected
FROM 
  land_sections ls
INNER JOIN 
  crop_transitions ct 
ON 
  ls.section_id = ct.section_id
WHERE 
  ct.year_from BETWEEN 2010 AND 2020
GROUP BY 
  ls.soil_type
HAVING 
  AVG(ct.area_affected) > 5

WITH TransitionTrendsCTE AS (
    SELECT
        ct.section_id,
        ls.identifier,
        ls.location_description,
        SUM(ct.area_affected) AS total_area_affected,
        ct.crop_code_from,
        ct.crop_code_to,
        c1.crop_name AS crop_from_name,
        c2.crop_name AS crop_to_name,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ct.section_id ORDER BY SUM(ct.area_affected) DESC) AS area_rank
    FROM
        crop_transitions ct
    INNER JOIN
        crops c1 ON ct.crop_code_from = c1.crop_code
    INNER JOIN
        crops c2 ON ct.crop_code_to = c2.crop_code
    INNER JOIN
        land_sections ls ON ct.section_id = ls.section_id
    GROUP BY
        ct.section_id, ct.crop_code_from, ct.crop_code_to
),
FilteredTransitions AS (
    SELECT
        section_id,
        total_area_affected,
        crop_from_name,
        crop_to_name
    FROM
        TransitionTrendsCTE
    WHERE
        area_rank = 1
)
SELECT
    ft.section_id,
    ft.total_area_affected,
    ft.crop_from_name,
    ft.crop_to_name,
    MIN(dist.distance) AS closest_transition_distance
FROM
    FilteredTransitions ft
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        transition_id,
        distance
    FROM
        crop_transitions
    WHERE
        transition_type_embedding MATCH '[0.5, 0.4, 0.6, 0.3, ..., 0.8]' -- Adjust the vector according to your data
    ORDER BY
        distance
    LIMIT 5
) dist ON dist.transition_id = ft.section_id
GROUP BY
    ft.section_id, ft.total_area_affected, ft.crop_from_name, ft.crop_to_name
ORDER BY
    total_area_affected DESC;

WITH RECURSIVE CropTransitionHierarchy AS (
    SELECT 
        ct.transition_id, 
        ct.section_id, 
        ct.area_affected, 
        ct.year_from, 
        ct.year_to, 
        1 AS level
    FROM crop_transitions ct
    WHERE ct.year_from = (
        SELECT MIN(year_from) FROM crop_transitions
    )
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        ct.transition_id, 
        ct.section_id, 
        ct.area_affected, 
        ct.year_from, 
        ct.year_to, 
        cth.level + 1
    FROM crop_transitions ct
    JOIN CropTransitionHierarchy cth ON ct.year_from = cth.year_to
),
SectionTransitionStats AS (
    SELECT 
        cth.section_id, 
        SUM(cth.area_affected) AS total_area_affected,
        COUNT(cth.transition_id) AS transition_count
    FROM CropTransitionHierarchy cth
    GROUP BY cth.section_id
),
CropAnalyticsSummary AS (
    SELECT 
        ca.section_id,
        AVG(ca.prediction_confidence) AS avg_prediction_confidence,
        COUNT(ca.analytics_id) AS analytics_count
    FROM crop_analytics ca
    GROUP BY ca.section_id
)
SELECT 
    sts.section_id, 
    SUM(sts.total_area_affected) OVER (ORDER BY sts.section_id) AS cumulative_area_affected,
    cas.avg_prediction_confidence
FROM SectionTransitionStats sts
INNER JOIN CropAnalyticsSummary cas ON sts.section_id = cas.section_id
ORDER BY sts.section_id;

WITH RECURSIVE LandSectionHierarchy AS (
    SELECT ls.section_id, ls.identifier, ls.location_description, 1 AS level
    FROM land_sections ls
    WHERE ls.section_id IS NOT NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT ls.section_id, ls.identifier, ls.location_description, lsh.level + 1
    FROM land_sections ls
    JOIN LandSectionHierarchy lsh ON ls.section_id = lsh.section_id
),
TransitionAnalytics AS (
    SELECT 
        ct.transition_id, 
        ct.section_id, 
        ct.year_from, 
        ct.year_to, 
        ca.trend_analysis, 
        ca.prediction_confidence,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ct.section_id ORDER BY ca.prediction_confidence DESC) AS rank
    FROM crop_transitions ct
    INNER JOIN crop_analytics ca ON ct.section_id = ca.section_id AND ct.year_to = ca.year
    WHERE ca.prediction_confidence > 75
),
RankedLandSections AS (
    SELECT ls.section_id, 
        ls.identifier, 
        ls.soil_type, 
        SUM(area_size) OVER (PARTITION BY soil_type ORDER BY section_id) AS cumulative_area
    FROM land_sections ls
    WHERE ls.soil_type IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT TAN.section_id
FROM TransitionAnalytics TAN
INNER JOIN RankedLandSections RLS ON TAN.section_id = RLS.section_id
WHERE TAN.rank = 1
ORDER BY RLS.soil_type, RLS.cumulative_area DESC;

WITH RecentCropsCTE AS (
    SELECT
        ca.section_id,
        ca.crop_code,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ca.section_id ORDER BY ca.year DESC) AS recent_rank
    FROM crop_analytics ca
),
TopCrops AS (
    SELECT
        rc.section_id,
        rc.crop_code
    FROM RecentCropsCTE rc
    WHERE rc.recent_rank = 1
),
LandSectionsWithCrops AS (
    SELECT
        ls.section_id,
        ls.identifier,
        ls.location_description,
        tc.crop_code
    FROM land_sections ls
    INNER JOIN TopCrops tc ON ls.section_id = tc.section_id
    WHERE ls.area_size > 100  -- Example condition for larger land sections
)
SELECT
    lsc.identifier,
    c.crop_name,
    c.growing_season
FROM LandSectionsWithCrops lsc
INNER JOIN crops c ON lsc.crop_code = c.crop_code
WHERE c.yield_per_acre > 50  -- Example condition for high yield crops

WITH TopSections AS (
    SELECT section_id, identifier, area_size 
    FROM land_sections
    WHERE area_size > 50 -- Example condition, adjust as needed
),
MatchedCrops AS (
    SELECT crop_code, crop_name, description
    FROM crops
    WHERE crop_name_embedding MATCH '[0.1, 0.2, 0.3, ..., 0.4]' -- Random vector
    ORDER BY distance
    LIMIT 5
)
SELECT ts.section_id, ts.identifier, mc.crop_name
FROM TopSections ts
JOIN crop_transitions ct ON ts.section_id = ct.section_id
JOIN MatchedCrops mc ON ct.crop_code_to = mc.crop_code
WHERE ct.year_to > 2020 -- Example condition, adjust as needed
ORDER BY ts.area_size DESC, mc.crop_name;

SELECT SUM(ct.area_affected) AS total_affected_area
FROM crop_transitions ct
JOIN crops cf ON ct.crop_code_from = cf.crop_code
JOIN crops ct ON ct.crop_code_to = ct.crop_code
WHERE ct.year_from >= 2008 AND ct.year_to <= 2020
GROUP BY ct.section_id, ct.crop_code_from, ct.crop_code_to
HAVING total_affected_area > 100

SELECT 
    ls.identifier AS section_identifier, 
    AVG(c.yield_per_acre) AS average_yield_per_acre
FROM 
    crop_transitions ct
INNER JOIN 
    crops c ON ct.crop_code_to = c.crop_code
INNER JOIN 
    land_sections ls ON ct.section_id = ls.section_id
WHERE 
    ct.year_to = 2008 -- Specific year for the transition
    AND ct.area_affected > 10 -- Adjust this for significant area affected
GROUP BY 
    ls.identifier
HAVING 
    AVG(c.yield_per_acre) > 1000; -- Filter based on average yield

WITH TransitionSummary AS (
    SELECT
        ct.section_id,
        ct.transition_type,
        AVG(c.yield_per_acre) AS avg_yield_per_acre
    FROM crop_transitions ct
    JOIN crops c ON ct.crop_code_to = c.crop_code
    GROUP BY ct.section_id, ct.transition_type
),
TopTransitions AS (
    SELECT
        section_id,
        transition_type,
        avg_yield_per_acre,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY section_id ORDER BY avg_yield_per_acre DESC) AS rank
    FROM TransitionSummary
)
SELECT
    ts.section_id,
    ls.location_description
FROM TopTransitions ts
JOIN land_sections ls ON ts.section_id = ls.section_id
WHERE ts.rank = 1
ORDER BY ts.section_id;

SELECT crop_code, crop_name, yield_per_acre
FROM crops
WHERE yield_per_acre > 1000; -- Assuming we're interested in crops with yield per acre greater than 1000

SELECT 
    ls.identifier AS section_identifier, 
    c.crop_name AS new_crop_name
FROM 
    crop_transitions ct
INNER JOIN 
    land_sections ls ON ct.section_id = ls.section_id
INNER JOIN 
    crops c ON ct.crop_code_to = c.crop_code
WHERE 
    ct.year_to = (
        SELECT MAX(sub_ct.year_to)
        FROM crop_transitions sub_ct
        WHERE sub_ct.section_id = ct.section_id
    )
GROUP BY 
    ls.section_id, c.crop_name;

WITH CropYield AS (
    SELECT
        ct.section_id,
        ct.crop_code_to,
        ct.area_affected,
        ct.year_to,
        c.yield_per_acre
    FROM crop_transitions ct
    JOIN crops c ON ct.crop_code_to = c.crop_code
),
CropYieldPotential AS (
    SELECT
        section_id,
        crop_code_to,
        area_affected * yield_per_acre AS total_yield,
        year_to
    FROM CropYield
),
TopTransitions AS (
    SELECT
        section_id,
        crop_code_to,
        total_yield,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY section_id ORDER BY total_yield DESC) as rn
    FROM CropYieldPotential
)
SELECT
    lt.identifier AS section_identifier,
    c.crop_name AS new_crop,
    tt.total_yield
FROM TopTransitions tt
JOIN land_sections lt ON tt.section_id = lt.section_id
JOIN crops c ON tt.crop_code_to = c.crop_code
WHERE tt.rn = 1
ORDER BY tt.total_yield DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT 
  ls.identifier AS land_identifier,
  c.crop_name AS previous_crop,
  c_new.crop_name AS new_crop,
  COUNT(ct.transition_id) AS transition_count
FROM 
  crop_transitions ct
INNER JOIN 
  land_sections ls ON ct.section_id = ls.section_id
INNER JOIN 
  crops c ON ct.crop_code_from = c.crop_code
INNER JOIN 
  crops c_new ON ct.crop_code_to = c_new.crop_code
WHERE 
  ct.year_to BETWEEN 2015 AND 2020
GROUP BY 
  ls.identifier, c.crop_name, c_new.crop_name
HAVING 
  COUNT(ct.transition_id) > 1
ORDER BY 
  transition_count DESC;

WITH LandSectionCrop AS (
    SELECT ls.section_id, ls.identifier, ls.location_description, ls.area_size, ct.crop_code_from, ct.crop_code_to
    FROM land_sections ls
    JOIN crop_transitions ct ON ls.section_id = ct.section_id
),
CropAnalyticsDetails AS (
    SELECT ca.section_id, ca.crop_code, ca.trend_analysis, ca.prediction_confidence
    FROM crop_analytics ca
    JOIN LandSectionCrop lsc ON ca.section_id = lsc.section_id
    WHERE ca.year = 2023
),
CropTransitionAnalysis AS (
    SELECT 
        lsc.section_id, 
        lsc.identifier, 
        ca.crop_code, 
        ca.trend_analysis, 
        ca.prediction_confidence,
        LEAD(ca.prediction_confidence, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY lsc.section_id ORDER BY ca.prediction_confidence DESC) AS next_confidence
    FROM LandSectionCrop lsc
    JOIN CropAnalyticsDetails ca ON lsc.section_id = ca.section_id
),
FinalCropAnalysis AS (
    SELECT 
        cta.section_id, 
        cta.identifier,
        CASE 
            WHEN cta.prediction_confidence > cta.next_confidence THEN 'Increasing Confidence'
            ELSE 'Decreasing Confidence'
        END AS confidence_trend
    FROM CropTransitionAnalysis cta
)
SELECT confidence_trend
FROM FinalCropAnalysis
WHERE confidence_trend LIKE '%Confidence%'
ORDER BY confidence_trend;

WITH CropTransitionAnalysis AS (
    SELECT 
        ct.section_id,
        ct.year_from,
        ct.year_to,
        ct.crop_code_from,
        ct.crop_code_to,
        ct.transition_type,
        ls.area_size,
        ls.soil_type,
        ca.trend_analysis_embedding
    FROM
        crop_transitions ct
    INNER JOIN
        land_sections ls ON ct.section_id = ls.section_id
    LEFT JOIN
        crop_analytics ca ON ct.section_id = ca.section_id AND ct.crop_code_to = ca.crop_code
    WHERE
        ct.year_from >= (SELECT MIN(year_name) FROM years)
        AND ct.transition_type = 'rotational'
),
TopTransitions AS (
    SELECT 
        section_id,
        crop_code_to,
        transition_type,
        area_size,
        soil_type,
        trend_analysis_embedding,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY crop_code_to ORDER BY area_size DESC) AS rank
    FROM
        CropTransitionAnalysis
)
SELECT 
    section_id
FROM 
    TopTransitions
WHERE 
    rank <= 3
ORDER BY 
    section_id;

WITH LandSectionDetails AS (
    SELECT 
        ls.section_id,
        ls.identifier,
        ls.location_description,
        ls.area_size,
        ls.soil_type
    FROM land_sections ls
),
CropTransitionDetails AS (
    SELECT 
        ct.section_id,
        ct.year_to AS transition_year,
        ct.area_affected,
        ct.crop_code_to
    FROM crop_transitions ct
    WHERE ct.year_to >= 2000
),
CropYieldDetails AS (
    SELECT 
        c.crop_code,
        c.yield_per_acre
    FROM crops c
),
SectionTransitionYield AS (
    SELECT 
        ltd.section_id,
        ltd.identifier,
        ctd.transition_year,
        ctd.area_affected,
        cyd.yield_per_acre,
        (ctd.area_affected * cyd.yield_per_acre) AS total_yield
    FROM LandSectionDetails ltd
    INNER JOIN CropTransitionDetails ctd ON ltd.section_id = ctd.section_id
    INNER JOIN CropYieldDetails cyd ON ctd.crop_code_to = cyd.crop_code
),
CumulativeYield AS (
    SELECT 
        sty.section_id,
        sty.identifier,
        sty.transition_year,
        SUM(sty.total_yield) OVER (PARTITION BY sty.section_id ORDER BY sty.transition_year) AS cumulative_yield
    FROM SectionTransitionYield sty
)
SELECT 
    cy.identifier,
    cy.transition_year,
    cy.cumulative_yield
FROM CumulativeYield cy
ORDER BY cy.identifier, cy.transition_year;

WITH TransitionDetails AS (
    SELECT 
        ct.transition_id,
        ct.section_id,
        ct.area_affected,
        c.crop_name AS crop_from,
        c2.crop_name AS crop_to,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ct.section_id ORDER BY ct.year_to DESC) AS recent_rank
    FROM crop_transitions ct
    LEFT JOIN crops c ON ct.crop_code_from = c.crop_code
    LEFT JOIN crops c2 ON ct.crop_code_to = c2.crop_code
),
RecentTransitions AS (
    SELECT * 
    FROM TransitionDetails
    WHERE recent_rank = 1
)
SELECT 
    ls.section_id,
    ls.identifier,
    ls.area_size,
    rt.crop_from,
    rt.crop_to
FROM land_sections ls
JOIN RecentTransitions rt ON ls.section_id = rt.section_id
WHERE ls.soil_type = 'Loamy'
AND rt.area_affected > 50
ORDER BY ls.area_size DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT c.crop_name, SUM(ct.area_affected) AS total_area_affected
FROM crops c
INNER JOIN crop_transitions ct ON c.crop_code = ct.crop_code_to
INNER JOIN land_sections ls ON ct.section_id = ls.section_id
WHERE ls.soil_type LIKE '%loam%'
GROUP BY c.crop_name
HAVING total_area_affected > 100
ORDER BY total_area_affected DESC;

WITH TopCropTransitions AS (
    SELECT 
        ct.section_id, 
        ct.transition_id,
        ct.year_to,
        ct.crop_code_to,
        ct.area_affected,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ct.section_id ORDER BY ct.area_affected DESC) AS rank
    FROM crop_transitions ct
    INNER JOIN crops c ON ct.crop_code_to = c.crop_code
    WHERE ct.year_to BETWEEN 2018 AND 2023
),
TopAnalytics AS (
    SELECT 
        ca.analytics_id,
        ca.section_id,
        ca.crop_code,
        ca.prediction_confidence,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ca.section_id ORDER BY ca.prediction_confidence DESC) AS analytics_rank
    FROM crop_analytics ca
    WHERE ca.year BETWEEN 2018 AND 2023
)
SELECT ta.prediction_confidence
FROM TopCropTransitions tct
JOIN TopAnalytics ta ON tct.section_id = ta.section_id AND tct.crop_code_to = ta.crop_code
WHERE tct.rank = 1 AND ta.analytics_rank = 1;

SELECT 
  ls.identifier AS land_section_identifier,
  ls.soil_type,
  AVG(c.yield_per_acre) AS average_yield_per_acre
FROM 
  land_sections ls
INNER JOIN 
  crop_transitions ct ON ls.section_id = ct.section_id
INNER JOIN 
  crops c ON ct.crop_code_to = c.crop_code
WHERE 
  ct.year_to BETWEEN 2015 AND 2020
GROUP BY 
  ls.identifier, ls.soil_type
HAVING 
  AVG(c.yield_per_acre) > (
    SELECT AVG(yield_per_acre) 
    FROM crops
  )
ORDER BY 
  average_yield_per_acre DESC
LIMIT 5;

WITH LandSectionDetails AS (
    SELECT
        ls.section_id,
        ls.identifier,
        ls.area_size,
        ls.soil_type
    FROM land_sections ls
),
CropTransitionSummary AS (
    SELECT
        ct.section_id,
        c_from.crop_name AS crop_from,
        c_to.crop_name AS crop_to,
        ct.year_from,
        ct.year_to,
        ct.area_affected,
        ct.transition_type
    FROM crop_transitions ct
    JOIN crops c_from ON ct.crop_code_from = c_from.crop_code
    JOIN crops c_to ON ct.crop_code_to = c_to.crop_code
),
SectionAnalytics AS (
    SELECT
        ca.section_id,
        ca.year,
        ca.prediction_confidence,
        ca.trend_analysis
    FROM crop_analytics ca
)
SELECT
    ls.identifier,
    ca.trend_analysis,
    SUM(ct.area_affected) OVER (PARTITION BY ls.section_id) AS total_area_affected
FROM LandSectionDetails ls
JOIN CropTransitionSummary ct ON ls.section_id = ct.section_id
JOIN SectionAnalytics ca ON ls.section_id = ca.section_id AND ct.year_to = ca.year
ORDER BY ls.identifier, total_area_affected DESC;

SELECT identifier
  FROM land_sections
  WHERE soil_type = 'Loamy'
  ORDER BY section_id;

WITH DistanceOnlyInstitutions AS (
    SELECT institution_id
    FROM admissions
    WHERE distance_only = 1
),
InstitutionAnalysis AS (
    SELECT 
        a.institution_id,
        CASE
            WHEN CAST(fo.graduation_rate AS FLOAT) > 0.75 THEN 'High Graduation Rate'
            ELSE 'Low Graduation Rate'
        END AS graduation_category,
        AVG(CAST(sd.pct_female AS FLOAT)) AS avg_pct_female
    FROM DistanceOnlyInstitutions doi
    JOIN admissions a ON doi.institution_id = a.institution_id
    JOIN student_demographics sd ON a.institution_id = sd.institution_id
    JOIN financial_outcomes fo ON a.institution_id = fo.institution_id
    GROUP BY a.institution_id, graduation_category
    HAVING AVG(CAST(sd.pct_female AS FLOAT)) > 0.5
)
SELECT graduation_category
FROM InstitutionAnalysis
WHERE avg_pct_female > 0.6;

WITH earnings_vs_tuition AS (
    SELECT 
        fo.institution_id,
        fo.median_earnings_10_years,
        fo.tuition_fee,
        (fo.median_earnings_10_years * 1.0 / fo.tuition_fee) AS earnings_to_tuition_ratio
    FROM financial_outcomes fo
),
high_earning_institutions AS (
    SELECT institution_id
    FROM earnings_vs_tuition
    WHERE earnings_to_tuition_ratio > (
        SELECT AVG(earnings_to_tuition_ratio) FROM earnings_vs_tuition
    )
),
student_aid_summary AS (
    SELECT 
        fa.institution_id,
        fa.pct_pell_grant,
        fa.pct_federal_loan,
        sd.pct_students_over_25,
        sd.pct_female
    FROM financial_aid fa
    JOIN student_demographics sd ON fa.institution_id = sd.institution_id
),
institution_analysis AS (
    SELECT 
        hai.institution_id,
        sa.pct_pell_grant,
        sa.pct_federal_loan,
        sa.pct_students_over_25,
        sa.pct_female
    FROM high_earning_institutions hai
    INNER JOIN student_aid_summary sa ON hai.institution_id = sa.institution_id
),
final_selection AS (
    SELECT 
        ia.institution_id,
        ia.pct_pell_grant,
        ia.pct_federal_loan,
        ia.pct_students_over_25,
        ia.pct_female,
        go.employment_rate
    FROM institution_analysis ia
    JOIN graduate_outcomes go ON ia.institution_id = go.institution_id
)
SELECT institution_id
FROM final_selection
WHERE employment_rate > '0.85'
ORDER BY pct_pell_grant DESC, pct_federal_loan DESC;

WITH InstitutionEarnings AS (
    SELECT
        f.institution_id,
        f.median_earnings_10_years,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY f.median_earnings_10_years DESC) AS earnings_rank
    FROM
        financial_outcomes f
),
InstitutionDetails AS (
    SELECT
        ie.institution_id,
        sd.pct_female,
        sd.pct_male,
        fa.avg_scholarship_amount
    FROM
        InstitutionEarnings ie
    JOIN student_demographics sd ON ie.institution_id = sd.institution_id
    JOIN financial_aid fa ON ie.institution_id = fa.institution_id
    WHERE ie.earnings_rank <= 10
)
SELECT
    id.institution_id
FROM
    InstitutionDetails id
WHERE
    id.avg_scholarship_amount > 3000;

WITH HighEarningsInstitutions AS (
    SELECT f.institution_id, f.median_earnings_10_years, f.graduation_rate
    FROM financial_outcomes f
    WHERE CAST(f.graduation_rate AS REAL) > 0.75
),
StudentDiversity AS (
    SELECT d.institution_id, 
           CAST(d.pct_two_or_more_races AS REAL) + 
           CAST(d.pct_non_resident_alien AS REAL) + 
           CAST(d.pct_unknown AS REAL) AS diversity_score
    FROM student_demographics d
),
SelectedInstitutions AS (
    SELECT h.institution_id, h.median_earnings_10_years, s.diversity_score
    FROM HighEarningsInstitutions h
    JOIN StudentDiversity s ON h.institution_id = s.institution_id
    WHERE s.diversity_score > 0.1
)
SELECT a.institution_id, si.median_earnings_10_years
FROM SelectedInstitutions si
JOIN admissions a ON si.institution_id = a.institution_id
WHERE CAST(a.acceptance_rate AS REAL) < 0.7;

WITH CropTransitionDetails AS (
    SELECT
        ct.transition_id,
        ls.identifier AS land_identifier,
        c1.crop_name AS crop_from,
        c2.crop_name AS crop_to,
        ct.year_from,
        ct.year_to
    FROM crop_transitions ct
    INNER JOIN land_sections ls ON ct.section_id = ls.section_id
    INNER JOIN crops c1 ON ct.crop_code_from = c1.crop_code
    INNER JOIN crops c2 ON ct.crop_code_to = c2.crop_code
),
PopularTransitions AS (
    SELECT
        crop_from,
        crop_to,
        COUNT(*) AS transition_count
    FROM CropTransitionDetails
    GROUP BY crop_from, crop_to
    ORDER BY transition_count DESC
    LIMIT 5
),
UserAccessPatterns AS (
    SELECT
        u.user_name,
        u.role,
        a.access_type,
        JULIANDAY(a.access_date) AS julian_access_date
    FROM access_logs a
    INNER JOIN users u ON a.user_id = u.user_id
    WHERE julianday(a.access_date) > julianday('2023-01-01')
)
SELECT
    pt.crop_from,
    pt.crop_to,
    pt.transition_count,
    uap.user_name || '(' || uap.role || ')' AS user_role_access
FROM PopularTransitions pt
INNER JOIN UserAccessPatterns uap ON pt.crop_from = uap.access_type
ORDER BY pt.transition_count DESC, uap.julian_access_date ASC;

WITH HighEarningInstitutions AS (
    SELECT
        fo.institution_id,
        fo.median_earnings_10_years,
        fo.graduation_rate
    FROM
        financial_outcomes fo
    WHERE
        fo.median_earnings_10_years > 45000
        AND CAST(fo.graduation_rate AS FLOAT) > 0.7
),
Demographics AS (
    SELECT
        sd.institution_id,
        CAST(sd.pct_female AS FLOAT) AS pct_female,
        CAST(sd.pct_students_over_25 AS FLOAT) AS pct_students_over_25
    FROM
        student_demographics sd
),
FilteredInstitutions AS (
    SELECT
        hei.institution_id,
        hei.median_earnings_10_years + (CAST(hei.graduation_rate AS FLOAT) * 1000) AS score
    FROM
        HighEarningInstitutions hei
    JOIN
        Demographics d ON hei.institution_id = d.institution_id
    WHERE
        d.pct_female > 0.5
        AND d.pct_students_over_25 < 0.3
)
SELECT
    fi.institution_id,
    fi.score
FROM
    FilteredInstitutions fi
ORDER BY
    fi.score DESC;

SELECT c.crop_name
FROM land_sections ls
INNER JOIN crop_transitions ct ON ls.section_id = ct.section_id
INNER JOIN crops c ON ct.crop_code_to = c.crop_code
WHERE ls.section_id = 1
GROUP BY c.crop_name
ORDER BY MAX(c.yield_per_acre) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT fi.median_earnings_10_years
FROM admissions AS ad
INNER JOIN financial_outcomes AS fi ON ad.institution_id = fi.institution_id
INNER JOIN financial_aid AS fa ON ad.institution_id = fa.institution_id
WHERE ad.distance_only = 0 
  AND fa.avg_scholarship_amount > 4000
GROUP BY fi.median_earnings_10_years
HAVING AVG(fi.median_earnings_10_years) > 40000;

SELECT go.median_earnings_10_years
FROM graduate_outcomes go
INNER JOIN admissions a ON go.institution_id = a.institution_id
WHERE CAST(a.acceptance_rate AS FLOAT) < 0.70
  AND CAST(go.employment_rate AS FLOAT) > 0.85;

WITH CTE_Admissions AS (
    SELECT institution_id, 
           sat_verbal_mid + sat_math_mid AS sat_total,
           CAST(acceptance_rate AS REAL) AS acceptance_rate_real
    FROM admissions
    WHERE distance_only = 0
),
CTE_FinancialAid AS (
    SELECT institution_id, 
           CAST(pct_pell_grant AS REAL) AS pell_grant_rate,
           CAST(pct_federal_loan AS REAL) AS federal_loan_rate,
           avg_scholarship_amount
    FROM financial_aid
),
CTE_StudentDemographics AS (
    SELECT institution_id, 
           CAST(pct_pell_grant AS REAL) AS demo_pell_grant_rate,
           CAST(pct_federal_loan AS REAL) AS demo_federal_loan_rate,
           CAST(pct_female AS REAL) as female_rate
    FROM student_demographics
),
CTE_FinancialOutcomes AS (
    SELECT institution_id,
           median_earnings_10_years,
           CAST(graduation_rate AS REAL) AS graduation_rate_real
    FROM financial_outcomes
    WHERE tuition_fee > 30000
)
SELECT CTE_Admissions.institution_id
FROM CTE_Admissions
JOIN CTE_FinancialAid ON CTE_Admissions.institution_id = CTE_FinancialAid.institution_id
JOIN CTE_StudentDemographics ON CTE_Admissions.institution_id = CTE_StudentDemographics.institution_id
JOIN CTE_FinancialOutcomes ON CTE_Admissions.institution_id = CTE_FinancialOutcomes.institution_id
WHERE CTE_Admissions.acceptance_rate_real < 0.75
  AND CTE_FinancialAid.pell_grant_rate > 0.25
  AND CTE_StudentDemographics.female_rate > 0.5
  AND CTE_FinancialOutcomes.graduation_rate_real > 0.7
ORDER BY CTE_FinancialOutcomes.median_earnings_10_years DESC;

WITH EarningsAndDebt AS (
    SELECT 
        fo.institution_id,
        fo.median_earnings_10_years,
        fo.median_debt,
        (fo.median_earnings_10_years - fo.median_debt) AS earnings_to_debt_ratio
    FROM financial_outcomes fo
),
DiversityIndex AS (
    SELECT 
        sd.institution_id,
        (CAST(sd.pct_two_or_more_races AS REAL) + CAST(sd.pct_non_resident_alien AS REAL) + CAST(sd.pct_unknown AS REAL)) AS diversity_score
    FROM student_demographics sd
),
FinancialAidImpact AS (
    SELECT 
        fa.institution_id,
        (CAST(fa.pct_pell_grant AS REAL) * fa.avg_scholarship_amount) AS aid_impact_score
    FROM financial_aid fa
),
FinalIndex AS (
    SELECT 
        ead.institution_id,
        ead.earnings_to_debt_ratio,
        di.diversity_score,
        fai.aid_impact_score,
        (ead.earnings_to_debt_ratio + di.diversity_score + fai.aid_impact_score) AS final_index
    FROM EarningsAndDebt ead
    JOIN DiversityIndex di ON ead.institution_id = di.institution_id
    JOIN FinancialAidImpact fai ON ead.institution_id = fai.institution_id
)
SELECT 
    institution_id,
    final_index
FROM FinalIndex
ORDER BY final_index DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH FinancialAidCTE AS (
    SELECT institution_id, CAST(pct_pell_grant AS REAL) AS pell_grant_rate, avg_scholarship_amount
    FROM financial_aid
),
DemographicsCTE AS (
    SELECT institution_id, CAST(pct_female AS REAL) AS female_rate, CAST(pct_students_over_25 AS REAL) AS over_25_rate
    FROM student_demographics
),
GraduateOutcomesCTE AS (
    SELECT institution_id, employment_rate, median_earnings_10_years
    FROM graduate_outcomes
),
AdmissionsCTE AS (
    SELECT institution_id, acceptance_rate
    FROM admissions
    WHERE CAST(acceptance_rate AS REAL) < 0.5
),
RankedInstitutions AS (
    SELECT 
        fa.institution_id,
        fa.pell_grant_rate,
        fa.avg_scholarship_amount,
        d.female_rate,
        d.over_25_rate,
        go.employment_rate,
        go.median_earnings_10_years,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY go.median_earnings_10_years DESC) AS earnings_rank
    FROM FinancialAidCTE fa
    JOIN DemographicsCTE d ON fa.institution_id = d.institution_id
    JOIN GraduateOutcomesCTE go ON fa.institution_id = go.institution_id
    JOIN AdmissionsCTE a ON fa.institution_id = a.institution_id
)
SELECT institution_id, employment_rate
FROM RankedInstitutions
WHERE earnings_rank <= 5;

WITH CTE_Admissions AS (
    SELECT institution_id, 
           CAST(acceptance_rate AS FLOAT) AS acceptance_rate_num, 
           application_deadline
    FROM admissions
    WHERE application_deadline >= '2023-01-15'
),
CTE_Financial AS (
    SELECT institution_id, 
           tuition_fee, 
           AVG(median_earnings_10_years) OVER () AS avg_earnings
    FROM financial_outcomes
    WHERE median_earnings_10_years > 40000
),
CTE_Graduate AS (
    SELECT institution_id, 
           CAST(employment_rate AS FLOAT) AS employment_rate_num
    FROM graduate_outcomes
    WHERE employment_rate >= '0.85'
)
SELECT fa.institution_id, 
       (fa.tuition_fee / fa.avg_earnings) AS tuition_to_earnings_ratio
FROM CTE_Financial AS fa
JOIN CTE_Admissions AS ad ON fa.institution_id = ad.institution_id
JOIN CTE_Graduate AS gr ON fa.institution_id = gr.institution_id
WHERE ad.acceptance_rate_num < 0.70
ORDER BY tuition_to_earnings_ratio;

WITH StudentAid AS (
    SELECT 
        sd.institution_id,
        CAST(sd.pct_pell_grant AS REAL) AS pell_grant_pct,
        CAST(sd.pct_federal_loan AS REAL) AS federal_loan_pct
    FROM student_demographics sd
    WHERE CAST(sd.pct_pell_grant AS REAL) > 0.25
),
FinancialPerformance AS (
    SELECT 
        fo.institution_id,
        fo.median_earnings_10_years,
        fo.median_debt,
        CAST(fo.graduation_rate AS REAL) AS graduation_rate
    FROM financial_outcomes fo
),
EarningsAnalysis AS (
    SELECT 
        sa.institution_id,
        fp.median_earnings_10_years,
        sa.pell_grant_pct
    FROM StudentAid sa
    JOIN FinancialPerformance fp ON sa.institution_id = fp.institution_id
    WHERE fp.median_earnings_10_years > 40000
)
SELECT 
    ea.institution_id,
    ROUND(ea.median_earnings_10_years * (1 - ea.pell_grant_pct), 2) AS adjusted_earnings
FROM EarningsAnalysis ea
ORDER BY adjusted_earnings DESC;

SELECT fo.institution_id, fo.median_earnings_10_years
FROM financial_outcomes fo
INNER JOIN student_demographics sd ON fo.institution_id = sd.institution_id
WHERE fo.graduation_rate > 0.7 
  AND sd.pct_federal_loan < 0.65;

SELECT institution_id, median_earnings_10_years, graduation_rate
FROM financial_outcomes
WHERE median_earnings_10_years > 40000
ORDER BY graduation_rate DESC;

WITH InstitutionFinancials AS (
    SELECT fo.institution_id, 
           CAST(fo.graduation_rate AS FLOAT) AS graduation_rate, 
           CAST(sd.pct_pell_grant AS FLOAT) AS pct_pell_grant
    FROM financial_outcomes fo
    JOIN student_demographics sd ON fo.institution_id = sd.institution_id
    WHERE CAST(fo.graduation_rate AS FLOAT) > 0.75
      AND CAST(sd.pct_pell_grant AS FLOAT) > 0.28
),
TopPerformingInstitutions AS (
    SELECT institution_id
    FROM InstitutionFinancials
    WHERE graduation_rate > 0.8
),
CombinedStats AS (
    SELECT sd.institution_id,
           sd.pct_two_or_more_races,
           sd.pct_non_resident_alien,
           sd.pct_students_over_25,
           fo.median_earnings_10_years,
           fa.avg_scholarship_amount
    FROM student_demographics sd
    JOIN financial_outcomes fo ON sd.institution_id = fo.institution_id
    JOIN financial_aid fa ON sd.institution_id = fa.institution_id
    WHERE sd.institution_id IN (SELECT institution_id FROM TopPerformingInstitutions)
),
AggregatedResults AS (
    SELECT institution_id,
           AVG(CAST(pct_two_or_more_races AS FLOAT)) AS avg_pct_two_or_more_races,
           AVG(CAST(pct_non_resident_alien AS FLOAT)) AS avg_pct_non_resident_alien,
           AVG(CAST(pct_students_over_25 AS FLOAT)) AS avg_pct_students_over_25,
           AVG(median_earnings_10_years) AS avg_median_earnings_10_years,
           AVG(avg_scholarship_amount) AS avg_avg_scholarship_amount
    FROM CombinedStats
    GROUP BY institution_id
)
SELECT institution_id
FROM AggregatedResults
WHERE avg_median_earnings_10_years > 45000
ORDER BY avg_avg_scholarship_amount DESC;

WITH FinancialAidCTE AS (
    SELECT institution_id, 
           CAST(pct_pell_grant AS REAL) AS pct_pell_grant,
           CAST(pct_federal_loan AS REAL) AS pct_federal_loan,
           avg_scholarship_amount
    FROM financial_aid
    WHERE CAST(pct_pell_grant AS REAL) > 0.25 AND CAST(pct_federal_loan AS REAL) > 0.6
),
GraduateOutcomesCTE AS (
    SELECT institution_id, 
           median_earnings_10_years, 
           employment_rate
    FROM graduate_outcomes
    WHERE employment_rate > '0.85'
),
HighGradRateInstitutions AS (
    SELECT institution_id, 
           CAST(graduation_rate AS REAL) AS graduation_rate
    FROM financial_outcomes
    WHERE CAST(graduation_rate AS REAL) > 0.7
)
SELECT fa.institution_id, 
       fa.avg_scholarship_amount, 
       go.median_earnings_10_years
FROM FinancialAidCTE fa
JOIN GraduateOutcomesCTE go ON fa.institution_id = go.institution_id
JOIN HighGradRateInstitutions hg ON fa.institution_id = hg.institution_id
ORDER BY go.median_earnings_10_years DESC

SELECT 
  f.institution_id, 
  AVG(f.median_earnings_10_years) AS average_median_earnings
FROM 
  financial_outcomes f
INNER JOIN 
  student_demographics s ON f.institution_id = s.institution_id
WHERE 
  CAST(f.graduation_rate AS REAL) > 0.70 
  AND CAST(s.pct_pell_grant AS REAL) >= 0.294
GROUP BY 
  f.institution_id;

WITH EligibleInstitutions AS (
    SELECT 
        fa.institution_id,
        fa.pct_federal_loan,
        fa.pct_pell_grant,
        fo.median_earnings_10_years
    FROM 
        financial_aid fa
    INNER JOIN 
        financial_outcomes fo ON fa.institution_id = fo.institution_id
    WHERE 
        CAST(fa.pct_federal_loan AS REAL) > 0.6 
        AND CAST(fa.pct_pell_grant AS REAL) > 0.25
),
RankedInstitutions AS (
    SELECT 
        institution_id,
        median_earnings_10_years,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY median_earnings_10_years DESC) AS rank
    FROM 
        EligibleInstitutions
)
SELECT 
    institution_id
FROM 
    RankedInstitutions
WHERE 
    rank = 1;

SELECT a.institution_id, fo.graduation_rate
FROM admissions a
INNER JOIN financial_outcomes fo ON a.institution_id = fo.institution_id
WHERE CAST(a.acceptance_rate AS REAL) > 0.6
AND CAST(fo.median_earnings_10_years AS REAL) > 40000
GROUP BY a.institution_id, fo.graduation_rate
HAVING AVG(CAST(fo.median_earnings_10_years AS REAL)) > 42000;

SELECT fo.institution_id, fo.graduation_rate
FROM financial_outcomes fo
JOIN graduate_outcomes go ON fo.institution_id = go.institution_id
WHERE CAST(fo.graduation_rate AS REAL) > 0.75
AND CAST(go.employment_rate AS REAL) > 0.85;

SELECT 
  a.institution_id, 
  g.median_earnings_10_years
FROM 
  admissions a
JOIN
  student_demographics s ON a.institution_id = s.institution_id
JOIN
  graduate_outcomes g ON a.institution_id = g.institution_id
WHERE 
  CAST(s.pct_pell_grant AS FLOAT) > 0.25
ORDER BY 
  g.median_earnings_10_years DESC;

WITH EarningsAndDebtCTE AS (
    SELECT 
        fo.institution_id,
        fo.median_earnings_10_years,
        fo.median_debt
    FROM financial_outcomes fo
    WHERE fo.median_earnings_10_years > 50000 AND fo.median_debt < 30000
),
DemographicsCTE AS (
    SELECT 
        sd.institution_id,
        CAST(sd.pct_two_or_more_races AS REAL) AS pct_two_or_more_races,
        CAST(sd.pct_non_resident_alien AS REAL) AS pct_non_resident_alien
    FROM student_demographics sd
    WHERE CAST(sd.pct_two_or_more_races AS REAL) > 0.05 OR CAST(sd.pct_non_resident_alien AS REAL) > 0.05
)
SELECT 
    ead.institution_id,
    (ead.median_earnings_10_years - ead.median_debt) AS net_earnings_after_debt
FROM EarningsAndDebtCTE ead
INNER JOIN DemographicsCTE dc ON ead.institution_id = dc.institution_id
ORDER BY net_earnings_after_debt DESC;

WITH EarningsCTE AS (
    SELECT institution_id, median_earnings_10_years
    FROM graduate_outcomes
    WHERE median_earnings_10_years > (
        SELECT AVG(median_earnings_10_years)
        FROM graduate_outcomes
        WHERE employment_rate > '0.85'
    )
),
DistanceOnlyInstitutions AS (
    SELECT institution_id
    FROM admissions
    WHERE distance_only = 1 AND acceptance_rate > '0.70'
)
SELECT e.institution_id
FROM EarningsCTE e
JOIN DistanceOnlyInstitutions d ON e.institution_id = d.institution_id
ORDER BY e.median_earnings_10_years DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT a.institution_id, AVG(f.avg_scholarship_amount) AS average_scholarship_amount
FROM admissions a
INNER JOIN financial_aid f ON a.institution_id = f.institution_id
WHERE a.sat_verbal_mid > 550
GROUP BY a.institution_id;

WITH PellGrantInstitutions AS (
    SELECT
        fa.institution_id,
        st.pct_pell_grant,
        st.pct_federal_loan
    FROM student_demographics st
    INNER JOIN financial_aid fa ON st.institution_id = fa.institution_id
    WHERE CAST(st.pct_pell_grant AS REAL) > 0.25
),
HighEarningsInstitutions AS (
    SELECT
        fo.institution_id,
        fo.median_earnings_10_years,
        fo.graduation_rate
    FROM financial_outcomes fo
    WHERE fo.median_earnings_10_years > 47000
),
FilteredInstitutions AS (
    SELECT
        pg.institution_id,
        pg.pct_pell_grant,
        pg.pct_federal_loan,
        he.median_earnings_10_years,
        he.graduation_rate
    FROM PellGrantInstitutions pg
    INNER JOIN HighEarningsInstitutions he ON pg.institution_id = he.institution_id
)
SELECT
    fi.institution_id,
    AVG(CAST(fi.pct_pell_grant AS REAL) + CAST(fi.pct_federal_loan AS REAL)) AS avg_aid_percentage,
    fi.median_earnings_10_years
FROM FilteredInstitutions fi
GROUP BY fi.institution_id
HAVING AVG(CAST(fi.pct_pell_grant AS REAL) + CAST(fi.pct_federal_loan AS REAL)) > 0.5
ORDER BY fi.median_earnings_10_years DESC;

WITH CTE_FinancialOutcomes AS (
    SELECT 
        fo.institution_id,
        CAST(fo.median_earnings_10_years AS REAL) / fo.median_debt AS earnings_to_debt_ratio
    FROM 
        financial_outcomes fo
    WHERE 
        fo.median_earnings_10_years > 40000
    AND 
        fo.median_debt < 25000
),
CTE_GraduateOutcomes AS (
    SELECT 
        go.institution_id,
        CAST(go.median_earnings_10_years AS REAL) / go.median_debt AS graduate_earnings_to_debt_ratio,
        CAST(go.employment_rate AS REAL) AS employment_rate_numeric
    FROM 
        graduate_outcomes go
    WHERE
        employment_rate > '0.8'
),
CTE_FinancialAid AS (
    SELECT 
        fa.institution_id,
        CAST(fa.avg_scholarship_amount AS REAL) / (CAST(fa.pct_pell_grant AS REAL) + CAST(fa.pct_federal_loan AS REAL)) AS scholarship_to_aid_ratio
    FROM 
        financial_aid fa
),
CTE_JoinResults AS (
    SELECT 
        fo.institution_id,
        fo.earnings_to_debt_ratio,
        go.graduate_earnings_to_debt_ratio,
        go.employment_rate_numeric,
        fa.scholarship_to_aid_ratio
    FROM 
        CTE_FinancialOutcomes fo
    INNER JOIN 
        CTE_GraduateOutcomes go ON fo.institution_id = go.institution_id
    INNER JOIN
        CTE_FinancialAid fa ON fo.institution_id = fa.institution_id
)
SELECT 
    AVG(earnings_to_debt_ratio * graduate_earnings_to_debt_ratio * employment_rate_numeric * scholarship_to_aid_ratio) AS combined_metric
FROM 
    CTE_JoinResults
WHERE
    scholarship_to_aid_ratio > 1000;

WITH HighEarningsInstitutions AS (
    SELECT institution_id, median_earnings_10_years, graduation_rate
    FROM financial_outcomes
    WHERE median_earnings_10_years > 45000 AND CAST(graduation_rate AS REAL) > 0.75
),
AdmissionsCriteria AS (
    SELECT institution_id, acceptance_rate, distance_only
    FROM admissions
    WHERE CAST(acceptance_rate AS REAL) < 0.70 AND distance_only = 0
)
SELECT he.institution_id, he.median_earnings_10_years, ac.acceptance_rate
FROM HighEarningsInstitutions he
INNER JOIN AdmissionsCriteria ac ON he.institution_id = ac.institution_id;

SELECT MIN(tuition_fee) AS minimum_tuition_fee
FROM financial_outcomes;

SELECT a.institution_id
FROM admissions a
INNER JOIN student_demographics sd ON a.institution_id = sd.institution_id
INNER JOIN financial_outcomes fo ON a.institution_id = fo.institution_id
WHERE sd.pct_pell_grant > '0.25' AND fo.graduation_rate > '0.70'
GROUP BY a.institution_id
HAVING AVG(fo.median_earnings_10_years) > 40000;

SELECT a.institution_id
FROM admissions a
INNER JOIN financial_outcomes f ON a.institution_id = f.institution_id
WHERE a.distance_only = 1
  AND a.acceptance_rate > '0.7'
  AND f.median_earnings_10_years = (
    SELECT MAX(median_earnings_10_years)
    FROM financial_outcomes
  );

WITH DistanceEducationInstitutions AS (
    SELECT institution_id, sat_verbal_mid, sat_math_mid, acceptance_rate
    FROM admissions
    WHERE distance_only = 1
),
FinancialAidSummary AS (
    SELECT f.institution_id, 
           (CAST(fa.pct_pell_grant AS REAL) + CAST(fa.pct_federal_loan AS REAL)) / 2 AS avg_financial_aid_pct
    FROM financial_outcomes f
    INNER JOIN financial_aid fa ON f.institution_id = fa.institution_id
),
GraduatePerformance AS (
    SELECT g.institution_id, g.median_earnings_10_years, g.employment_rate, 
           RANK() OVER (ORDER BY g.median_earnings_10_years DESC) AS earnings_rank
    FROM graduate_outcomes g
)
SELECT d.institution_id, d.sat_verbal_mid, f.avg_financial_aid_pct, g.earnings_rank
FROM DistanceEducationInstitutions d
INNER JOIN FinancialAidSummary f ON d.institution_id = f.institution_id
INNER JOIN GraduatePerformance g ON d.institution_id = g.institution_id
WHERE g.employment_rate > '0.8'
ORDER BY g.earnings_rank, f.avg_financial_aid_pct DESC;

WITH HighEmployment AS (
    SELECT institution_id, median_earnings_10_years, employment_rate, median_debt
    FROM graduate_outcomes
    WHERE CAST(employment_rate AS REAL) > 0.85
),
LowDebtInstitutions AS (
    SELECT institution_id, median_debt
    FROM financial_outcomes
    WHERE median_debt < 23000
),
NonDistanceInstitutions AS (
    SELECT institution_id
    FROM admissions
    WHERE distance_only = 0
)
SELECT HE.median_earnings_10_years
FROM HighEmployment HE
JOIN LowDebtInstitutions LD ON HE.institution_id = LD.institution_id
JOIN NonDistanceInstitutions ND ON HE.institution_id = ND.institution_id;

WITH AdmissionsData AS (
    SELECT institution_id, acceptance_rate, sat_verbal_mid + sat_math_mid AS sat_total
    FROM admissions
    WHERE acceptance_rate < '0.7'
),
FinancialOutcomesData AS (
    SELECT institution_id, median_earnings_10_years, median_debt
    FROM financial_outcomes
    WHERE tuition_fee < 40000
),
StudentDemographicsData AS (
    SELECT institution_id, CAST(pct_pell_grant AS FLOAT) AS pct_pell_grant
    FROM student_demographics
    WHERE CAST(pct_female AS FLOAT) > 0.5
),
CombinedData AS (
    SELECT ad.institution_id,
           fo.median_earnings_10_years,
           sd.pct_pell_grant
    FROM AdmissionsData ad
    JOIN FinancialOutcomesData fo ON ad.institution_id = fo.institution_id
    JOIN StudentDemographicsData sd ON ad.institution_id = sd.institution_id
),
RankedInstitutions AS (
    SELECT institution_id,
           median_earnings_10_years,
           RANK() OVER (ORDER BY median_earnings_10_years DESC) AS earnings_rank,
           pct_pell_grant
    FROM CombinedData
)
SELECT institution_id, earnings_rank
FROM RankedInstitutions
WHERE pct_pell_grant > 0.3
ORDER BY earnings_rank ASC;

SELECT median_earnings_10_years
FROM financial_outcomes;

WITH InstitutionPerformance AS (
    SELECT 
        a.institution_id,
        a.sat_verbal_mid,
        a.sat_math_mid,
        f.median_earnings_10_years,
        f.median_debt,
        g.employment_rate,
        CAST(f.graduation_rate AS REAL) / 100 AS graduation_rate_ratio,
        CAST(a.acceptance_rate AS REAL) / 100 AS acceptance_rate_ratio
    FROM admissions a
    JOIN financial_outcomes f ON a.institution_id = f.institution_id
    JOIN graduate_outcomes g ON a.institution_id = g.institution_id
),
FinancialAidStats AS (
    SELECT
        fa.institution_id,
        CAST(fa.pct_pell_grant AS REAL) AS pct_pell_grant,
        CAST(fa.pct_federal_loan AS REAL) AS pct_federal_loan,
        fa.avg_scholarship_amount
    FROM financial_aid fa
),
StudentDemographicsStats AS (
    SELECT
        sd.institution_id,
        CAST(sd.pct_two_or_more_races AS REAL) AS pct_two_or_more_races,
        CAST(sd.pct_non_resident_alien AS REAL) AS pct_non_resident_alien,
        CAST(sd.pct_students_over_25 AS REAL) AS pct_students_over_25,
        CAST(sd.pct_female AS REAL) AS pct_female,
        CAST(sd.pct_male AS REAL) AS pct_male
    FROM student_demographics sd
)
SELECT
    ip.institution_id,
    ip.sat_verbal_mid,
    ip.sat_math_mid,
    ip.median_earnings_10_years,
    ip.median_debt,
    ip.employment_rate,
    ip.graduation_rate_ratio,
    ip.acceptance_rate_ratio,
    fas.pct_pell_grant,
    fas.pct_federal_loan,
    fas.avg_scholarship_amount,
    sds.pct_two_or_more_races,
    sds.pct_non_resident_alien,
    sds.pct_students_over_25,
    sds.pct_female,
    sds.pct_male
FROM InstitutionPerformance ip
JOIN FinancialAidStats fas ON ip.institution_id = fas.institution_id
JOIN StudentDemographicsStats sds ON ip.institution_id = sds.institution_id
ORDER BY ip.median_earnings_10_years DESC, ip.graduation_rate_ratio DESC
LIMIT 10;

WITH AvgEarningsCTE AS (
    SELECT AVG(median_earnings_10_years) AS avg_earnings
    FROM financial_outcomes
),
HighEarningsInstitutionsCTE AS (
    SELECT fo.institution_id, fo.median_earnings_10_years, fo.graduation_rate
    FROM financial_outcomes fo
    JOIN AvgEarningsCTE aec ON fo.median_earnings_10_years > aec.avg_earnings
    WHERE CAST(fo.graduation_rate AS REAL) > 0.8
),
DebtDifferenceCTE AS (
    SELECT heic.institution_id, 
           (go.median_earnings_10_years - go.median_debt) AS earnings_debt_difference
    FROM HighEarningsInstitutionsCTE heic
    JOIN graduate_outcomes go ON heic.institution_id = go.institution_id
)
SELECT institution_id
FROM DebtDifferenceCTE
ORDER BY earnings_debt_difference DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH CTE_FinancialAid AS (
    SELECT institution_id, 
           CAST(pct_pell_grant AS REAL) AS pell_grant_percentage,
           CAST(pct_federal_loan AS REAL) AS federal_loan_percentage
    FROM financial_aid
),
CTE_GraduateOutcomes AS (
    SELECT institution_id, 
           median_earnings_10_years, 
           median_debt,
           CAST(employment_rate AS REAL) AS employment_rate_percentage
    FROM graduate_outcomes
),
CTE_Admissions AS (
    SELECT institution_id, 
           sat_verbal_mid + sat_math_mid AS total_sat_score,
           CASE 
               WHEN CAST(acceptance_rate AS REAL) < 0.5 THEN 'Selective'
               ELSE 'Non-Selective'
           END AS selectivity
    FROM admissions
),
CTE_Combined AS (
    SELECT fa.institution_id,
           fa.pell_grant_percentage,
           fa.federal_loan_percentage,
           go.median_earnings_10_years,
           go.median_debt,
           go.employment_rate_percentage,
           adm.total_sat_score,
           adm.selectivity
    FROM CTE_FinancialAid fa
    JOIN CTE_GraduateOutcomes go ON fa.institution_id = go.institution_id
    JOIN CTE_Admissions adm ON fa.institution_id = adm.institution_id
)
SELECT institution_id,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY median_earnings_10_years DESC) AS earnings_rank,
       CASE 
           WHEN employment_rate_percentage > 0.85 THEN 'High'
           ELSE 'Low'
       END AS employment_status
FROM CTE_Combined
WHERE pell_grant_percentage > 0.25
ORDER BY earnings_rank;

WITH EarningsCTE AS (
    SELECT 
        fo.institution_id,
        fo.median_earnings_10_years,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY fo.median_earnings_10_years DESC) AS rank
    FROM 
        financial_outcomes fo
),
HighestEarningsInstitution AS (
    SELECT 
        e.institution_id
    FROM 
        EarningsCTE e
    WHERE 
        e.rank = 1
)
SELECT 
    a.institution_id
FROM 
    admissions a
JOIN 
    HighestEarningsInstitution hei ON a.institution_id = hei.institution_id;

WITH RankedInstitutions AS (
    SELECT 
        f.institution_id,
        f.graduation_rate,
        g.median_earnings_10_years,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY CAST(f.graduation_rate AS REAL) DESC) AS rank
    FROM 
        financial_outcomes f
    INNER JOIN 
        graduate_outcomes g ON f.institution_id = g.institution_id
),
TopInstitutions AS (
    SELECT 
        institution_id,
        graduation_rate,
        median_earnings_10_years
    FROM 
        RankedInstitutions
    WHERE 
        rank <= 5
)
SELECT 
    institution_id,
    median_earnings_10_years
FROM 
    TopInstitutions;

WITH AcceptableInstitutions AS (
    SELECT 
        a.institution_id,
        CAST(a.acceptance_rate AS REAL) AS acceptance_rate,
        CAST(f.graduation_rate AS REAL) AS graduation_rate,
        CAST(s.pct_pell_grant AS REAL) AS pct_pell_grant,
        f.median_earnings_10_years
    FROM 
        admissions a
    JOIN 
        financial_outcomes f ON a.institution_id = f.institution_id
    JOIN 
        student_demographics s ON a.institution_id = s.institution_id
    WHERE 
        a.distance_only = 0
        AND f.tuition_fee < 30000
),
HighAcceptanceGraduation AS (
    SELECT 
        institution_id,
        median_earnings_10_years
    FROM 
        AcceptableInstitutions
    WHERE 
        acceptance_rate > 0.65
        AND graduation_rate > 0.75
        AND pct_pell_grant > 0.25
)
SELECT 
    AVG(median_earnings_10_years) AS avg_median_earnings
FROM 
    HighAcceptanceGraduation;

WITH HighAidInstitutions AS (
    SELECT fa.institution_id, 
           CAST(REPLACE(fa.pct_pell_grant, '%', '') AS FLOAT) AS pell_grant_pct,
           CAST(REPLACE(fa.pct_federal_loan, '%', '') AS FLOAT) AS federal_loan_pct
    FROM financial_aid fa
    WHERE CAST(REPLACE(fa.pct_pell_grant, '%', '') AS FLOAT) > 50
      AND CAST(REPLACE(fa.pct_federal_loan, '%', '') AS FLOAT) > 50
),
TuitionFees AS (
    SELECT fo.institution_id, 
           fo.tuition_fee, 
           RANK() OVER (ORDER BY fo.tuition_fee DESC) AS fee_rank
    FROM financial_outcomes fo
),
GraduateEarnings AS (
    SELECT go.institution_id,
           go.median_earnings_10_years,
           RANK() OVER (ORDER BY go.median_earnings_10_years DESC) AS earnings_rank
    FROM graduate_outcomes go
),
CombinedData AS (
    SELECT h.institution_id, 
           t.fee_rank, 
           g.earnings_rank
    FROM HighAidInstitutions h
    INNER JOIN TuitionFees t ON h.institution_id = t.institution_id
    INNER JOIN GraduateEarnings g ON h.institution_id = g.institution_id
)
SELECT institution_id
FROM CombinedData
WHERE fee_rank <= 10 AND earnings_rank <= 10
ORDER BY institution_id;

SELECT AVG(tuition_fee) AS average_tuition_fee
  FROM financial_outcomes;

WITH PellGrantInstitutions AS (
    SELECT fa.institution_id, fa.avg_scholarship_amount
    FROM financial_aid fa
    WHERE CAST(fa.pct_pell_grant AS REAL) > 0.25
),
GraduateEarnings AS (
    SELECT go.institution_id, go.median_earnings_10_years
    FROM graduate_outcomes go
    WHERE CAST(go.employment_rate AS REAL) > 0.8
)
SELECT p.avg_scholarship_amount, g.median_earnings_10_years
FROM PellGrantInstitutions p
JOIN GraduateEarnings g ON p.institution_id = g.institution_id
WHERE p.avg_scholarship_amount > 3000
ORDER BY g.median_earnings_10_years DESC;

WITH FinancialAidPct AS (
    SELECT 
        institution_id,
        CAST(pct_pell_grant AS REAL) AS pell_grant_pct,
        CAST(pct_federal_loan AS REAL) AS federal_loan_pct
    FROM financial_aid
),
FinancialOutcomes AS (
    SELECT 
        institution_id,
        median_earnings_10_years,
        median_debt,
        tuition_fee,
        avg_loan_amount,
        CAST(graduation_rate AS REAL) AS grad_rate
    FROM financial_outcomes
),
Demographics AS (
    SELECT
        institution_id,
        CAST(pct_two_or_more_races AS REAL) AS pct_two_or_more_races,
        CAST(pct_non_resident_alien AS REAL) AS pct_non_resident_alien,
        CAST(pct_unknown AS REAL) AS pct_unknown,
        CAST(pct_students_over_25 AS REAL) AS pct_students_over_25,
        CAST(pct_female AS REAL) AS pct_female,
        CAST(pct_male AS REAL) AS pct_male
    FROM student_demographics
),
InstitutionAnalysis AS (
    SELECT 
        fo.institution_id,
        LOG2(fo.median_earnings_10_years + 1) AS earnings_log,
        SIGN(fo.median_debt - fo.avg_loan_amount) AS debt_sign,
        fa.pell_grant_pct,
        fa.federal_loan_pct,
        (CASE WHEN fo.grad_rate >= 0.7 THEN 'High' ELSE 'Low' END) AS graduation_category,
        (CASE WHEN d.pct_female > 0.5 THEN 'Female Dominant' ELSE 'Male Dominant' END) AS gender_dominance
    FROM FinancialOutcomes fo
    JOIN FinancialAidPct fa ON fo.institution_id = fa.institution_id
    JOIN Demographics d ON fo.institution_id = d.institution_id
    WHERE fo.tuition_fee <= 35000
    AND fa.pell_grant_pct > 0.25
    AND fo.grad_rate > 0.6
)
SELECT institution_id
FROM InstitutionAnalysis
ORDER BY earnings_log DESC, debt_sign;

-- SQL query to find the average scholarship amount for institutions 
-- with a graduation rate above the median graduation rate

WITH GraduationRates AS (
    SELECT CAST(graduation_rate AS REAL) AS graduation_rate
    FROM financial_outcomes
),
MedianGraduationRate AS (
    SELECT AVG(graduation_rate) AS median_graduation_rate
    FROM (
        SELECT graduation_rate
        FROM GraduationRates
        ORDER BY graduation_rate
        LIMIT 2 - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM GraduationRates) % 2  -- Handles odd/even count of rows
        OFFSET (SELECT (COUNT(*) - 1) / 2 FROM GraduationRates)
    )
)
SELECT AVG(fa.avg_scholarship_amount) AS average_scholarship_above_median
FROM financial_aid fa
JOIN financial_outcomes fo ON fa.institution_id = fo.institution_id
WHERE CAST(fo.graduation_rate AS REAL) > (SELECT median_graduation_rate FROM MedianGraduationRate);

WITH HighGradInstitutions AS (
    SELECT
        fo.institution_id,
        fo.graduation_rate,
        fa.avg_scholarship_amount
    FROM
        financial_outcomes fo
    INNER JOIN
        financial_aid fa ON fo.institution_id = fa.institution_id
    WHERE
        CAST(fo.graduation_rate AS REAL) > 0.70
)
SELECT institution_id
FROM HighGradInstitutions
WHERE avg_scholarship_amount > 4000
ORDER BY avg_scholarship_amount DESC;

SELECT a.institution_id
FROM admissions a
INNER JOIN graduate_outcomes g ON a.institution_id = g.institution_id
WHERE g.employment_rate > '0.85' AND a.acceptance_rate > '0.65';

SELECT AVG(financial_outcomes.median_earnings_10_years) AS avg_median_earnings
FROM admissions
JOIN financial_outcomes ON admissions.institution_id = financial_outcomes.institution_id
WHERE admissions.acceptance_rate < '0.7'
  AND financial_outcomes.graduation_rate > '0.75'
  AND admissions.distance_only = 0
GROUP BY admissions.institution_id
HAVING AVG(financial_outcomes.median_earnings_10_years) > 40000;

WITH EarningsAndDebtCTE AS (
    SELECT 
        f.institution_id,
        f.median_earnings_10_years,
        f.median_debt
    FROM
        financial_outcomes f
    WHERE
        f.median_earnings_10_years > 48000
),
FinancialAidCTE AS (
    SELECT
        fa.institution_id,
        fa.avg_scholarship_amount
    FROM
        financial_aid fa
    WHERE
        CAST(fa.pct_pell_grant AS REAL) > 0.29
)
SELECT
    a.institution_id
FROM 
    EarningsAndDebtCTE ead
INNER JOIN 
    FinancialAidCTE fa ON ead.institution_id = fa.institution_id
INNER JOIN 
    admissions a ON a.institution_id = fa.institution_id
WHERE
    a.distance_only = 0
  AND a.acceptance_rate < '0.7';

WITH AdmissionsWithScores AS (
    SELECT 
        institution_id,
        sat_verbal_mid + sat_math_mid AS total_sat_score,
        CAST(acceptance_rate AS REAL) AS acceptance_rate
    FROM admissions
    WHERE application_deadline < '2023-02-15'
),
FinancialMetrics AS (
    SELECT 
        institution_id,
        median_earnings_10_years,
        tuition_fee,
        CAST(graduation_rate AS REAL) AS graduation_rate
    FROM financial_outcomes
),
InstitutionPerformance AS (
    SELECT 
        aws.institution_id,
        aws.total_sat_score,
        fm.median_earnings_10_years,
        fm.tuition_fee,
        aws.acceptance_rate,
        fm.graduation_rate,
        aws.acceptance_rate * fm.graduation_rate AS performance_score
    FROM AdmissionsWithScores aws
    JOIN FinancialMetrics fm ON aws.institution_id = fm.institution_id
)
SELECT 
    ip.institution_id,
    ip.total_sat_score,
    ip.performance_score
FROM InstitutionPerformance ip
WHERE ip.performance_score > 0.5
ORDER BY ip.performance_score DESC;

WITH HighGraduationRate AS (
    SELECT institution_id, tuition_fee, avg_loan_amount
    FROM financial_outcomes
    WHERE CAST(TRIM(graduation_rate) AS FLOAT) > 0.75
),
HighFinancialAid AS (
    SELECT s.institution_id
    FROM student_demographics s
    JOIN financial_aid f ON s.institution_id = f.institution_id
    WHERE CAST(TRIM(s.pct_pell_grant) AS FLOAT) > 0.25
      AND CAST(TRIM(s.pct_federal_loan) AS FLOAT) > 0.6
),
HighEarningsInstitutions AS (
    SELECT g.institution_id
    FROM graduate_outcomes g
    WHERE g.median_earnings_10_years > 50000
      AND CAST(TRIM(g.employment_rate) AS FLOAT) > 0.85
)
SELECT DISTINCT hgr.institution_id
FROM HighGraduationRate hgr
JOIN HighFinancialAid hfa ON hgr.institution_id = hfa.institution_id
JOIN HighEarningsInstitutions hei ON hgr.institution_id = hei.institution_id;

SELECT institution_id, sat_verbal_mid, sat_math_mid, acceptance_rate, application_deadline, distance_only
FROM admissions
WHERE institution_id IN (
  SELECT institution_id
  FROM graduate_outcomes
  WHERE median_earnings_10_years = 48100
)

WITH EmploymentCTE AS (
    SELECT institution_id, employment_rate, median_earnings_10_years
    FROM graduate_outcomes
    WHERE CAST(employment_rate AS REAL) > 0.85
),
FinancialAidCTE AS (
    SELECT institution_id, CAST(pct_pell_grant AS REAL) AS pell_grant_rate
    FROM financial_aid
),
FinancialOutcomesCTE AS (
    SELECT institution_id, graduation_rate
    FROM financial_outcomes
    WHERE CAST(graduation_rate AS REAL) > 0.7
),
EligibleInstitutions AS (
    SELECT e.institution_id, e.median_earnings_10_years
    FROM EmploymentCTE e
    INNER JOIN FinancialAidCTE fa ON e.institution_id = fa.institution_id
    INNER JOIN FinancialOutcomesCTE fo ON e.institution_id = fo.institution_id
    WHERE fa.pell_grant_rate > 0.25
)
SELECT institution_id
FROM EligibleInstitutions
ORDER BY median_earnings_10_years DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT 
    g.institution_id, 
    AVG(g.median_earnings_10_years) AS average_median_earnings_10_years, 
    g.employment_rate
FROM 
    graduate_outcomes g
INNER JOIN 
    financial_outcomes f ON g.institution_id = f.institution_id
WHERE 
    f.median_earnings_10_years > 45000
GROUP BY 
    g.institution_id, 
    g.employment_rate
HAVING 
    AVG(g.median_earnings_10_years) > 47000

WITH CTE_AidAndOutcomes AS (
    -- Combine financial aid information with outcomes
    SELECT fa.institution_id, fa.avg_scholarship_amount, fo.median_earnings_10_years, fo.median_debt, fo.tuition_fee
    FROM financial_aid fa
    INNER JOIN financial_outcomes fo ON fa.institution_id = fo.institution_id
),
CTE_AidEffect AS (
    -- Calculate a metric representing the financial effect of aid on earnings
    SELECT institution_id,
           IIF(tuition_fee > 0, (median_earnings_10_years - median_debt - avg_scholarship_amount) / tuition_fee, NULL) AS aid_effectiveness
    FROM CTE_AidAndOutcomes
),
CTE_Final AS (
    -- Combine with graduation rate from financial outcomes
    SELECT aid_effectiveness, fo.graduation_rate
    FROM CTE_AidEffect aeo
    INNER JOIN financial_outcomes fo ON aeo.institution_id = fo.institution_id
)
-- Select a meaningful column from the final CTE
SELECT AVG(aid_effectiveness) AS average_aid_effectiveness
FROM CTE_Final
WHERE graduation_rate > '0.6';

WITH CTE_FinancialAid AS (
    SELECT 
        fa.institution_id,
        CAST(fa.pct_pell_grant AS REAL) AS pell_grant_rate,
        CAST(fa.pct_federal_loan AS REAL) AS federal_loan_rate,
        fa.avg_scholarship_amount
    FROM financial_aid fa
    WHERE pell_grant_rate > 0.28 AND federal_loan_rate > 0.60
),
CTE_StudentDemographics AS (
    SELECT 
        sd.institution_id,
        CAST(sd.pct_female AS REAL) AS female_percentage,
        CAST(sd.pct_students_over_25 AS REAL) AS mature_students_rate
    FROM student_demographics sd
    WHERE mature_students_rate > 0.30
),
CTE_FinancialOutcomes AS (
    SELECT 
        fo.institution_id,
        fo.median_earnings_10_years,
        fo.graduation_rate
    FROM financial_outcomes fo
    WHERE CAST(fo.graduation_rate AS REAL) > 0.75
),
CTE_GraduateOutcomes AS (
    SELECT 
        go.institution_id,
        go.median_earnings_10_years,
        CAST(go.employment_rate AS REAL) AS employment_rate
    FROM graduate_outcomes go
    WHERE employment_rate > 0.70
)
SELECT 
    fa.institution_id
FROM CTE_FinancialAid fa
JOIN CTE_StudentDemographics sd ON fa.institution_id = sd.institution_id
JOIN CTE_FinancialOutcomes fo ON fa.institution_id = fo.institution_id
JOIN CTE_GraduateOutcomes go ON fa.institution_id = go.institution_id
ORDER BY fo.median_earnings_10_years DESC, go.employment_rate DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH CTE_Demographics AS (
    SELECT 
        institution_id,
        CAST(pct_pell_grant AS REAL) AS pell_grant_percentage,
        CAST(pct_federal_loan AS REAL) AS federal_loan_percentage
    FROM student_demographics
),
CTE_FinancialOutcomes AS (
    SELECT 
        institution_id,
        CAST(graduation_rate AS REAL) AS grad_rate,
        median_earnings_10_years,
        tuition_fee
    FROM financial_outcomes
),
CTE_GraduateOutcomes AS (
    SELECT 
        institution_id,
        median_earnings_10_years AS median_earnings
    FROM graduate_outcomes
),
CTE_CombinedStats AS (
    SELECT 
        d.institution_id,
        d.pell_grant_percentage,
        d.federal_loan_percentage,
        fo.grad_rate,
        fo.median_earnings_10_years AS financial_median_earnings,
        fo.tuition_fee,
        go.median_earnings AS graduate_median_earnings
    FROM CTE_Demographics d
    JOIN CTE_FinancialOutcomes fo ON d.institution_id = fo.institution_id
    JOIN CTE_GraduateOutcomes go ON d.institution_id = go.institution_id
)
SELECT 
    CASE
        WHEN financial_median_earnings > graduate_median_earnings THEN 'Financial Outcome Better'
        ELSE 'Graduate Outcome Better'
    END AS Outcome_Comparison
FROM CTE_CombinedStats
WHERE pell_grant_percentage > 0.25 AND federal_loan_percentage > 0.7
ORDER BY tuition_fee DESC;

WITH EarningsCTE AS (
    SELECT 
        fo.institution_id,
        (fo.median_earnings_10_years * CAST(sd.pct_female AS REAL)) AS weighted_median_earnings_female,
        (fo.median_earnings_10_years * CAST(sd.pct_male AS REAL)) AS weighted_median_earnings_male
    FROM 
        financial_outcomes fo
    JOIN 
        student_demographics sd ON fo.institution_id = sd.institution_id
),
WeightedEarnings AS (
    SELECT 
        institution_id,
        (weighted_median_earnings_female + weighted_median_earnings_male) / 2 AS weighted_median_earnings
    FROM 
        EarningsCTE
),
MedianEarningsStats AS (
    SELECT 
        institution_id,
        weighted_median_earnings,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY weighted_median_earnings DESC) AS earnings_rank
    FROM 
        WeightedEarnings
)
SELECT 
    institution_id
FROM 
    MedianEarningsStats
WHERE 
    earnings_rank = 1;

WITH AdmissionsData AS (
    SELECT 
        institution_id, 
        CAST(sat_verbal_mid + sat_math_mid AS FLOAT) / 2 AS avg_sat_score,
        RTRIM(acceptance_rate, '%') AS acceptance_rate
    FROM admissions
    WHERE distance_only = 0
),
StudentDemographicsData AS (
    SELECT 
        institution_id, 
        CAST(RTRIM(pct_female, '%') AS FLOAT) AS pct_female,
        CAST(RTRIM(pct_male, '%') AS FLOAT) AS pct_male
    FROM student_demographics
),
FinancialOutcomesData AS (
    SELECT 
        institution_id, 
        median_earnings_10_years, 
        median_debt
    FROM financial_outcomes
    WHERE graduation_rate > '0.70'
),
CombinedData AS (
    SELECT 
        ad.institution_id,
        ad.avg_sat_score,
        sd.pct_female,
        sd.pct_male,
        fo.median_earnings_10_years,
        fo.median_debt,
        ad.acceptance_rate
    FROM AdmissionsData ad
    JOIN StudentDemographicsData sd ON ad.institution_id = sd.institution_id
    JOIN FinancialOutcomesData fo ON ad.institution_id = fo.institution_id
)
SELECT 
    AVG(avg_sat_score) OVER () AS overall_avg_sat_score,
    LAST_VALUE(median_earnings_10_years) OVER (ORDER BY acceptance_rate ASC) AS earnings_with_highest_acceptance_rate
FROM CombinedData
ORDER BY median_earnings_10_years DESC;

SELECT pct_pell_grant
FROM student_demographics;

SELECT AVG(median_earnings_10_years) AS average_median_earnings
FROM graduate_outcomes;

SELECT 
    a.institution_id,
    f.median_earnings_10_years,
    d.pct_female
FROM 
    admissions a
INNER JOIN 
    graduate_outcomes f ON a.institution_id = f.institution_id
INNER JOIN 
    student_demographics d ON a.institution_id = d.institution_id
WHERE 
    a.acceptance_rate < '0.8'
    AND f.employment_rate > '0.8'
ORDER BY 
    f.median_earnings_10_years DESC;

SELECT median_debt 
FROM financial_outcomes;

WITH HighPellInstitutions AS (
    SELECT fa.institution_id
    FROM financial_aid fa
    WHERE CAST(fa.pct_pell_grant AS REAL) > 0.25
),
DistanceOnlyInstitutions AS (
    SELECT institution_id
    FROM admissions
    WHERE distance_only = 1
),
FinancialAnalysis AS (
    SELECT fo.institution_id, fo.median_earnings_10_years, fo.median_debt, fo.tuition_fee, fo.graduation_rate
    FROM financial_outcomes fo
    WHERE fo.median_earnings_10_years > 48000
),
InstitutionDetails AS (
    SELECT sd.institution_id, CAST(sd.pct_female AS REAL) AS pct_female, CAST(sd.pct_students_over_25 AS REAL) AS pct_students_over_25
    FROM student_demographics sd
)
SELECT 
    fa.institution_id
FROM HighPellInstitutions fa
JOIN DistanceOnlyInstitutions doi ON fa.institution_id = doi.institution_id
JOIN FinancialAnalysis fao ON fa.institution_id = fao.institution_id
JOIN InstitutionDetails id ON fa.institution_id = id.institution_id
WHERE id.pct_female > 0.5 AND id.pct_students_over_25 > 0.2
ORDER BY fao.median_earnings_10_years DESC;

WITH FinancialAnalysis AS (
    SELECT
        fo.institution_id,
        fo.median_earnings_10_years,
        fo.median_debt,
        fo.graduation_rate,
        CAST(fo.graduation_rate AS REAL) / CAST(fo.median_debt AS REAL) AS earnings_to_debt_ratio
    FROM financial_outcomes fo
    WHERE fo.median_earnings_10_years > 45000
),
Demographics AS (
    SELECT
        sd.institution_id,
        CAST(sd.pct_female AS REAL) AS pct_female,
        CAST(sd.pct_non_resident_alien AS REAL) AS pct_non_resident_alien,
        sd.pct_pell_grant
    FROM student_demographics sd
    WHERE CAST(sd.pct_female AS REAL) > 0.5
),
AdmissionsData AS (
    SELECT
        a.institution_id,
        a.sat_verbal_mid,
        a.sat_math_mid,
        CAST(a.acceptance_rate AS REAL) AS acceptance_rate
    FROM admissions a
    WHERE a.sat_math_mid > 500
)
SELECT
    fa.institution_id,
    fa.earnings_to_debt_ratio,
    da.pct_non_resident_alien
FROM FinancialAnalysis fa
JOIN Demographics da ON fa.institution_id = da.institution_id
JOIN AdmissionsData ad ON fa.institution_id = ad.institution_id
WHERE fa.earnings_to_debt_ratio > 1.5
ORDER BY fa.earnings_to_debt_ratio DESC
LIMIT 10;

WITH EarningsDebtCTE AS (
    SELECT 
        fo.institution_id,
        fo.median_earnings_10_years,
        fo.median_debt,
        fo.graduation_rate,
        (CAST(fo.graduation_rate AS FLOAT) * fo.median_earnings_10_years / fo.median_debt) AS performance_index
    FROM financial_outcomes fo
),
DemographicsCTE AS (
    SELECT 
        sd.institution_id,
        sd.pct_female,
        sd.pct_students_over_25
    FROM student_demographics sd
),
CombinedCTE AS (
    SELECT 
        ed.institution_id,
        ed.performance_index,
        dc.pct_female,
        dc.pct_students_over_25
    FROM EarningsDebtCTE ed
    JOIN DemographicsCTE dc ON ed.institution_id = dc.institution_id
),
RankedInstitutions AS (
    SELECT 
        institution_id,
        performance_index,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY performance_index DESC) AS rank_by_performance
    FROM CombinedCTE
)
SELECT 
    institution_id
FROM RankedInstitutions
WHERE rank_by_performance <= 5;  -- Select top 5 institutions based on performance index

SELECT a.institution_id, AVG(f.median_earnings_10_years) AS avg_median_earnings
FROM admissions a
INNER JOIN student_demographics sd ON a.institution_id = sd.institution_id
INNER JOIN financial_outcomes f ON a.institution_id = f.institution_id
WHERE sd.pct_pell_grant > '0.25' AND sd.pct_federal_loan > '0.6'
GROUP BY a.institution_id
HAVING AVG(f.median_earnings_10_years) > 40000;

SELECT 
  a.institution_id,
  a.sat_verbal_mid,
  a.sat_math_mid,
  f.median_earnings_10_years,
  f.avg_loan_amount
FROM 
  admissions a
INNER JOIN 
  financial_outcomes f ON a.institution_id = f.institution_id
WHERE 
  a.acceptance_rate > '0.6' AND a.distance_only = 0
GROUP BY 
  a.institution_id, a.sat_verbal_mid, a.sat_math_mid, f.median_earnings_10_years, f.avg_loan_amount
HAVING 
  AVG(f.median_earnings_10_years) > 40000
ORDER BY 
  f.median_earnings_10_years DESC;

SELECT a.institution_id
FROM admissions a
INNER JOIN financial_outcomes f ON a.institution_id = f.institution_id
WHERE CAST(a.acceptance_rate AS REAL) < 0.7
  AND CAST(f.graduation_rate AS REAL) > 0.75;

WITH CTE_Demographics AS (
    SELECT 
        sd.institution_id,
        CAST(sd.pct_two_or_more_races AS REAL) AS pct_two_or_more_races,
        CAST(sd.pct_non_resident_alien AS REAL) AS pct_non_resident_alien,
        CAST(sd.pct_unknown AS REAL) AS pct_unknown,
        CAST(sd.pct_pell_grant AS REAL) AS pct_pell_grant,
        CAST(sd.pct_federal_loan AS REAL) AS pct_federal_loan,
        CAST(sd.pct_students_over_25 AS REAL) AS pct_students_over_25,
        CAST(sd.pct_female AS REAL) AS pct_female,
        CAST(sd.pct_male AS REAL) AS pct_male
    FROM student_demographics sd
),
CTE_FinancialAid AS (
    SELECT 
        fa.institution_id,
        CAST(fa.pct_pell_grant AS REAL) AS pct_pell_grant_aid,
        CAST(fa.pct_federal_loan AS REAL) AS pct_federal_loan_aid,
        fa.avg_scholarship_amount
    FROM financial_aid fa
),
CTE_GraduateOutcomes AS (
    SELECT 
        go.institution_id,
        go.median_earnings_10_years,
        go.median_debt,
        CAST(go.employment_rate AS REAL) AS employment_rate
    FROM graduate_outcomes go
),
CTE_MergedData AS (
    SELECT 
        d.institution_id,
        (d.pct_two_or_more_races + d.pct_non_resident_alien + d.pct_unknown) / 3.0 AS avg_diversity_pct,
        (d.pct_pell_grant + f.pct_pell_grant_aid) / 2.0 AS avg_pell_grant_pct,
        (d.pct_federal_loan + f.pct_federal_loan_aid) / 2.0 AS avg_federal_loan_pct,
        (g.median_earnings_10_years - g.median_debt) AS net_earnings
    FROM CTE_Demographics d
    JOIN CTE_FinancialAid f ON d.institution_id = f.institution_id
    JOIN CTE_GraduateOutcomes g ON d.institution_id = g.institution_id
)
SELECT m.institution_id
FROM CTE_MergedData m
ORDER BY m.net_earnings DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH 
InstitutionFinancialAid AS (
    SELECT 
        f.institution_id,
        COALESCE(f.pct_pell_grant, d.pct_pell_grant) AS pct_pell_grant_combined,
        COALESCE(f.pct_federal_loan, d.pct_federal_loan) AS pct_federal_loan_combined
    FROM 
        financial_aid f
    JOIN 
        student_demographics d ON f.institution_id = d.institution_id
),
FilteredInstitutions AS (
    SELECT 
        institution_id,
        pct_pell_grant_combined,
        pct_federal_loan_combined
    FROM 
        InstitutionFinancialAid
    WHERE 
        CAST(pct_pell_grant_combined AS REAL) > 0.25
        AND CAST(pct_federal_loan_combined AS REAL) > 0.70
)
SELECT 
    a.institution_id,
    a.application_deadline
FROM 
    admissions a
JOIN 
    FilteredInstitutions fi ON a.institution_id = fi.institution_id
WHERE 
    a.distance_only = 0
ORDER BY 
    a.application_deadline DESC;

SELECT f.institution_id
FROM financial_outcomes f
INNER JOIN student_demographics s ON f.institution_id = s.institution_id
WHERE f.median_earnings_10_years = (
  SELECT MAX(f2.median_earnings_10_years)
  FROM financial_outcomes f2
  INNER JOIN student_demographics s2 ON f2.institution_id = s2.institution_id
  WHERE CAST(s2.pct_pell_grant AS REAL) > 0.25 AND CAST(s2.pct_federal_loan AS REAL) > 0.7
)

WITH CTE_GraduateFinancial AS (
    SELECT 
        go.institution_id,
        go.median_earnings_10_years,
        fo.median_debt,
        fo.tuition_fee,
        fo.avg_loan_amount
    FROM graduate_outcomes go
    INNER JOIN financial_outcomes fo ON go.institution_id = fo.institution_id
),
CTE_StudentFinancialAid AS (
    SELECT 
        fa.institution_id,
        fa.pct_pell_grant,
        fa.pct_federal_loan,
        fa.avg_scholarship_amount,
        sd.pct_students_over_25
    FROM financial_aid fa
    INNER JOIN student_demographics sd ON fa.institution_id = sd.institution_id
),
CTE_AdmissionsAnalysis AS (
    SELECT 
        a.institution_id,
        a.sat_verbal_mid,
        a.sat_math_mid,
        a.acceptance_rate
    FROM admissions a
    WHERE a.application_deadline < '2023-05-01'
),
CTE_Combined AS (
    SELECT 
        gf.institution_id,
        gf.median_earnings_10_years,
        sf.pct_pell_grant,
        aa.acceptance_rate,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY gf.institution_id ORDER BY gf.median_earnings_10_years DESC) as ranking
    FROM CTE_GraduateFinancial gf
    INNER JOIN CTE_StudentFinancialAid sf ON gf.institution_id = sf.institution_id
    INNER JOIN CTE_AdmissionsAnalysis aa ON gf.institution_id = aa.institution_id
)
SELECT institution_id, median_earnings_10_years
FROM CTE_Combined
WHERE pct_pell_grant > '0.25' AND acceptance_rate < '0.75'
ORDER BY ranking
LIMIT 10;

SELECT DISTINCT f.median_earnings_10_years
FROM financial_outcomes f
INNER JOIN admissions a ON f.institution_id = a.institution_id
INNER JOIN financial_aid fa ON f.institution_id = fa.institution_id
WHERE CAST(fa.pct_pell_grant AS REAL) > 0.25 AND CAST(a.acceptance_rate AS REAL) < 0.70

WITH FinancialAidCTE AS (
    SELECT
        fa.institution_id,
        CAST(fa.pct_pell_grant AS REAL) AS pell_grant_pct,
        CAST(fa.pct_federal_loan AS REAL) AS federal_loan_pct
    FROM
        financial_aid fa
    WHERE
        pell_grant_pct > 0.25 AND federal_loan_pct > 0.50
),
GraduateOutcomesCTE AS (
    SELECT 
        go.institution_id, 
        go.median_earnings_10_years
    FROM 
        graduate_outcomes go
    WHERE
        go.median_earnings_10_years IS NOT NULL
),
EarningsComparison AS (
    SELECT
        fa.institution_id,
        go.median_earnings_10_years,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY go.median_earnings_10_years DESC) AS earnings_rank
    FROM
        FinancialAidCTE fa
    INNER JOIN
