        GraduateOutcomesCTE go ON fa.institution_id = go.institution_id
)
SELECT 
    e.institution_id,
    e.median_earnings_10_years
FROM 
    EarningsComparison e
WHERE 
    e.earnings_rank <= 5;

SELECT AVG(avg_scholarship_amount) AS average_scholarship
FROM financial_aid;

SELECT 
  a.institution_id,
  a.application_deadline,
  d.pct_pell_grant,
  f.median_earnings_10_years,
  f.tuition_fee
FROM 
  admissions a
INNER JOIN 
  student_demographics d ON a.institution_id = d.institution_id
INNER JOIN 
  financial_outcomes f ON a.institution_id = f.institution_id
WHERE 
  a.distance_only = 1
  AND CAST(d.pct_pell_grant AS REAL) > 0.25
ORDER BY 
  f.median_earnings_10_years DESC;

SELECT g.institution_id
FROM graduate_outcomes g
JOIN financial_outcomes f ON g.institution_id = f.institution_id
WHERE g.median_earnings_10_years > 40000
  AND CAST(f.graduation_rate AS REAL) > 0.70;

WITH CTE_StudentAid AS (
    SELECT sd.institution_id, CAST(sd.pct_pell_grant AS REAL) AS pct_pell_grant
    FROM student_demographics sd
    UNION ALL
    SELECT fa.institution_id, CAST(fa.pct_pell_grant AS REAL) AS pct_pell_grant
    FROM financial_aid fa
),
CTE_MedianEarnings AS (
    SELECT go.institution_id, go.median_earnings_10_years
    FROM graduate_outcomes go
    INNER JOIN admissions a ON go.institution_id = a.institution_id
    WHERE CAST(a.acceptance_rate AS REAL) < 0.8
),
CTE_Analysis AS (
    SELECT sa.institution_id, AVG(sa.pct_pell_grant) AS avg_pell_grant, me.median_earnings_10_years
    FROM CTE_StudentAid sa
    INNER JOIN CTE_MedianEarnings me ON sa.institution_id = me.institution_id
    GROUP BY sa.institution_id
    HAVING AVG(sa.pct_pell_grant) > 0.25
)
SELECT institution_id, median_earnings_10_years
FROM CTE_Analysis
ORDER BY median_earnings_10_years DESC;

WITH InstitutionEarningsDebt AS (
    SELECT 
        g.institution_id,
        ROUND(AVG(g.median_earnings_10_years), 0) AS avg_earnings,
        ROUND(AVG(g.median_debt), 0) AS avg_debt
    FROM 
        graduate_outcomes g
    GROUP BY 
        g.institution_id
),
InstitutionsWithAid AS (
    SELECT 
        f.institution_id,
        f.pct_pell_grant,
        f.avg_scholarship_amount
    FROM 
        financial_aid f
    WHERE 
        CAST(f.pct_pell_grant AS REAL) > 0.28
)
SELECT 
    iad.avg_earnings,
    afd.avg_scholarship_amount
FROM 
    InstitutionEarningsDebt iad
JOIN 
    InstitutionsWithAid afd ON iad.institution_id = afd.institution_id
JOIN 
    admissions a ON iad.institution_id = a.institution_id
WHERE 
    CAST(a.acceptance_rate AS REAL) < 0.70
    AND a.distance_only = 0;

SELECT a.institution_id
FROM admissions a
INNER JOIN financial_outcomes fo ON a.institution_id = fo.institution_id
INNER JOIN student_demographics sd ON a.institution_id = sd.institution_id
WHERE CAST(a.acceptance_rate AS FLOAT) < 0.5
  AND CAST(fo.graduation_rate AS FLOAT) > 0.7
  AND CAST(sd.pct_pell_grant AS FLOAT) > 0.4
GROUP BY a.institution_id
HAVING AVG(CAST(fo.median_earnings_10_years AS INTEGER)) > 45000;

WITH HighEmploymentInstitutions AS (
  SELECT institution_id, employment_rate
  FROM graduate_outcomes
  WHERE CAST(employment_rate AS REAL) > 0.80
),
InstitutionFinancialData AS (
  SELECT f.institution_id, f.median_earnings_10_years, f.median_debt, f.tuition_fee
  FROM financial_outcomes f
  JOIN HighEmploymentInstitutions hei ON f.institution_id = hei.institution_id
),
InstitutionAdmissionsData AS (
  SELECT a.institution_id, a.acceptance_rate, a.sat_verbal_mid, a.sat_math_mid
  FROM admissions a
  JOIN HighEmploymentInstitutions hei ON a.institution_id = hei.institution_id
)
SELECT 
  afd.institution_id, 
  (CAST(afd.acceptance_rate AS REAL) * afd.sat_verbal_mid + afd.sat_math_mid) / (fnd.median_earnings_10_years + fnd.tuition_fee) AS score
FROM 
  InstitutionFinancialData fnd
JOIN 
  InstitutionAdmissionsData afd ON fnd.institution_id = afd.institution_id
ORDER BY score DESC;

SELECT fo.median_earnings_10_years
FROM financial_outcomes fo
INNER JOIN graduate_outcomes go ON fo.institution_id = go.institution_id
WHERE fo.graduation_rate > '0.75' AND fo.avg_loan_amount < 10000;

SELECT a.institution_id
FROM admissions a
INNER JOIN financial_outcomes f ON a.institution_id = f.institution_id
WHERE CAST(f.median_earnings_10_years AS INTEGER) > 45000
AND CAST(f.tuition_fee AS INTEGER) < 35000
GROUP BY a.institution_id
HAVING AVG(CAST(f.graduation_rate AS FLOAT)) > 0.7;

SELECT sd.institution_id
FROM student_demographics sd
INNER JOIN graduate_outcomes go ON sd.institution_id = go.institution_id
WHERE CAST(sd.pct_pell_grant AS REAL) > 0.25
  AND go.median_earnings_10_years > 40000;

WITH EarningsCTE AS (
    SELECT 
        fo.institution_id,
        fo.median_earnings_10_years,
        fo.graduation_rate
    FROM financial_outcomes fo
),
AdmissionsCTE AS (
    SELECT 
        institution_id,
        acceptance_rate
    FROM admissions
),
DemographicsCTE AS (
    SELECT 
        institution_id,
        pct_female
    FROM student_demographics
),
EarningsRankedCTE AS (
    SELECT 
        institution_id,
        median_earnings_10_years,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY median_earnings_10_years DESC) AS earnings_rank
    FROM EarningsCTE
),
CombinedCTE AS (
    SELECT 
        e.institution_id,
        e.median_earnings_10_years,
        a.acceptance_rate,
        d.pct_female
    FROM EarningsRankedCTE e
    JOIN AdmissionsCTE a ON e.institution_id = a.institution_id
    JOIN DemographicsCTE d ON e.institution_id = d.institution_id
)
SELECT 
    c.median_earnings_10_years,
    c.acceptance_rate
FROM CombinedCTE c
WHERE c.pct_female > '0.5'
ORDER BY c.median_earnings_10_years DESC
LIMIT 10;

WITH HighGraduationSchools AS (
    SELECT 
        fo.institution_id,
        fo.graduation_rate,
        fi.avg_scholarship_amount,
        sd.pct_female,
        fo.tuition_fee
    FROM 
        financial_outcomes fo
    JOIN 
        financial_aid fi ON fo.institution_id = fi.institution_id
    JOIN 
        student_demographics sd ON fo.institution_id = sd.institution_id
    WHERE 
        CAST(fo.graduation_rate AS REAL) > 0.75 
        AND fi.avg_scholarship_amount > 5000 
        AND CAST(sd.pct_female AS REAL) > 0.5
)
SELECT 
    AVG(tuition_fee) AS avg_tuition_fee
FROM 
    HighGraduationSchools;

SELECT AVG(go.median_earnings_10_years) AS avg_median_earnings
FROM admissions a
INNER JOIN graduate_outcomes go ON a.institution_id = go.institution_id
WHERE CAST(a.acceptance_rate AS FLOAT) > 0.50
GROUP BY a.institution_id;

SELECT median_earnings_10_years, median_debt
FROM financial_outcomes;

SELECT a.institution_id
FROM admissions a
INNER JOIN student_demographics sd ON a.institution_id = sd.institution_id
INNER JOIN graduate_outcomes go ON a.institution_id = go.institution_id
INNER JOIN financial_aid fa ON a.institution_id = fa.institution_id
WHERE go.median_earnings_10_years > 50000
  AND CAST(sd.pct_pell_grant AS REAL) > 0.25
GROUP BY a.institution_id
HAVING AVG(CAST(go.median_earnings_10_years AS REAL)) > 50000;

WITH InstitutionMetrics AS (
    SELECT 
        a.institution_id,
        a.acceptance_rate,
        a.sat_verbal_mid + a.sat_math_mid AS sat_total_mid,
        d.pct_female
    FROM admissions a
    JOIN student_demographics d ON a.institution_id = d.institution_id
    WHERE a.acceptance_rate < '0.75' AND d.pct_female > '0.50'
),
FinancialMetrics AS (
    SELECT 
        f.institution_id,
        f.median_earnings_10_years,
        f.median_debt
    FROM financial_outcomes f
    WHERE f.median_earnings_10_years > 50000
),
GraduateMetrics AS (
    SELECT 
        g.institution_id,
        g.employment_rate
    FROM graduate_outcomes g
    WHERE CAST(g.employment_rate AS FLOAT) > 0.85
)
SELECT 
    i.institution_id,
    i.sat_total_mid,
    f.median_earnings_10_years,
    g.employment_rate
FROM InstitutionMetrics i
JOIN FinancialMetrics f ON i.institution_id = f.institution_id
JOIN GraduateMetrics g ON i.institution_id = g.institution_id;

SELECT tuition_fee, graduation_rate
FROM financial_outcomes;

WITH PellGrantInstitutions AS (
    SELECT sd.institution_id, sd.pct_pell_grant
    FROM student_demographics sd
    WHERE CAST(sd.pct_pell_grant AS REAL) > 0.25
),
HighEarningInstitutions AS (
    SELECT fo.institution_id, fo.median_earnings_10_years
    FROM financial_outcomes fo
    WHERE fo.median_earnings_10_years > 40000
)
SELECT p.institution_id
FROM PellGrantInstitutions p
JOIN HighEarningInstitutions h ON p.institution_id = h.institution_id;

WITH MedianEarningsCTE AS (
    SELECT institution_id, median_earnings_10_years,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY median_earnings_10_years DESC) AS earnings_rank
    FROM graduate_outcomes
),
GraduateAidCTE AS (
    SELECT f.institution_id, f.avg_scholarship_amount, g.median_debt
    FROM financial_aid f
    JOIN graduate_outcomes g ON f.institution_id = g.institution_id
    WHERE f.avg_scholarship_amount > 4000 AND g.median_debt < 25000
),
AdmissionDemographicsCTE AS (
    SELECT a.institution_id, a.acceptance_rate, sd.pct_female
    FROM admissions a
    JOIN student_demographics sd ON a.institution_id = sd.institution_id
    WHERE a.acceptance_rate < '0.75' AND sd.pct_female > '0.55'
)
SELECT me.institution_id
FROM MedianEarningsCTE me
JOIN GraduateAidCTE ga ON me.institution_id = ga.institution_id
JOIN AdmissionDemographicsCTE ad ON me.institution_id = ad.institution_id
WHERE me.earnings_rank <= 5;

SELECT fo.median_earnings_10_years, fo.graduation_rate
FROM admissions a
INNER JOIN student_demographics sd ON a.institution_id = sd.institution_id
INNER JOIN financial_outcomes fo ON a.institution_id = fo.institution_id
WHERE a.sat_verbal_mid > 550
  AND CAST(sd.pct_students_over_25 AS REAL) > 0.30;

WITH PellGrantInstitutions AS (
    SELECT fa.institution_id
    FROM financial_aid fa
    WHERE CAST(fa.pct_pell_grant AS REAL) > 0.2
),
HighEarningInstitutions AS (
    SELECT fo.institution_id
    FROM financial_outcomes fo
    WHERE fo.median_earnings_10_years > 40000
),
Demographics AS (
    SELECT sd.institution_id, 
           CAST(sd.pct_female AS REAL) AS pct_female, 
           CAST(sd.pct_students_over_25 AS REAL) AS pct_students_over_25
    FROM student_demographics sd
    WHERE CAST(sd.pct_female AS REAL) > 0.5 AND CAST(sd.pct_students_over_25 AS REAL) > 0.3
)

SELECT go.median_earnings_10_years
FROM graduate_outcomes go
JOIN PellGrantInstitutions pg ON go.institution_id = pg.institution_id
JOIN HighEarningInstitutions he ON go.institution_id = he.institution_id
JOIN Demographics d ON go.institution_id = d.institution_id
WHERE go.employment_rate > '0.7';

SELECT fo.institution_id
FROM financial_outcomes fo
INNER JOIN graduate_outcomes go ON fo.institution_id = go.institution_id
INNER JOIN financial_aid fa ON fo.institution_id = fa.institution_id
WHERE CAST(TRIM(fo.graduation_rate) AS REAL) > 0.75
  AND fo.median_earnings_10_years > 45000
  AND CAST(TRIM(fa.pct_pell_grant) AS REAL) > 0.20
  AND fo.median_debt < 25000;

SELECT
  d.institution_id,
  d.pct_non_resident_alien,
  AVG(f.tuition_fee) AS avg_tuition_fee
FROM student_demographics d
INNER JOIN admissions a ON d.institution_id = a.institution_id
INNER JOIN financial_outcomes f ON d.institution_id = f.institution_id
WHERE CAST(d.pct_non_resident_alien AS FLOAT) > 0.01
  AND CAST(a.acceptance_rate AS FLOAT) < 0.8
GROUP BY d.institution_id;

WITH CTE_Graduates AS (
    SELECT 
        institution_id, 
        median_earnings_10_years, 
        median_debt,
        CAST(employment_rate AS REAL) AS employment_rate
    FROM graduate_outcomes
    WHERE employment_rate >= 0.85
),
CTE_FinancialAid AS (
    SELECT 
        institution_id, 
        CAST(pct_pell_grant AS REAL) AS pct_pell_grant, 
        CAST(pct_federal_loan AS REAL) AS pct_federal_loan,
        avg_scholarship_amount
    FROM financial_aid
),
CTE_Join AS (
    SELECT 
        g.institution_id,
        g.median_earnings_10_years,
        g.median_debt,
        g.employment_rate,
        f.pct_pell_grant,
        f.pct_federal_loan,
        f.avg_scholarship_amount
    FROM CTE_Graduates g
    JOIN CTE_FinancialAid f ON g.institution_id = f.institution_id
),
CTE_Analysis AS (
    SELECT 
        institution_id,
        median_earnings_10_years,
        median_debt,
        employment_rate,
        pct_pell_grant,
        pct_federal_loan,
        avg_scholarship_amount,
        LEAD(median_earnings_10_years) OVER (ORDER BY median_earnings_10_years DESC) AS next_median_earnings
    FROM CTE_Join
)
SELECT 
    institution_id
FROM CTE_Analysis
WHERE avg_scholarship_amount > 4000
ORDER BY employment_rate DESC, next_median_earnings DESC
LIMIT 5;

-- Using CTEs to simplify readability and manage complex subqueries
WITH HighAcceptanceInstitutions AS (
    SELECT institution_id
    FROM admissions
    WHERE acceptance_rate > '0.60'
),
PellGrantInstitutions AS (
    SELECT institution_id
    FROM financial_aid
    WHERE CAST(pct_pell_grant AS REAL) > 0.28
),
EligibleInstitutions AS (
    SELECT h.institution_id
    FROM HighAcceptanceInstitutions h
    INNER JOIN PellGrantInstitutions p
    ON h.institution_id = p.institution_id
),
EarningsData AS (
    SELECT g.institution_id, g.median_earnings_10_years
    FROM graduate_outcomes g
    INNER JOIN EligibleInstitutions e
    ON g.institution_id = e.institution_id
)
SELECT institution_id
FROM EarningsData
ORDER BY median_earnings_10_years DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT MAX(fo.median_earnings_10_years) AS max_median_earnings
  FROM financial_outcomes fo
  INNER JOIN financial_aid fa ON fo.institution_id = fa.institution_id
  WHERE CAST(fa.pct_pell_grant AS FLOAT) > 0.25 AND CAST(fa.pct_federal_loan AS FLOAT) > 0.60;

WITH HighEarningsInstitutions AS (
    SELECT institution_id
    FROM graduate_outcomes
    WHERE CAST(median_earnings_10_years AS INTEGER) > 45000
),
HighEmploymentRateInstitutions AS (
    SELECT institution_id
    FROM graduate_outcomes
    WHERE CAST(employment_rate AS FLOAT) > 0.85
),
EligibleInstitutions AS (
    SELECT he.institution_id
    FROM HighEarningsInstitutions he
    INNER JOIN HighEmploymentRateInstitutions her ON he.institution_id = her.institution_id
),
ScholarshipInfo AS (
    SELECT fi.institution_id, fa.avg_scholarship_amount
    FROM financial_outcomes fi
    INNER JOIN financial_aid fa ON fi.institution_id = fa.institution_id
),
DemographicsInfo AS (
    SELECT institution_id, CAST(pct_female AS FLOAT) AS pct_female, CAST(pct_male AS FLOAT) AS pct_male
    FROM student_demographics
)
SELECT AVG(si.avg_scholarship_amount) AS average_scholarship_amount
FROM ScholarshipInfo si
INNER JOIN EligibleInstitutions ei ON si.institution_id = ei.institution_id
INNER JOIN DemographicsInfo di ON si.institution_id = di.institution_id
WHERE di.pct_female > 0.5 AND di.pct_male < 0.5;

WITH StudentAid AS (
    SELECT 
        sd.institution_id,
        CAST(sd.pct_pell_grant AS REAL) AS pell_grant_percentage,
        CAST(sd.pct_federal_loan AS REAL) AS federal_loan_percentage
    FROM 
        student_demographics sd
    INNER JOIN 
        financial_aid fa ON sd.institution_id = fa.institution_id
    WHERE 
        CAST(sd.pct_pell_grant AS REAL) >= 0.25 AND
        CAST(sd.pct_federal_loan AS REAL) >= 0.60
),
FinancialAnalysis AS (
    SELECT 
        fo.institution_id,
        fo.median_earnings_10_years,
        fo.median_debt,
        fo.graduation_rate
    FROM 
        financial_outcomes fo
    INNER JOIN 
        StudentAid sa ON fo.institution_id = sa.institution_id
),
EarningsDebtComparison AS (
    SELECT 
        fa.institution_id,
        fa.median_earnings_10_years,
        fa.median_debt,
        fa.graduation_rate,
        CASE
            WHEN fa.median_earnings_10_years > fa.median_debt THEN 'Earnings > Debt'
            ELSE 'Debt >= Earnings'
        END AS earnings_vs_debt
    FROM 
        FinancialAnalysis fa
)
SELECT 
    ed.institution_id,
    ed.earnings_vs_debt
FROM 
    EarningsDebtComparison ed
ORDER BY 
    ed.median_earnings_10_years DESC;

WITH HighRatesInstitutions AS (
    SELECT
        f.institution_id,
        f.graduation_rate,
        a.acceptance_rate
    FROM
        financial_outcomes f
    INNER JOIN admissions a ON f.institution_id = a.institution_id
    WHERE
        CAST(f.graduation_rate AS REAL) > 0.75 AND
        CAST(a.acceptance_rate AS REAL) > 0.7
),
FinancialMetrics AS (
    SELECT
        f.institution_id,
        f.median_earnings_10_years,
        f.median_debt,
        (CAST(f.median_debt AS REAL) / f.median_earnings_10_years) AS debt_to_earnings_ratio
    FROM
        financial_outcomes f
)
SELECT
    h.institution_id,
    fm.debt_to_earnings_ratio,
    g.employment_rate
FROM
    HighRatesInstitutions h
INNER JOIN FinancialMetrics fm ON h.institution_id = fm.institution_id
INNER JOIN graduate_outcomes g ON h.institution_id = g.institution_id;

SELECT AVG(fa.avg_scholarship_amount) AS average_scholarship
  FROM graduate_outcomes go
  INNER JOIN financial_aid fa ON go.institution_id = fa.institution_id
  WHERE CAST(go.employment_rate AS FLOAT) > 0.85
    AND CAST(fa.pct_federal_loan AS FLOAT) > 0.60;

WITH HighPellGrantsAndAcceptance AS (
    SELECT a.institution_id
    FROM admissions a
    JOIN student_demographics sd ON a.institution_id = sd.institution_id
    WHERE CAST(sd.pct_pell_grant AS REAL) > 0.5
      AND CAST(a.acceptance_rate AS REAL) > 0.6
),
TopEarningsInstitutions AS (
    SELECT institution_id
    FROM financial_outcomes
    ORDER BY median_earnings_10_years DESC
    LIMIT 5
)
SELECT DISTINCT hp.institution_id
FROM HighPellGrantsAndAcceptance hp
JOIN TopEarningsInstitutions te ON hp.institution_id = te.institution_id;

WITH CTE_Admissions AS (
    SELECT 
        institution_id,
        LN(sat_verbal_mid + sat_math_mid) AS sat_score_log,
        CAST(acceptance_rate AS FLOAT) AS acceptance_rate_float
    FROM admissions
    WHERE acceptance_rate_float <= 0.70 AND distance_only = 0
),
CTE_StudentDemographics AS (
    SELECT 
        institution_id,
        CAST(pct_female AS FLOAT) AS pct_female_float,
        CAST(pct_male AS FLOAT) AS pct_male_float
    FROM student_demographics
    WHERE pct_female_float > pct_male_float
),
CTE_FinancialOutcomes AS (
    SELECT 
        institution_id,
        LN(median_earnings_10_years) AS log_median_earnings,
        tuition_fee,
        CAST(graduation_rate AS FLOAT) AS graduation_rate_float
    FROM financial_outcomes
    WHERE graduation_rate_float > 0.50
),
CTE_FinancialAid AS (
    SELECT 
        institution_id,
        avg_scholarship_amount,
        CAST(pct_pell_grant AS FLOAT) AS pct_pell_grant_float
    FROM financial_aid
    WHERE avg_scholarship_amount > 4000
)
SELECT 
    a.institution_id,
    a.sat_score_log + fo.log_median_earnings AS combined_log_scores
FROM CTE_Admissions a
JOIN CTE_StudentDemographics sd ON a.institution_id = sd.institution_id
JOIN CTE_FinancialOutcomes fo ON a.institution_id = fo.institution_id
JOIN CTE_FinancialAid fa ON a.institution_id = fa.institution_id
WHERE fa.pct_pell_grant_float > 0.28
ORDER BY combined_log_scores DESC;

SELECT institution_id, median_earnings_10_years, median_debt, tuition_fee, graduation_rate
FROM financial_outcomes;

WITH FinancialData AS (
    SELECT 
        f.institution_id,
        f.median_earnings_10_years,
        f.median_debt,
        f.graduation_rate
    FROM 
        financial_outcomes f
    WHERE 
        CAST(f.median_earnings_10_years AS INTEGER) > 40000
),
AdmissionsData AS (
    SELECT 
        a.institution_id,
        a.acceptance_rate
    FROM 
        admissions a
    WHERE 
        a.distance_only = 0
),
GraduateData AS (
    SELECT 
        g.institution_id,
        g.employment_rate
    FROM 
        graduate_outcomes g
    WHERE 
        CAST(g.employment_rate AS FLOAT) > 0.85
)
SELECT 
    fd.institution_id,
    fd.graduation_rate,
    fd.median_earnings_10_years,
    fd.median_debt
FROM 
    FinancialData fd
JOIN 
    AdmissionsData ad ON fd.institution_id = ad.institution_id
JOIN 
    GraduateData gd ON fd.institution_id = gd.institution_id
WHERE 
    CAST(ad.acceptance_rate AS FLOAT) < 0.7
ORDER BY 
    fd.graduation_rate DESC;

WITH AvgMedianEarningsCTE AS (
    SELECT
        institution_id,
        AVG(CAST(median_earnings_10_years AS FLOAT)) OVER () AS avg_median_earnings
    FROM graduate_outcomes
),
InstitutionAnalysisCTE AS (
    SELECT
        sd.institution_id,
        sd.pct_pell_grant,
        sd.pct_federal_loan,
        fo.median_earnings_10_years,
        ae.avg_median_earnings
    FROM student_demographics sd
    INNER JOIN financial_outcomes fo ON sd.institution_id = fo.institution_id
    INNER JOIN admissions a ON sd.institution_id = a.institution_id
    INNER JOIN AvgMedianEarningsCTE ae ON sd.institution_id = ae.institution_id
    WHERE CAST(a.acceptance_rate AS FLOAT) < 0.7 
      AND CAST(a.sat_verbal_mid AS FLOAT) > 550
      AND CAST(a.sat_math_mid AS FLOAT) > 550
)
SELECT ia.institution_id
FROM InstitutionAnalysisCTE ia
WHERE CAST(ia.median_earnings_10_years AS FLOAT) > ia.avg_median_earnings
ORDER BY ia.institution_id;

WITH AdmissionsCTE AS (
    SELECT
        a.institution_id,
        (a.sat_verbal_mid + a.sat_math_mid) / 2.0 AS avg_sat_score,
        CAST(a.acceptance_rate AS REAL) AS acceptance_rate
    FROM
        admissions a
    WHERE
        a.distance_only = 0
),
FinancialOutcomesCTE AS (
    SELECT
        f.institution_id,
        f.median_earnings_10_years,
        f.median_debt,
        CAST(f.graduation_rate AS REAL) AS graduation_rate
    FROM
        financial_outcomes f
),
DemographicsCTE AS (
    SELECT
        d.institution_id,
        CAST(d.pct_female AS REAL) AS pct_female,
        CAST(d.pct_male AS REAL) AS pct_male
    FROM
        student_demographics d
),
CombinedData AS (
    SELECT
        a.institution_id,
        a.avg_sat_score,
        a.acceptance_rate,
        f.median_earnings_10_years,
        f.median_debt,
        f.graduation_rate,
        (d.pct_female - d.pct_male) AS gender_gap
    FROM
        AdmissionsCTE a
    JOIN
        FinancialOutcomesCTE f ON a.institution_id = f.institution_id
    JOIN
        DemographicsCTE d ON a.institution_id = d.institution_id
),
RankedInstitutions AS (
    SELECT
        c.institution_id,
        (c.median_earnings_10_years - c.median_debt) AS net_earnings,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY (c.median_earnings_10_years - c.median_debt) DESC) AS earnings_rank
    FROM
        CombinedData c
)
SELECT 
    institution_id
FROM 
    RankedInstitutions
WHERE 
    earnings_rank = 1;

WITH InstitutionPerformance AS (
    SELECT
        fo.institution_id,
        fo.median_earnings_10_years,
        fo.graduation_rate,
        go.employment_rate,
        (CAST(fo.median_earnings_10_years AS FLOAT) * 0.4 + 
         CAST(SUBSTR(fo.graduation_rate, 1, LENGTH(fo.graduation_rate) - 1) AS FLOAT) * 0.3 +
         CAST(SUBSTR(go.employment_rate, 1, LENGTH(go.employment_rate) - 1) AS FLOAT) * 0.3) AS performance_score
    FROM
        financial_outcomes AS fo
    INNER JOIN
        graduate_outcomes AS go ON fo.institution_id = go.institution_id
)
SELECT
    ip.institution_id
FROM
    InstitutionPerformance AS ip
ORDER BY
    ip.performance_score DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
  f.institution_id, 
  AVG(f.avg_scholarship_amount) AS avg_scholarship,
  AVG(CAST(d.pct_pell_grant AS REAL)) AS avg_pell_grant_percentage
FROM 
  financial_aid f
INNER JOIN 
  student_demographics d ON f.institution_id = d.institution_id
WHERE 
  CAST(d.pct_female AS REAL) > 0.5 AND 
  CAST(d.pct_students_over_25 AS REAL) < 0.3 
GROUP BY 
  f.institution_id
HAVING 
  AVG(CAST(f.pct_federal_loan AS REAL)) > 0.6;

WITH CTE_FinancialAid AS (
  SELECT
    fa.institution_id,
    CAST(fa.pct_pell_grant AS REAL) AS pct_pell_grant,
    CAST(fa.pct_federal_loan AS REAL) AS pct_federal_loan
  FROM financial_aid fa
),
CTE_GraduateOutcomes AS (
  SELECT
    go.institution_id,
    go.median_earnings_10_years
  FROM graduate_outcomes go
  WHERE go.median_earnings_10_years > 50000
)
SELECT 
  sd.institution_id,
  CAST(sd.pct_pell_grant AS REAL) AS pct_pell_grant
FROM student_demographics sd
INNER JOIN CTE_FinancialAid fa ON sd.institution_id = fa.institution_id
INNER JOIN CTE_GraduateOutcomes go ON sd.institution_id = go.institution_id
WHERE 
  fa.pct_pell_grant > 0.25
  AND fa.pct_federal_loan > 0.5;

WITH InstitutionEarnings AS (
    SELECT
        fo.institution_id,
        fo.median_earnings_10_years,
        fo.graduation_rate
    FROM
        financial_outcomes fo
    WHERE
        fo.median_earnings_10_years > 45000
        AND CAST(fo.graduation_rate AS REAL) > 0.75
),
InstitutionDebt AS (
    SELECT
        fo.institution_id,
        fo.median_debt,
        fa.avg_scholarship_amount
    FROM
        financial_outcomes fo
    JOIN
        financial_aid fa ON fo.institution_id = fa.institution_id
    WHERE
        fo.median_debt < 30000
        AND fa.avg_scholarship_amount > 4000
),
EarningsDebtComparison AS (
    SELECT
        ie.institution_id,
        ie.median_earnings_10_years,
        id.median_debt,
        (ie.median_earnings_10_years - id.median_debt) AS earnings_debt_difference
    FROM
        InstitutionEarnings ie
    JOIN
        InstitutionDebt id ON ie.institution_id = id.institution_id
),
StudentDemographics AS (
    SELECT
        sd.institution_id,
        sd.pct_female,
        sd.pct_male,
        sd.pct_students_over_25
    FROM
        student_demographics sd
    WHERE
        CAST(sd.pct_female AS REAL) > CAST(sd.pct_male AS REAL)
        AND CAST(sd.pct_students_over_25 AS REAL) > 0.2
),
FinalSelection AS (
    SELECT
        edc.institution_id,
        edc.earnings_debt_difference,
        sd.pct_female,
        sd.pct_students_over_25,
        'High Earnings to Debt Ratio' AS outcome_category
    FROM
        EarningsDebtComparison edc
    JOIN
        StudentDemographics sd ON edc.institution_id = sd.institution_id
)
SELECT
    fs.institution_id,
    fs.earnings_debt_difference,
    fs.pct_female,
    fs.pct_students_over_25,
    fs.outcome_category
FROM
    FinalSelection fs
ORDER BY
    fs.earnings_debt_difference DESC;

WITH InstDiversity AS (
    SELECT sd.institution_id, 
           CAST(sd.pct_two_or_more_races AS REAL) + CAST(sd.pct_non_resident_alien AS REAL) AS diversity_score
    FROM student_demographics sd
),
InstFinancialOutcomes AS (
    SELECT fo.institution_id, 
           fo.median_earnings_10_years, 
           fo.graduation_rate
    FROM financial_outcomes fo
    WHERE CAST(fo.graduation_rate AS REAL) > 0.7
),
InstAdmissions AS (
    SELECT a.institution_id, 
           a.acceptance_rate
    FROM admissions a
    WHERE a.distance_only = 0
)
SELECT a.institution_id
FROM InstAdmissions a
JOIN InstDiversity d ON a.institution_id = d.institution_id
JOIN InstFinancialOutcomes f ON a.institution_id = f.institution_id
WHERE CAST(a.acceptance_rate AS REAL) > 0.5
AND d.diversity_score > 0.05
AND f.median_earnings_10_years > 40000
ORDER BY f.median_earnings_10_years DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH InstitutionSummary AS (
    SELECT
        a.institution_id,
        a.acceptance_rate,
        a.distance_only,
        CAST(f.median_earnings_10_years AS FLOAT) / CAST(f.median_debt AS FLOAT) AS earnings_debt_ratio,
        f.graduation_rate
    FROM admissions a
    INNER JOIN financial_outcomes f ON a.institution_id = f.institution_id
    WHERE a.distance_only = 1
),
FinancialAidSummary AS (
    SELECT
        fa.institution_id,
        fa.avg_scholarship_amount,
        CAST(fa.pct_pell_grant AS FLOAT) AS pell_grant_pct,
        CAST(fa.pct_federal_loan AS FLOAT) AS federal_loan_pct
    FROM financial_aid fa
),
EarningsComparison AS (
    SELECT
        i.institution_id,
        i.earnings_debt_ratio,
        fa.avg_scholarship_amount,
        CASE
            WHEN i.earnings_debt_ratio > 1 THEN 'High Earnings-Debt Ratio'
            ELSE 'Low Earnings-Debt Ratio'
        END AS earnings_debt_category
    FROM InstitutionSummary i
    LEFT JOIN FinancialAidSummary fa ON i.institution_id = fa.institution_id
)
SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(ec.earnings_debt_category) AS earnings_debt_summary
FROM EarningsComparison ec
ORDER BY ec.institution_id;

SELECT AVG(median_earnings_10_years) AS average_earnings
FROM graduate_outcomes;

WITH EarningsDebtEmployment AS (
    SELECT
        go.institution_id,
        go.median_earnings_10_years,
        go.median_debt,
        CAST(go.employment_rate AS FLOAT) AS employment_rate
    FROM graduate_outcomes go
    INNER JOIN financial_outcomes fo
        ON go.institution_id = fo.institution_id
),
RankedInstitutions AS (
    SELECT
        institution_id,
        employment_rate,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY ROUND(median_earnings_10_years / 10000) 
            ORDER BY employment_rate DESC, median_debt ASC
        ) AS rank
    FROM EarningsDebtEmployment
)
SELECT institution_id
FROM RankedInstitutions
WHERE rank = 1;

WITH EarningsDebtRatio AS (
    SELECT 
        f.institution_id,
        COALESCE(CAST(g.median_earnings_10_years AS REAL) / NULLIF(g.median_debt, 0), 0) AS earnings_debt_ratio
    FROM 
        financial_outcomes f
    INNER JOIN 
        graduate_outcomes g ON f.institution_id = g.institution_id
),
InstitutionAidStats AS (
    SELECT 
        fa.institution_id,
        CAST(fa.pct_pell_grant AS REAL) AS pct_pell_grant,
        CAST(fa.pct_federal_loan AS REAL) AS pct_federal_loan
    FROM 
        financial_aid fa
    INNER JOIN 
        student_demographics sd ON fa.institution_id = sd.institution_id
),
RankedInstitutions AS (
    SELECT 
        edr.institution_id,
        edr.earnings_debt_ratio,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY edr.earnings_debt_ratio DESC) AS rank
    FROM 
        EarningsDebtRatio edr
    WHERE 
        edr.earnings_debt_ratio > 1
)
SELECT 
    r.rank
FROM 
    RankedInstitutions r
LEFT JOIN 
    InstitutionAidStats ias ON r.institution_id = ias.institution_id
ORDER BY 
    r.rank ASC
LIMIT 10;

WITH AvgFinancialAid AS (
    SELECT 
        fa.institution_id,
        AVG(fa.avg_scholarship_amount) AS avg_scholarship
    FROM 
        financial_aid fa
    GROUP BY 
        fa.institution_id
),
GraduateStats AS (
    SELECT 
        go.institution_id,
        AVG(go.median_earnings_10_years) AS avg_earnings,
        AVG(go.median_debt) AS avg_debt
    FROM 
        graduate_outcomes go
    GROUP BY 
        go.institution_id
)
SELECT 
    a.institution_id,
    f.graduation_rate,
    COALESCE(AvgFinancialAid.avg_scholarship, 0) AS avg_scholarship
FROM 
    admissions a
INNER JOIN 
    financial_outcomes f ON a.institution_id = f.institution_id
LEFT JOIN 
    AvgFinancialAid ON a.institution_id = AvgFinancialAid.institution_id
LEFT JOIN 
    GraduateStats gs ON a.institution_id = gs.institution_id
WHERE 
    CAST(f.graduation_rate AS REAL) > 0.6
ORDER BY 
    avg_scholarship DESC;

SELECT AVG(g.median_earnings_10_years) AS avg_median_earnings
FROM financial_aid f
INNER JOIN graduate_outcomes g ON f.institution_id = g.institution_id
WHERE CAST(f.pct_pell_grant AS FLOAT) > 0.25;

WITH ScholarshipStats AS (
    SELECT fa.institution_id, fa.avg_scholarship_amount, fa.pct_pell_grant
    FROM financial_aid fa
),
EarningsDebtComparison AS (
    SELECT go.institution_id, go.median_earnings_10_years, go.median_debt
    FROM graduate_outcomes go
),
OptimalInstitutions AS (
    SELECT ss.institution_id, ss.avg_scholarship_amount, ed.median_earnings_10_years, ed.median_debt
    FROM ScholarshipStats ss
    JOIN EarningsDebtComparison ed ON ss.institution_id = ed.institution_id
    WHERE ss.avg_scholarship_amount > 5000
    AND ed.median_earnings_10_years > 40000
    AND ss.pct_pell_grant > '0.25'
),
FinalSelection AS (
    SELECT institution_id,
        AVG(avg_scholarship_amount) OVER () AS avg_scholarship,
        MIN(median_earnings_10_years) OVER () AS min_median_earnings
    FROM OptimalInstitutions
)
SELECT institution_id, avg_scholarship, min_median_earnings
FROM FinalSelection
ORDER BY min_median_earnings DESC;

SELECT AVG(fo.median_earnings_10_years) AS average_median_earnings
FROM admissions a
JOIN student_demographics sd ON a.institution_id = sd.institution_id
JOIN financial_outcomes fo ON a.institution_id = fo.institution_id
WHERE fo.graduation_rate > '0.5';

WITH HighGraduationRates AS (
    SELECT institution_id, graduation_rate
    FROM financial_outcomes
    WHERE CAST(graduation_rate AS REAL) > 0.70
),
FinancialAidStats AS (
    SELECT institution_id, CAST(pct_pell_grant AS REAL) AS pell_grant_percentage, CAST(pct_federal_loan AS REAL) AS federal_loan_percentage
    FROM student_demographics
    WHERE CAST(pct_pell_grant AS REAL) > 0.25 OR CAST(pct_federal_loan AS REAL) > 0.70
),
EarningsComparison AS (
    SELECT institution_id, AVG(median_earnings_10_years) OVER () AS avg_earnings_all
    FROM financial_outcomes
),
SelectedInstitutions AS (
    SELECT h.institution_id, f.median_earnings_10_years, e.avg_earnings_all
    FROM HighGraduationRates h
    INNER JOIN financial_outcomes f ON h.institution_id = f.institution_id
    INNER JOIN EarningsComparison e ON f.institution_id = e.institution_id
    WHERE f.median_earnings_10_years > e.avg_earnings_all
)
SELECT s.institution_id
FROM SelectedInstitutions s
INNER JOIN FinancialAidStats fa ON s.institution_id = fa.institution_id;

SELECT institution_id, sat_verbal_mid, sat_math_mid
FROM admissions
WHERE acceptance_rate < '0.8'
ORDER BY sat_verbal_mid DESC;

SELECT AVG(CAST(pct_federal_loan AS REAL)) AS avg_pct_federal_loan
FROM student_demographics;

WITH MedianEarningsCTE AS (
    SELECT g.institution_id, g.median_earnings_10_years, a.acceptance_rate
    FROM graduate_outcomes g
    INNER JOIN admissions a ON g.institution_id = a.institution_id
    WHERE a.distance_only = 0
),
PellGrantCTE AS (
    SELECT f.institution_id, f.pct_pell_grant
    FROM financial_aid f
    INNER JOIN admissions a ON f.institution_id = a.institution_id
    WHERE a.distance_only = 0
)
SELECT 
    m.institution_id, 
    m.median_earnings_10_years
FROM MedianEarningsCTE m
INNER JOIN PellGrantCTE p ON m.institution_id = p.institution_id
WHERE CAST(p.pct_pell_grant AS REAL) > 0.25
ORDER BY m.median_earnings_10_years DESC;

SELECT a.institution_id
FROM admissions a
JOIN student_demographics sd ON a.institution_id = sd.institution_id
JOIN financial_outcomes fo ON a.institution_id = fo.institution_id
WHERE CAST(sd.pct_pell_grant AS REAL) > 0.25
  AND CAST(a.acceptance_rate AS REAL) > 0.65
  AND fo.median_earnings_10_years > 50000;

WITH InstitutionPellGrant AS (
    SELECT 
        fa.institution_id, 
        COALESCE(CAST(fa.pct_pell_grant AS REAL), 0) AS pell_grant_aid,
        COALESCE(CAST(sd.pct_pell_grant AS REAL), 0) AS pell_grant_demo
    FROM 
        financial_aid fa
    JOIN 
        student_demographics sd ON fa.institution_id = sd.institution_id
),
InstitutionDebtEarnings AS (
    SELECT 
        fo.institution_id,
        fo.median_debt,
        fo.median_earnings_10_years
    FROM 
        financial_outcomes fo
    WHERE 
        fo.median_debt > 25000 AND fo.median_earnings_10_years > 40000
),
CombinedInstitutionStats AS (
    SELECT 
        dp.institution_id,
        dp.pell_grant_aid + dp.pell_grant_demo AS total_pell_grant_percent,
        CASE 
            WHEN de.median_debt IS NOT NULL THEN 'High Debt'
            ELSE 'Low Debt'
        END AS debt_status
    FROM 
        InstitutionPellGrant dp
    LEFT JOIN 
        InstitutionDebtEarnings de ON dp.institution_id = de.institution_id
)
SELECT 
    ci.total_pell_grant_percent,
    ci.debt_status
FROM 
    CombinedInstitutionStats ci
ORDER BY 
    ci.total_pell_grant_percent DESC;

WITH CTE_StudentAid AS (
    SELECT 
        a.institution_id,
        CAST(sd.pct_pell_grant AS REAL) AS pell_grant_pct,
        CAST(sd.pct_federal_loan AS REAL) AS federal_loan_pct
    FROM student_demographics sd
    JOIN admissions a ON sd.institution_id = a.institution_id
    WHERE a.distance_only = 0 -- Exclude distance-only institutions
), 
CTE_FinancialAidComparison AS (
    SELECT 
        fa.institution_id,
        CAST(fa.pct_pell_grant AS REAL) AS aid_pell_grant_pct,
        CAST(fa.pct_federal_loan AS REAL) AS aid_federal_loan_pct,
        fa.avg_scholarship_amount
    FROM financial_aid fa
),
CTE_GraduateOutcomes AS (
    SELECT 
        go.institution_id,
        go.median_earnings_10_years,
        go.median_debt,
        CAST(go.employment_rate AS REAL) AS employment_rate
    FROM graduate_outcomes go
),
CTE_HighPellGrantInstitutions AS (
    SELECT 
        csa.institution_id
    FROM CTE_StudentAid csa
    WHERE csa.pell_grant_pct > 0.25 -- Filter institutions with high Pell Grant percentage
),
CTE_CombinedStats AS (
    SELECT 
        hpg.institution_id,
        fg.median_earnings_10_years,
        fg.median_debt,
        fg.employment_rate,
        fac.avg_scholarship_amount
    FROM CTE_HighPellGrantInstitutions hpg
    JOIN CTE_FinancialAidComparison fac ON hpg.institution_id = fac.institution_id
    JOIN CTE_GraduateOutcomes fg ON hpg.institution_id = fg.institution_id
)
SELECT 
    cs.institution_id
FROM CTE_CombinedStats cs
WHERE cs.median_earnings_10_years > 40000 -- Institutions with median earnings above specified threshold
ORDER BY cs.median_earnings_10_years DESC;

WITH HighGraduationAndEarnings AS (
    SELECT 
        f.institution_id,
        f.graduation_rate,
        g.median_earnings_10_years,
        f.median_debt
    FROM 
        financial_outcomes f
    JOIN 
        graduate_outcomes g ON f.institution_id = g.institution_id
    WHERE 
        CAST(f.graduation_rate AS FLOAT) > 0.75 AND 
        g.median_earnings_10_years > 50000
),
PellGrantInstitutions AS (
    SELECT 
        a.institution_id,
        a.acceptance_rate,
        fa.avg_scholarship_amount,
        sd.pct_pell_grant,
        sd.pct_federal_loan
    FROM 
        admissions a
    JOIN 
        financial_aid fa ON a.institution_id = fa.institution_id
    JOIN 
        student_demographics sd ON a.institution_id = sd.institution_id
    WHERE 
        CAST(sd.pct_pell_grant AS FLOAT) > 0.3 AND 
        CAST(a.acceptance_rate AS FLOAT) < 0.7
)
SELECT 
    h.institution_id
FROM 
    HighGraduationAndEarnings h
JOIN 
    PellGrantInstitutions p ON h.institution_id = p.institution_id
WHERE 
    CAST(p.pct_federal_loan AS FLOAT) < 0.6
ORDER BY 
    h.median_earnings_10_years DESC
LIMIT 5;

WITH AdmissionsData AS (
    SELECT institution_id, CAST(acceptance_rate AS REAL) AS acceptance_rate_num
    FROM admissions
),
DemographicsData AS (
    SELECT institution_id, CAST(pct_pell_grant AS REAL) AS pell_grant_rate, CAST(pct_federal_loan AS REAL) AS federal_loan_rate
    FROM student_demographics
),
FinancialAidData AS (
    SELECT institution_id, avg_scholarship_amount
    FROM financial_aid
),
FinancialOutcomesData AS (
    SELECT institution_id, median_earnings_10_years, median_debt, tuition_fee, graduation_rate
    FROM financial_outcomes
),
GraduateOutcomesData AS (
    SELECT institution_id, median_earnings_10_years AS grad_earnings, median_debt AS grad_debt, CAST(employment_rate AS REAL) AS employment_rate_num
    FROM graduate_outcomes
),
InstitutionRanking AS (
    SELECT 
        a.institution_id,
        (f.median_earnings_10_years - f.median_debt) AS net_earnings,
        (g.grad_earnings - g.grad_debt) AS grad_net_earnings,
        (a.acceptance_rate_num * d.pell_grant_rate) AS financial_aid_factor
    FROM AdmissionsData a
    JOIN DemographicsData d ON a.institution_id = d.institution_id
    JOIN FinancialOutcomesData f ON a.institution_id = f.institution_id
    JOIN GraduateOutcomesData g ON a.institution_id = g.institution_id
    WHERE a.acceptance_rate_num < 0.7
    ORDER BY net_earnings DESC, grad_net_earnings DESC
),
FinalResult AS (
    SELECT institution_id,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY net_earnings DESC, grad_net_earnings DESC) AS rank,
    net_earnings,
    grad_net_earnings,
    financial_aid_factor
    FROM InstitutionRanking
)
SELECT institution_id
FROM FinalResult
WHERE rank = 1;

SELECT go.median_earnings_10_years, go.employment_rate
FROM graduate_outcomes go
INNER JOIN student_demographics sd ON go.institution_id = sd.institution_id
WHERE CAST(sd.pct_pell_grant AS FLOAT) > 0.25
  AND CAST(sd.pct_female AS FLOAT) > 0.50;

WITH HighEarningsInstitutions AS (
    SELECT institution_id
    FROM financial_outcomes
    WHERE median_earnings_10_years > 45000
    AND CAST(graduation_rate AS REAL) > 0.75
),
HighScoringAdmissions AS (
    SELECT institution_id
    FROM admissions
    WHERE sat_verbal_mid > 500 AND sat_math_mid > 500
)
SELECT fi.institution_id
FROM HighEarningsInstitutions fi
JOIN HighScoringAdmissions ha ON fi.institution_id = ha.institution_id

SELECT a.institution_id
FROM admissions a
JOIN student_demographics sd ON a.institution_id = sd.institution_id
WHERE CAST(a.acceptance_rate AS FLOAT) < 0.7
GROUP BY a.institution_id
HAVING AVG(CAST(sd.pct_two_or_more_races AS FLOAT)) > 0.005;

WITH InstitutionStats AS (
    SELECT 
        a.institution_id,
        CAST(a.acceptance_rate AS FLOAT) AS acceptance_rate,
        fi.median_earnings_10_years AS earnings_10yrs,
        CAST(fi.graduation_rate AS FLOAT) AS graduation_rate,
        CAST(ga.employment_rate AS FLOAT) AS employment_rate
    FROM admissions a
    JOIN financial_outcomes fi ON a.institution_id = fi.institution_id
    JOIN graduate_outcomes ga ON a.institution_id = ga.institution_id
),
AggregatedStats AS (
    SELECT 
        institution_id,
        (acceptance_rate + graduation_rate) / 2 AS avg_acceptance_graduation_rate,
        (earnings_10yrs + employment_rate) / 2 AS avg_earnings_employment
    FROM InstitutionStats
),
FinalSelection AS (
    SELECT 
        institution_id,
        ASINH(avg_acceptance_graduation_rate) AS transformed_acceptance_graduation_rate
    FROM AggregatedStats
)
SELECT 
    transformed_acceptance_graduation_rate
FROM FinalSelection
WHERE transformed_acceptance_graduation_rate > 0.5
ORDER BY transformed_acceptance_graduation_rate DESC;

SELECT a.institution_id
  FROM admissions a
  INNER JOIN graduate_outcomes g ON a.institution_id = g.institution_id
  WHERE CAST(a.acceptance_rate AS REAL) > 0.5
  GROUP BY a.institution_id
  HAVING AVG(g.median_earnings_10_years) > 40000;

WITH HighPellGrantInstitutions AS (
    SELECT fa.institution_id
    FROM financial_aid fa
    WHERE CAST(fa.pct_pell_grant AS REAL) > 0.25
),
FilteredInstitutions AS (
    SELECT a.institution_id, a.acceptance_rate, fo.graduation_rate
    FROM admissions a
    INNER JOIN financial_outcomes fo ON a.institution_id = fo.institution_id
    WHERE CAST(a.acceptance_rate AS REAL) BETWEEN 0.6 AND 0.7
),
TopInstitutions AS (
    SELECT fi.institution_id, fi.graduation_rate
    FROM FilteredInstitutions fi
    INNER JOIN HighPellGrantInstitutions hpgi ON fi.institution_id = hpgi.institution_id
    ORDER BY CAST(fi.graduation_rate AS REAL) DESC
    LIMIT 5
)
SELECT a.institution_id, a.acceptance_rate
FROM admissions a
INNER JOIN TopInstitutions ti ON a.institution_id = ti.institution_id

SELECT fo.institution_id, fa.avg_scholarship_amount
FROM financial_outcomes fo
JOIN graduate_outcomes go ON fo.institution_id = go.institution_id
JOIN financial_aid fa ON fo.institution_id = fa.institution_id
WHERE fo.graduation_rate > '0.75' AND go.median_earnings_10_years > 30000;

SELECT 
    a.institution_id,
    a.application_deadline,
    f.graduation_rate,
    sd.pct_pell_grant
FROM 
    admissions a
INNER JOIN 
    financial_outcomes f ON a.institution_id = f.institution_id
INNER JOIN 
    student_demographics sd ON a.institution_id = sd.institution_id
WHERE 
    a.distance_only = 1
    AND CAST(f.graduation_rate AS REAL) > 0.75
    AND CAST(sd.pct_pell_grant AS REAL) > 0.25

WITH CTE_Admissions AS (
    SELECT 
        institution_id,
        CAST(acceptance_rate AS REAL) AS acceptance_rate_real,
        CASE WHEN sat_verbal_mid > 500 THEN 'Above Average' ELSE 'Below Average' END AS verbal_performance
    FROM admissions
),
CTE_Demographics AS (
    SELECT 
        institution_id,
        CAST(pct_two_or_more_races AS REAL) AS pct_two_or_more_races_real,
        CASE WHEN pct_students_over_25 > '0.3' THEN 'Older Students' ELSE 'Younger Students' END AS age_group
    FROM student_demographics
    WHERE pct_female > pct_male
),
CTE_FinancialOutcomes AS (
    SELECT 
        institution_id,
        median_earnings_10_years,
        LOWER(graduation_rate) AS graduation_rate_lower
    FROM financial_outcomes
),
CTE_FinancialAid AS (
    SELECT 
        institution_id,
        avg_scholarship_amount,
        CASE WHEN avg_scholarship_amount > 5000 THEN 'High Aid' ELSE 'Low Aid' END AS aid_level
    FROM financial_aid
)
SELECT 
    a.institution_id,
    f.median_earnings_10_years,
    d.age_group
FROM CTE_Admissions a
JOIN CTE_Demographics d ON a.institution_id = d.institution_id
JOIN CTE_FinancialOutcomes f ON a.institution_id = f.institution_id
JOIN CTE_FinancialAid fa ON a.institution_id = fa.institution_id
WHERE LIKELY(a.acceptance_rate_real > 0.5)
ORDER BY f.median_earnings_10_years DESC;

WITH
    EarningsDebtCTE AS (
        SELECT
            f.institution_id,
            f.median_earnings_10_years,
            f.median_debt,
            g.employment_rate
        FROM
            financial_outcomes f
        JOIN
            graduate_outcomes g ON f.institution_id = g.institution_id
    ),
    AidImpactCTE AS (
        SELECT
            s.institution_id,
            s.pct_pell_grant,
            s.pct_federal_loan,
            fa.avg_scholarship_amount
        FROM
            student_demographics s
        JOIN
            financial_aid fa ON s.institution_id = fa.institution_id
    ),
    GraduationCTE AS (
        SELECT
            institution_id,
            CAST(graduation_rate AS FLOAT) AS grad_rate
        FROM
            financial_outcomes
        WHERE
            CAST(graduation_rate AS FLOAT) > 0.7 -- example filter condition
    ),
    CombinedData AS (
        SELECT
            ed.institution_id,
            ed.median_earnings_10_years,
            ed.median_debt,
            ed.employment_rate,
            ai.pct_pell_grant,
            ai.pct_federal_loan,
            ai.avg_scholarship_amount,
            gct.grad_rate
        FROM
            EarningsDebtCTE ed
        JOIN
            AidImpactCTE ai ON ed.institution_id = ai.institution_id
        JOIN
            GraduationCTE gct ON ed.institution_id = gct.institution_id
    )
SELECT
    institution_id
FROM
    CombinedData
WHERE
    median_earnings_10_years > 40000
    AND median_debt < 25000
ORDER BY
    institution_id;

WITH HighGraduationInstitutions AS (
    SELECT institution_id, CAST(graduation_rate AS FLOAT) AS grad_rate
    FROM financial_outcomes
    WHERE grad_rate > 0.75
),
EarningsDebtComparison AS (
    SELECT go.institution_id, go.median_earnings_10_years, go.median_debt,
           CASE
               WHEN go.median_earnings_10_years > go.median_debt * 2 THEN 'Good'
               ELSE 'Average'
           END AS financial_status
    FROM graduate_outcomes go
    INNER JOIN HighGraduationInstitutions hgi ON go.institution_id = hgi.institution_id
)
SELECT edc.institution_id, edc.financial_status
FROM EarningsDebtComparison edc;

WITH AdmissionDetails AS (
    SELECT 
        institution_id,
        CAST(acceptance_rate AS REAL) AS acceptance_rate_numeric
    FROM admissions
),
FinancialStats AS (
    SELECT 
        institution_id, 
        median_earnings_10_years, 
        CAST(graduation_rate AS REAL) AS graduation_rate_numeric
    FROM financial_outcomes
),
RankedInstitutions AS (
    SELECT 
        fs.institution_id,
        fs.median_earnings_10_years,
        ad.acceptance_rate_numeric,
        fs.graduation_rate_numeric,
        RANK() OVER (
            ORDER BY fs.median_earnings_10_years DESC, fs.graduation_rate_numeric DESC
        ) AS earnings_and_graduation_rank
    FROM FinancialStats fs
    JOIN AdmissionDetails ad ON fs.institution_id = ad.institution_id
)
SELECT institution_id
FROM RankedInstitutions
ORDER BY earnings_and_graduation_rank
LIMIT 1;

SELECT g.institution_id
FROM graduate_outcomes g
INNER JOIN financial_outcomes f ON g.institution_id = f.institution_id
INNER JOIN financial_aid a ON g.institution_id = a.institution_id
WHERE CAST(g.employment_rate AS REAL) > 0.85
AND CAST(f.median_debt AS REAL) < 30000
GROUP BY g.institution_id
HAVING AVG(CAST(a.avg_scholarship_amount AS REAL)) > 5000;

SELECT fi.graduation_rate, go.median_earnings_10_years
  FROM financial_outcomes fi
  INNER JOIN graduate_outcomes go ON fi.institution_id = go.institution_id
  WHERE CAST(fi.graduation_rate AS REAL) > 0.75;

WITH HighGradRateCTE AS (
    SELECT institution_id
    FROM financial_outcomes
    WHERE CAST(graduation_rate AS REAL) > 0.75
),
HighAidInstitutionsCTE AS (
    SELECT institution_id
    FROM financial_aid
    WHERE CAST(pct_pell_grant AS REAL) > 0.25 AND CAST(pct_federal_loan AS REAL) > 0.70
)
SELECT AVG(fa.avg_scholarship_amount) AS average_scholarship
FROM financial_aid fa
JOIN HighGradRateCTE hgr ON fa.institution_id = hgr.institution_id
JOIN HighAidInstitutionsCTE hai ON fa.institution_id = hai.institution_id;

SELECT 
  a.institution_id, 
  g.median_earnings_10_years
FROM 
  admissions a
INNER JOIN 
  student_demographics d ON a.institution_id = d.institution_id
INNER JOIN 
  graduate_outcomes g ON a.institution_id = g.institution_id
WHERE 
  CAST(d.pct_pell_grant AS REAL) > 0.28 
  AND CAST(a.acceptance_rate AS REAL) < 0.7 
  AND a.application_deadline BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-02-01'
GROUP BY 
  a.institution_id
HAVING 
  AVG(g.median_earnings_10_years) > 50000;

SELECT fa.avg_scholarship_amount
FROM financial_aid fa
INNER JOIN admissions ad ON fa.institution_id = ad.institution_id
INNER JOIN student_demographics sd ON fa.institution_id = sd.institution_id
WHERE ad.acceptance_rate < '0.70' -- Institutions with acceptance rates below 70%
AND sd.pct_pell_grant > '0.25' -- Institutions with more than 25% students receiving Pell Grants
GROUP BY fa.institution_id
ORDER BY fa.avg_scholarship_amount DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT f.institution_id
FROM student_demographics sd
INNER JOIN financial_outcomes f ON sd.institution_id = f.institution_id
WHERE CAST(sd.pct_pell_grant AS REAL) > 0.25 AND CAST(f.graduation_rate AS REAL) > 0.7
GROUP BY f.institution_id;

SELECT 
  s.institution_id, 
  AVG(CAST(s.pct_pell_grant AS FLOAT)) AS avg_pell_grant_percentage
FROM 
  student_demographics s
JOIN 
  financial_outcomes f ON s.institution_id = f.institution_id
WHERE 
  CAST(f.graduation_rate AS FLOAT) > 0.75
GROUP BY 
  s.institution_id;

WITH EarningsDebtCTE AS (
    SELECT 
        f.institution_id,
        f.median_earnings_10_years,
        f.median_debt
    FROM 
        financial_outcomes f
    WHERE 
        f.median_earnings_10_years > 45000
),
DemographicsCTE AS (
    SELECT 
        s.institution_id,
        CAST(s.pct_pell_grant AS REAL) AS pell_grant_percentage,
        CAST(s.pct_federal_loan AS REAL) AS federal_loan_percentage
    FROM 
        student_demographics s
    WHERE 
        CAST(s.pct_pell_grant AS REAL) > 0.25 AND 
        CAST(s.pct_federal_loan AS REAL) > 0.6
)
SELECT 
    ed.institution_id
FROM 
    EarningsDebtCTE ed
JOIN 
    DemographicsCTE dc ON ed.institution_id = dc.institution_id
WHERE 
    ed.median_debt < 30000;

WITH MedianEarningsVsDebt AS (
    SELECT 
        go.institution_id,
        go.median_earnings_10_years,
        go.median_debt,
        CASE 
            WHEN go.median_earnings_10_years > go.median_debt THEN 'Earnings are higher'
            ELSE 'Debt is higher or equal'
        END AS earnings_debt_comparison
    FROM 
        graduate_outcomes go
),
DemographicsSummary AS (
    SELECT 
        sd.institution_id,
        (CAST(sd.pct_two_or_more_races AS FLOAT) + CAST(sd.pct_non_resident_alien AS FLOAT) + CAST(sd.pct_unknown AS FLOAT)) AS pct_diverse_students,
        (CAST(sd.pct_female AS FLOAT) + CAST(sd.pct_male AS FLOAT)) AS pct_gender_reported,
        sd.pct_students_over_25
    FROM 
        student_demographics sd
),
FinancialAidSummary AS (
    SELECT 
        fa.institution_id,
        CAST(fa.pct_pell_grant AS FLOAT) AS pct_pell_grant,
        CAST(fa.pct_federal_loan AS FLOAT) AS pct_federal_loan
    FROM 
        financial_aid fa
),
FinalAnalysis AS (
    SELECT 
        mevd.institution_id,
        mevd.earnings_debt_comparison,
        ds.pct_diverse_students,
        ds.pct_gender_reported,
        ds.pct_students_over_25,
        fas.pct_pell_grant,
        fas.pct_federal_loan
    FROM 
        MedianEarningsVsDebt mevd
    INNER JOIN DemographicsSummary ds ON mevd.institution_id = ds.institution_id
    INNER JOIN FinancialAidSummary fas ON mevd.institution_id = fas.institution_id
    WHERE 
        mevd.earnings_debt_comparison = 'Earnings are higher'
)
SELECT 
    earnings_debt_comparison
FROM 
    FinalAnalysis
ORDER BY 
    pct_diverse_students DESC;

WITH Demographics AS (
    SELECT 
        institution_id,
        CAST(pct_two_or_more_races AS REAL) AS pct_two_or_more_races,
        CAST(pct_non_resident_alien AS REAL) AS pct_non_resident_alien,
        CAST(pct_unknown AS REAL) AS pct_unknown,
        CAST(pct_pell_grant AS REAL) AS pct_pell_grant,
        CAST(pct_federal_loan AS REAL) AS pct_federal_loan,
        CAST(pct_students_over_25 AS REAL) AS pct_students_over_25,
        CAST(pct_female AS REAL) AS pct_female,
        CAST(pct_male AS REAL) AS pct_male
    FROM student_demographics
),
FinancialMetrics AS (
    SELECT 
        institution_id,
        AVG(AVG(pct_pell_grant + pct_federal_loan)) OVER (PARTITION BY institution_id) AS avg_aid_pct,
        AVG(median_earnings_10_years) OVER (PARTITION BY institution_id) AS avg_median_earnings
    FROM Demographics
    JOIN financial_outcomes USING (institution_id)
    WHERE CAST(graduation_rate AS REAL) > 0.7
),
EmploymentStats AS (
    SELECT 
        institution_id,
        CAST(employment_rate AS REAL) AS employment_rate
    FROM graduate_outcomes
    WHERE CAST(employment_rate AS REAL) > 0.8
)
SELECT 
    fm.institution_id,
    ROUND(fm.avg_median_earnings * em.employment_rate, 2) AS adjusted_earnings
FROM FinancialMetrics fm
JOIN EmploymentStats em ON fm.institution_id = em.institution_id
ORDER BY adjusted_earnings DESC;

WITH AvgEarningsCTE AS (
    SELECT institution_id, AVG(median_earnings_10_years) OVER () AS avg_earnings
    FROM financial_outcomes
),
TopInstitutionsCTE AS (
    SELECT a.institution_id, f.median_earnings_10_years, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY f.median_earnings_10_years DESC) AS rank
    FROM admissions a
    INNER JOIN financial_outcomes f ON a.institution_id = f.institution_id
    WHERE a.acceptance_rate < '0.50' AND a.distance_only = 0
)
SELECT ti.institution_id
FROM TopInstitutionsCTE ti
INNER JOIN AvgEarningsCTE ae ON ti.institution_id = ae.institution_id
WHERE ti.median_earnings_10_years > ae.avg_earnings AND ti.rank <= 10;

WITH AvgLoanCTE AS (
    SELECT institution_id, 
           AVG(avg_loan_amount) OVER () AS global_avg_loan_amount
    FROM financial_outcomes
),
InstitutionAnalysisCTE AS (
    SELECT a.institution_id, 
           f.median_earnings_10_years, 
           f.median_debt, 
           a.sat_verbal_mid, 
           a.sat_math_mid
    FROM admissions a
    INNER JOIN financial_outcomes f ON a.institution_id = f.institution_id
    WHERE CAST(a.acceptance_rate AS FLOAT) < 0.7 
      AND CAST(f.graduation_rate AS FLOAT) > 0.75
)
SELECT i.institution_id
FROM InstitutionAnalysisCTE i
INNER JOIN AvgLoanCTE al ON i.institution_id = al.institution_id
WHERE i.median_debt < al.global_avg_loan_amount;

SELECT AVG(go.median_earnings_10_years) AS average_median_earnings
FROM graduate_outcomes go
INNER JOIN financial_aid fa ON go.institution_id = fa.institution_id
WHERE CAST(fa.pct_pell_grant AS REAL) > 0.25
GROUP BY fa.institution_id

WITH AdmissionsStats AS (
    SELECT 
        institution_id, 
        CAST(acceptance_rate AS FLOAT) AS acceptance_rate,
        DATE(application_deadline) AS application_deadline
    FROM admissions
),
DemographicsStats AS (
    SELECT 
        institution_id, 
        CAST(pct_pell_grant AS FLOAT) AS pct_pell_grant
    FROM student_demographics
),
FinancialOutcomeStats AS (
    SELECT 
        institution_id, 
        median_earnings_10_years, 
        CAST(graduation_rate AS FLOAT) AS graduation_rate
    FROM financial_outcomes
),
InstitutionAnalysis AS (
    SELECT 
        fo.institution_id,
        fo.median_earnings_10_years,
        a.acceptance_rate,
        d.pct_pell_grant,
        fo.graduation_rate
    FROM FinancialOutcomeStats fo
    INNER JOIN AdmissionsStats a ON fo.institution_id = a.institution_id
    INNER JOIN DemographicsStats d ON fo.institution_id = d.institution_id
    WHERE fo.median_earnings_10_years > 40000
      AND a.acceptance_rate < 0.8
      AND d.pct_pell_grant > 0.25
)
SELECT 
    institution_id,
    median_earnings_10_years,
    acceptance_rate,
    pct_pell_grant,
    graduation_rate
FROM InstitutionAnalysis
ORDER BY median_earnings_10_years DESC;

WITH AdmissionsMetrics AS (
    SELECT 
        institution_id,
        (sat_verbal_mid + sat_math_mid) / 2.0 AS avg_sat_score,
        CAST(acceptance_rate AS REAL) AS acceptance_rate
    FROM admissions
),
DemographicsMetrics AS (
    SELECT
        institution_id,
        CAST(pct_pell_grant AS REAL) AS pct_pell_grant,
        CAST(pct_federal_loan AS REAL) AS pct_federal_loan,
        CAST(pct_students_over_25 AS REAL) AS pct_students_over_25
    FROM student_demographics
),
FinancialMetrics AS (
    SELECT 
        institution_id,
        median_earnings_10_years,
        median_debt,
        tuition_fee,
        CAST(graduation_rate AS REAL) AS graduation_rate
    FROM financial_outcomes
),
GraduateOutcomes AS (
    SELECT
        institution_id,
        employment_rate
    FROM graduate_outcomes
),
InstitutionPerformance AS (
    SELECT 
        am.institution_id,
        avg_sat_score,
        dm.pct_pell_grant,
        fm.median_earnings_10_years,
        fm.median_debt,
        fm.tuition_fee,
        fm.graduation_rate,
        CAST(go.employment_rate AS REAL) AS employment_rate
    FROM AdmissionsMetrics am
    JOIN DemographicsMetrics dm ON am.institution_id = dm.institution_id
    JOIN FinancialMetrics fm ON am.institution_id = fm.institution_id
    JOIN GraduateOutcomes go ON am.institution_id = go.institution_id
),
PerformanceScores AS (
    SELECT 
        institution_id,
        avg_sat_score + pct_pell_grant * 100 - median_debt / 1000 + median_earnings_10_years / 1000 + graduation_rate * 100 + employment_rate * 100 AS performance_score
    FROM InstitutionPerformance
)
SELECT institution_id
FROM PerformanceScores
ORDER BY performance_score DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT MAX(median_earnings_10_years) 
FROM financial_outcomes;

WITH
  CTE_Admissions AS (
    SELECT 
      institution_id, 
      sat_verbal_mid, 
      sat_math_mid, 
      FLOOR(CAST(acceptance_rate AS REAL) * 100) AS acceptance_rate_pct
    FROM admissions
  ),
  CTE_StudentDemographics AS (
    SELECT 
      institution_id, 
      FLOOR(CAST(pct_female AS REAL) * 100) AS pct_female_pct, 
      FLOOR(CAST(pct_male AS REAL) * 100) AS pct_male_pct, 
      FLOOR(CAST(pct_pell_grant AS REAL) * 100) AS pct_pell_grant_pct
    FROM student_demographics
  ),
  CTE_FinancialOutcomes AS (
    SELECT 
      institution_id, 
      median_earnings_10_years, 
      median_debt, 
      tuition_fee
    FROM financial_outcomes
  ),
  CTE_GraduateOutcomes AS (
    SELECT 
      institution_id, 
      median_earnings_10_years, 
      median_debt, 
      CAST(employment_rate AS REAL) AS employment_rate
    FROM graduate_outcomes
  )
SELECT 
  fo.institution_id
FROM CTE_Admissions a
JOIN CTE_StudentDemographics sd ON a.institution_id = sd.institution_id
JOIN CTE_FinancialOutcomes fo ON a.institution_id = fo.institution_id
JOIN CTE_GraduateOutcomes go ON a.institution_id = go.institution_id
WHERE 
  a.acceptance_rate_pct > 60 AND 
  sd.pct_pell_grant_pct > 25 AND
  fo.median_earnings_10_years > 45000 AND
  go.employment_rate > 0.75
ORDER BY fo.median_earnings_10_years DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH InstitutionMetrics AS (
    SELECT
        a.institution_id,
        CAST(REPLACE(a.acceptance_rate, '%', '') AS FLOAT) AS acceptance_rate_percent,
        CAST(REPLACE(f.graduation_rate, '%', '') AS FLOAT) AS graduation_rate_percent,
        f.median_earnings_10_years
    FROM
        admissions a
    INNER JOIN
        financial_outcomes f ON a.institution_id = f.institution_id
    WHERE
        a.distance_only = 0 -- Exclude distance-only institutions for this analysis
),
RankedInstitutions AS (
    SELECT
        institution_id,
        acceptance_rate_percent,
        graduation_rate_percent,
        median_earnings_10_years,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY median_earnings_10_years DESC) AS earnings_rank
    FROM
        InstitutionMetrics
)
SELECT
    institution_id,
    acceptance_rate_percent,
    graduation_rate_percent
FROM
    RankedInstitutions
WHERE
    earnings_rank <= 10 -- Top 10 institutions by median earnings 10 years after enrollment
ORDER BY
    median_earnings_10_years DESC;

WITH StudentFinancialAid AS (
    SELECT 
        sd.institution_id,
        CAST(fa.pct_pell_grant AS REAL) AS pell_grant_pct,
        CAST(fa.pct_federal_loan AS REAL) AS federal_loan_pct,
        CAST(sd.pct_students_over_25 AS REAL) AS students_over_25_pct,
        CAST(sd.pct_female AS REAL) AS female_pct
    FROM student_demographics sd
    JOIN financial_aid fa ON sd.institution_id = fa.institution_id
),
FinancialOutcomes AS (
    SELECT 
        fo.institution_id,
        CAST(fo.graduation_rate AS REAL) AS grad_rate,
        fo.median_earnings_10_years,
        fo.median_debt,
        fo.tuition_fee
    FROM financial_outcomes fo
),
CombinedData AS (
    SELECT
        sfa.institution_id,
        sfa.pell_grant_pct,
        sfa.federal_loan_pct,
        sfa.students_over_25_pct,
        sfa.female_pct,
        fo.grad_rate,
        fo.median_earnings_10_years,
        fo.median_debt,
        fo.tuition_fee,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sfa.institution_id ORDER BY fo.median_earnings_10_years DESC) AS rank_earnings
    FROM StudentFinancialAid sfa
    JOIN FinancialOutcomes fo ON sfa.institution_id = fo.institution_id
)
SELECT 
    institution_id,
    median_earnings_10_years
FROM CombinedData
WHERE rank_earnings = 1
ORDER BY median_earnings_10_years DESC;

SELECT sat_verbal_mid, sat_math_mid
FROM admissions;

WITH CTE_Admissions AS (
    SELECT 
        institution_id, 
        sat_verbal_mid, 
        sat_math_mid, 
        (CAST(acceptance_rate AS FLOAT)) AS acceptance_rate, 
        application_deadline, 
        distance_only
    FROM 
        admissions
),
CTE_StudentDemographics AS (
    SELECT 
        institution_id,
        CAST(pct_two_or_more_races AS FLOAT) AS pct_two_or_more_races,
        CAST(pct_non_resident_alien AS FLOAT) AS pct_non_resident_alien,
        CAST(pct_unknown AS FLOAT) AS pct_unknown,
        CAST(pct_pell_grant AS FLOAT) AS pct_pell_grant,
        CAST(pct_federal_loan AS FLOAT) AS pct_federal_loan,
        CAST(pct_students_over_25 AS FLOAT) AS pct_students_over_25,
        CAST(pct_female AS FLOAT) AS pct_female,
        CAST(pct_male AS FLOAT) AS pct_male
    FROM 
        student_demographics
),
CTE_FinancialOutcomes AS (
    SELECT 
        institution_id, 
        median_earnings_10_years, 
        median_debt,
        tuition_fee, 
        avg_loan_amount, 
        CAST(graduation_rate AS FLOAT) AS graduation_rate
    FROM 
        financial_outcomes
),
CTE_FinancialAid AS (
    SELECT 
        institution_id, 
        CAST(pct_pell_grant AS FLOAT) AS pct_pell_grant_aid,
        CAST(pct_federal_loan AS FLOAT) AS pct_federal_loan_aid,
        avg_scholarship_amount
    FROM 
        financial_aid
),
CTE_GraduateOutcomes AS (
    SELECT 
        institution_id, 
        median_earnings_10_years AS grad_median_earnings,
        median_debt AS grad_median_debt, 
        CAST(employment_rate AS FLOAT) AS employment_rate
    FROM 
        graduate_outcomes
),
FinalData AS (
    SELECT 
        a.institution_id,
        a.acceptance_rate,
        ROUND((a.sat_verbal_mid + a.sat_math_mid) / 2.0, 2) AS avg_sat_score,
        sd.pct_female,
        sd.pct_male,
        fo.median_earnings_10_years,
        fo.tuition_fee,
        fa.avg_scholarship_amount,
        (fo.graduation_rate * go.employment_rate) AS success_rate
    FROM 
        CTE_Admissions a
    INNER JOIN 
        CTE_StudentDemographics sd ON a.institution_id = sd.institution_id
    INNER JOIN 
        CTE_FinancialOutcomes fo ON a.institution_id = fo.institution_id
    INNER JOIN 
        CTE_FinancialAid fa ON a.institution_id = fa.institution_id
    INNER JOIN 
        CTE_GraduateOutcomes go ON a.institution_id = go.institution_id
    WHERE 
        a.distance_only = 0
    ORDER BY 
        success_rate DESC
)
SELECT 
    LAST_VALUE(institution_id) OVER (ORDER BY success_rate DESC RANGE BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS top_institution
FROM 
    FinalData
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
  institution_id,
  median_earnings_10_years,
  median_debt,
  employment_rate
FROM 
  graduate_outcomes
WHERE 
  employment_rate > '0.80';

WITH CTE_GraduateOutcomes AS (
    SELECT 
        institution_id,
        median_earnings_10_years,
        median_debt,
        CAST(employment_rate AS REAL) AS employment_rate_real
    FROM 
        graduate_outcomes
    WHERE 
        employment_rate_real > 0.85
),
CTE_FinancialAid AS (
    SELECT 
        institution_id,
        CAST(pct_pell_grant AS REAL) AS pell_grant_rate
    FROM 
        financial_aid
    WHERE 
        pell_grant_rate > 0.25
),
CTE_AdmissionsFiltered AS (
    SELECT 
        institution_id,
        LENGTH(acceptance_rate) AS acceptance_rate_length,
        distance_only
    FROM 
        admissions
    WHERE 
        distance_only = 0
),
CTE_Final AS (
    SELECT 
        g.institution_id,
        g.median_earnings_10_years,
        f.pell_grant_rate,
        a.acceptance_rate_length
    FROM 
        CTE_GraduateOutcomes g
    INNER JOIN 
        CTE_FinancialAid f ON g.institution_id = f.institution_id
    INNER JOIN 
        CTE_AdmissionsFiltered a ON g.institution_id = a.institution_id
    WHERE 
        g.median_earnings_10_years > 40000
)
SELECT
    institution_id,
    median_earnings_10_years,
    acceptance_rate_length
FROM 
    CTE_Final
ORDER BY 
    median_earnings_10_years DESC,
    acceptance_rate_length ASC;

WITH InstitutionSelection AS (
    SELECT
        f.institution_id,
        CAST(f.graduation_rate AS FLOAT) AS graduation_rate,
        a.sat_verbal_mid,
        a.sat_math_mid
    FROM admissions a
    INNER JOIN financial_outcomes f ON a.institution_id = f.institution_id
    WHERE CAST(f.graduation_rate AS FLOAT) > 0.75
),
AverageSATScores AS (
    SELECT
        institution_id,
        (sat_verbal_mid + sat_math_mid) / 2.0 AS avg_sat_score
    FROM InstitutionSelection
),
RankedInstitutions AS (
    SELECT
        institution_id,
        avg_sat_score,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY avg_sat_score DESC) AS rank
    FROM AverageSATScores
)
SELECT
    institution_id,
    avg_sat_score
FROM RankedInstitutions
WHERE rank <= 5;

WITH HighEmploymentInstitutions AS (
    SELECT g.institution_id
    FROM graduate_outcomes g
    WHERE CAST(g.employment_rate AS REAL) > 0.85
),
HighPellGrantInstitutions AS (
    SELECT fa.institution_id
    FROM financial_aid fa
    WHERE CAST(fa.pct_pell_grant AS REAL) > 0.2
)
SELECT 
    CONCAT_WS(', ', 'Institution ID: ', he.institution_id) AS InstitutionInfo
FROM 
    HighEmploymentInstitutions he
JOIN 
    HighPellGrantInstitutions hp ON he.institution_id = hp.institution_id;

WITH FinancialData AS (
    SELECT 
        f.institution_id, 
        f.graduation_rate, 
        g.employment_rate
    FROM 
        financial_outcomes f
    JOIN 
        graduate_outcomes g ON f.institution_id = g.institution_id
),
DemographicData AS (
    SELECT 
        s.institution_id,
        s.pct_pell_grant,
        s.pct_federal_loan
    FROM 
        student_demographics s
    WHERE 
        CAST(s.pct_pell_grant AS REAL) > 0.25
        AND CAST(s.pct_federal_loan AS REAL) > 0.70
)
SELECT 
    fd.graduation_rate, 
    fd.employment_rate
FROM 
    FinancialData fd
JOIN 
    DemographicData dd ON fd.institution_id = dd.institution_id
WHERE 
    CAST(fd.graduation_rate AS REAL) > 0.75
ORDER BY 
    fd.employment_rate DESC;

WITH FinancialStudentData AS (
    SELECT 
        f.institution_id,
        f.median_earnings_10_years,
        f.median_debt,
        f.tuition_fee,
        f.graduation_rate,
        d.pct_pell_grant,
        d.pct_federal_loan,
        d.pct_students_over_25,
        d.pct_female
    FROM 
        financial_outcomes f
    JOIN 
        student_demographics d ON f.institution_id = d.institution_id
),
AverageSAT AS (
    SELECT 
        institution_id,
        (CAST(sat_verbal_mid AS REAL) + CAST(sat_math_mid AS REAL)) / 2 AS avg_sat_score
    FROM 
        admissions
    WHERE 
        sat_verbal_mid IS NOT NULL AND sat_math_mid IS NOT NULL
),
InstitutionRanking AS (
    SELECT 
        fs.institution_id,
        fs.median_earnings_10_years,
        fs.median_debt,
        fs.tuition_fee,
        avg_sat.avg_sat_score,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY fs.median_earnings_10_years DESC) AS earnings_rank
    FROM 
        FinancialStudentData fs
    LEFT JOIN 
        AverageSAT avg_sat ON fs.institution_id = avg_sat.institution_id
)
SELECT 
    institution_id
FROM 
    InstitutionRanking
WHERE 
    earnings_rank <= 5;

WITH RankedInstitutions AS (
    SELECT 
        a.institution_id,
        fo.median_earnings_10_years,
        CAST(a.acceptance_rate AS REAL) AS acceptance_rate,
        CAST(fa.pct_pell_grant AS REAL) AS pct_pell_grant,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY fo.median_earnings_10_years DESC) AS earnings_rank
    FROM admissions a
    INNER JOIN financial_outcomes fo ON a.institution_id = fo.institution_id
    INNER JOIN financial_aid fa ON a.institution_id = fa.institution_id
    WHERE CAST(a.acceptance_rate AS REAL) > 0.5
      AND CAST(fa.pct_pell_grant AS REAL) > 0.25
)
SELECT institution_id
FROM RankedInstitutions
WHERE earnings_rank <= 5;

WITH RecursiveInstitutionHierarchy AS (
    SELECT 
        institution_id, 
        sat_verbal_mid, 
        sat_math_mid, 
        acceptance_rate, 
        1 AS level
    FROM admissions
    WHERE distance_only = 0
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        a.institution_id, 
        a.sat_verbal_mid, 
        a.sat_math_mid, 
        a.acceptance_rate, 
        rih.level + 1
    FROM admissions a
    JOIN RecursiveInstitutionHierarchy rih ON a.sat_verbal_mid > rih.sat_verbal_mid
),
FinancialData AS (
    SELECT 
        fi.institution_id,
        (CAST(fd.graduation_rate AS FLOAT) * CAST(fd.tuition_fee AS FLOAT)) AS weighted_graduation_rate
    FROM financial_outcomes fd
    JOIN financial_aid fi ON fd.institution_id = fi.institution_id
),
CombinedData AS (
    SELECT 
        sd.institution_id,
        sd.pct_pell_grant,
        sd.pct_federal_loan,
        f.weighted_graduation_rate,
        f.institution_id AS fin_inst_id
    FROM student_demographics sd
    LEFT JOIN FinancialData f ON sd.institution_id = f.institution_id
),
GraduateRank AS (
    SELECT 
        go.institution_id,
        go.median_earnings_10_years,
        go.employment_rate,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY CAST(go.employment_rate AS FLOAT) DESC, go.median_earnings_10_years DESC) AS rank
    FROM graduate_outcomes go
)
SELECT 
    ci.institution_id
FROM CombinedData cd
JOIN RecursiveInstitutionHierarchy ci ON cd.institution_id = ci.institution_id
JOIN GraduateRank gr ON ci.institution_id = gr.institution_id
WHERE gr.rank <= 5
ORDER BY ci.level, ci.institution_id;

WITH PellGrantInstitutions AS (
  SELECT sd.institution_id
  FROM student_demographics sd
  JOIN financial_aid fa ON sd.institution_id = fa.institution_id
  WHERE CAST(fa.pct_pell_grant AS REAL) > 0.25
),
MedianEarningsAndDebt AS (
  SELECT fo.institution_id, fo.median_earnings_10_years, fo.median_debt
  FROM financial_outcomes fo
  WHERE fo.institution_id IN (SELECT institution_id FROM PellGrantInstitutions)
),
GraduationStats AS (
  SELECT fo.institution_id, CAST(fo.graduation_rate AS REAL) AS graduation_rate
  FROM financial_outcomes fo
  WHERE fo.institution_id IN (SELECT institution_id FROM PellGrantInstitutions)
)
SELECT mead.median_earnings_10_years
FROM MedianEarningsAndDebt mead
JOIN GraduationStats gs ON mead.institution_id = gs.institution_id
WHERE gs.graduation_rate > 0.5
ORDER BY mead.median_earnings_10_years DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT fo.median_earnings_10_years
FROM financial_outcomes fo
INNER JOIN admissions a ON fo.institution_id = a.institution_id
WHERE CAST(a.acceptance_rate AS FLOAT) < (
  SELECT AVG(CAST(acceptance_rate AS FLOAT))
  FROM admissions
)
AND CAST(fo.graduation_rate AS FLOAT) > (
  SELECT AVG(CAST(graduation_rate AS FLOAT))
  FROM financial_outcomes
);

WITH FemaleDominatedInstitutions AS (
    SELECT sd.institution_id
    FROM student_demographics sd
    WHERE CAST(sd.pct_female AS REAL) > 0.5
),
HighGraduationRateInstitutions AS (
    SELECT fo.institution_id
    FROM financial_outcomes fo
    WHERE CAST(fo.graduation_rate AS REAL) > 0.75
)
SELECT go.median_earnings_10_years
FROM graduate_outcomes go
JOIN FemaleDominatedInstitutions fdi ON go.institution_id = fdi.institution_id
JOIN HighGraduationRateInstitutions hgri ON go.institution_id = hgri.institution_id;

WITH DistanceEducation AS (
    SELECT institution_id, median_earnings_10_years
    FROM financial_outcomes
    WHERE institution_id IN (
        SELECT institution_id
        FROM admissions
        WHERE distance_only = 1
    )
),
FilteredInstitutions AS (
    SELECT de.institution_id, de.median_earnings_10_years
    FROM DistanceEducation de
    INNER JOIN financial_outcomes fo ON de.institution_id = fo.institution_id
    INNER JOIN financial_aid fa ON de.institution_id = fa.institution_id
    WHERE CAST(fo.graduation_rate AS REAL) > 0.7 AND CAST(fa.pct_pell_grant AS REAL) > 0.2
),
RankedInstitutions AS (
    SELECT institution_id, median_earnings_10_years,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY median_earnings_10_years DESC) AS rank
    FROM FilteredInstitutions
)
SELECT institution_id
FROM RankedInstitutions
WHERE rank = 1;

WITH AvgScores AS (
    SELECT 
        institution_id,
        (sat_verbal_mid + sat_math_mid) / 2.0 AS avg_sat_score
    FROM admissions
    WHERE distance_only = 0
),
DemographicStats AS (
    SELECT 
        institution_id,
        CAST(pct_female AS REAL) AS pct_female_real,
        CAST(pct_students_over_25 AS REAL) AS pct_over_25_real
    FROM student_demographics
),
FinancialAnalysis AS (
    SELECT 
        fo.institution_id,
        fo.median_earnings_10_years,
        CAST(fo.graduation_rate AS REAL) AS grad_rate_real,
        CASE WHEN CAST(fo.graduation_rate AS REAL) > 0.75 THEN 'High' ELSE 'Low' END AS grad_rate_category
    FROM financial_outcomes fo
)
SELECT
    fa.institution_id
FROM AvgScores AS ascores
INNER JOIN DemographicStats AS ds ON ascores.institution_id = ds.institution_id
INNER JOIN FinancialAnalysis AS fa ON ascores.institution_id = fa.institution_id
WHERE fa.grad_rate_category = 'High' AND ds.pct_female_real > 0.5
ORDER BY fa.median_earnings_10_years DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT fa.avg_scholarship_amount
FROM financial_aid fa
INNER JOIN financial_outcomes fo ON fa.institution_id = fo.institution_id
INNER JOIN student_demographics sd ON fa.institution_id = sd.institution_id
WHERE CAST(fo.median_earnings_10_years AS INTEGER) > 50000
AND CAST(sd.pct_pell_grant AS REAL) > 0.25;

WITH HighSATInstitutions AS (
    SELECT institution_id
    FROM admissions
    WHERE sat_math_mid > 550 AND distance_only = 1
),
EarningsStats AS (
    SELECT 
        institution_id,
        AVG(median_earnings_10_years) AS avg_earnings
    FROM graduate_outcomes
    WHERE institution_id IN (SELECT institution_id FROM HighSATInstitutions)
    GROUP BY institution_id
),
GraduationStats AS (
    SELECT
        institution_id,
        graduation_rate
    FROM financial_outcomes
    WHERE institution_id IN (SELECT institution_id FROM HighSATInstitutions)
),
AcceptanceStats AS (
    SELECT 
        institution_id,
        acceptance_rate
    FROM admissions
    WHERE institution_id IN (SELECT institution_id FROM HighSATInstitutions)
)
SELECT 
    es.institution_id,
    es.avg_earnings,
    gs.graduation_rate
FROM EarningsStats es
JOIN GraduationStats gs ON es.institution_id = gs.institution_id
JOIN AcceptanceStats ac ON es.institution_id = ac.institution_id
ORDER BY es.avg_earnings DESC;

SELECT a.institution_id, f.median_earnings_10_years
FROM admissions a
INNER JOIN financial_outcomes f ON a.institution_id = f.institution_id
WHERE a.distance_only = 1;

SELECT fo.median_earnings_10_years
FROM admissions AS a
INNER JOIN financial_outcomes AS fo ON a.institution_id = fo.institution_id
INNER JOIN graduate_outcomes AS go ON a.institution_id = go.institution_id
WHERE a.distance_only = 1 AND CAST(fo.graduation_rate AS REAL) > 0.75
GROUP BY fo.median_earnings_10_years
HAVING AVG(CAST(go.employment_rate AS REAL)) > 0.85;

WITH FinancialAidCTE AS (
    SELECT institution_id, 
           CAST(REPLACE(pct_pell_grant, '0.', '') AS INTEGER) AS PellGrantPercentage,
           CAST(REPLACE(pct_federal_loan, '0.', '') AS INTEGER) AS FederalLoanPercentage
    FROM financial_aid
),
StudentDemographicsCTE AS (
    SELECT institution_id,
           CAST(REPLACE(pct_pell_grant, '0.', '') AS INTEGER) AS DemoPellGrantPercentage,
           CAST(REPLACE(pct_federal_loan, '0.', '') AS INTEGER) AS DemoFederalLoanPercentage
    FROM student_demographics
),
CombinedData AS (
    SELECT f.institution_id,
           (f.PellGrantPercentage + d.DemoPellGrantPercentage) / 2.0 AS AvgPellGrantPercentage,
           (f.FederalLoanPercentage + d.DemoFederalLoanPercentage) / 2.0 AS AvgFederalLoanPercentage
    FROM FinancialAidCTE f
    JOIN StudentDemographicsCTE d ON f.institution_id = d.institution_id
),
AboveAverageInstitutions AS (
    SELECT institution_id
    FROM CombinedData
    WHERE AvgPellGrantPercentage > 25 AND AvgFederalLoanPercentage > 50
)
SELECT f.avg_scholarship_amount
FROM financial_aid f
JOIN AboveAverageInstitutions a ON f.institution_id = a.institution_id;

WITH GraduationCTE AS (
    SELECT 
        institution_id,
        CAST(graduation_rate AS REAL) AS grad_rate
    FROM 
        financial_outcomes
),
EarningsCTE AS (
    SELECT 
        institution_id,
        median_earnings_10_years,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY median_earnings_10_years DESC) AS earnings_rank
    FROM 
        graduate_outcomes
),
DemographicsCTE AS (
    SELECT 
        institution_id,
        pct_female,
        pct_male,
        CAST(pct_pell_grant AS REAL) AS pell_grant_percentage
    FROM 
        student_demographics
)
SELECT 
    e.institution_id
FROM 
    EarningsCTE e
JOIN 
    GraduationCTE g ON e.institution_id = g.institution_id
JOIN 
    DemographicsCTE d ON e.institution_id = d.institution_id
WHERE 
    e.earnings_rank <= 5
    AND g.grad_rate > 0.75
    AND d.pell_grant_percentage > 0.25
ORDER BY 
    e.earnings_rank;

WITH FilteredInstitutions AS (
    SELECT 
        a.institution_id, 
        f.tuition_fee, 
        CAST(a.acceptance_rate AS REAL) AS acceptance_rate
    FROM admissions a
    INNER JOIN financial_outcomes f ON a.institution_id = f.institution_id
    WHERE a.distance_only = 0 AND CAST(a.acceptance_rate AS REAL) < 0.7
),
DemographicsSummary AS (
    SELECT 
        s.institution_id,
        CAST(s.pct_two_or_more_races AS REAL) AS pct_two_or_more_races,
        CAST(s.pct_pell_grant AS REAL) AS pct_pell_grant
    FROM student_demographics s
    WHERE CAST(s.pct_female AS REAL) > 0.5
),
FinancialAidStats AS (
    SELECT
