INNER JOIN RegionAnalysis ra ON wa.station_id = ra.region_id
ORDER BY pm25_ratio DESC;

WITH AvgAirQuality AS (
    SELECT 
        station_id,
        AVG(pm25) AS avg_pm25,
        AVG(pm10) AS avg_pm10
    FROM air_quality_data
    GROUP BY station_id
),
RecentAccess AS (
    SELECT 
        station_id,
        MAX(access_datetime) AS last_access
    FROM access_logs
    GROUP BY station_id
),
ActiveAlerts AS (
    SELECT 
        alerts.station_id,
        COUNT(alert_id) AS active_alert_count
    FROM alerts
    WHERE resolved = 0
    GROUP BY alerts.station_id
)
SELECT 
    ms.station_name
FROM AvgAirQuality aq
JOIN monitoring_stations ms ON aq.station_id = ms.station_id
LEFT JOIN RecentAccess ra ON ms.station_id = ra.station_id
LEFT JOIN ActiveAlerts aa ON ms.station_id = aa.station_id
JOIN regions r ON ms.region_id = r.region_id
WHERE aq.avg_pm25 > 35
  AND ra.last_access > DATE('now', '-1 month')
  AND aa.active_alert_count > 0
ORDER BY aq.avg_pm25 DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH RegionData AS (
    SELECT 
        ms.station_id,
        ms.region_id,
        ms.latitude,
        ms.longitude,
        ad.pm25,
        ad.datetime
    FROM monitoring_stations ms
    INNER JOIN air_quality_data ad ON ms.station_id = ad.station_id
    WHERE ad.pm25 IS NOT NULL
),
WeatherImpact AS (
    SELECT wc.weather_id, wc.impact_level, ad.record_id
    FROM weather_conditions wc
    INNER JOIN air_quality_data ad ON wc.weather_id = ad.weather_condition_id
),
SourceInfo AS (
    SELECT source_id, source_name
    FROM data_sources
    WHERE source_name_embedding MATCH '[0.4, 0.6, -0.2, 0.1, 0.5, 0.3, 0.7, -0.1]' AND k = 5
)
SELECT 
    rd.region_id,
    wc.impact_level
FROM RegionData rd
INNER JOIN WeatherImpact wc ON rd.station_id = wc.record_id
WHERE rd.datetime BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-12-31'
GROUP BY rd.region_id, wc.impact_level
ORDER BY rd.region_id, wc.impact_level;

WITH AvgPM25ByStation AS (
    SELECT
        a.station_id,
        AVG(a.pm25) AS avg_pm25,
        s.region_id
    FROM
        air_quality_data a
    JOIN
        monitoring_stations s ON a.station_id = s.station_id
    GROUP BY
        a.station_id, s.region_id
),
RankedStations AS (
    SELECT
        a.station_id,
        a.avg_pm25,
        s.region_id,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.region_id ORDER BY a.avg_pm25 DESC) AS rank
    FROM
        AvgPM25ByStation a
    JOIN
        monitoring_stations s ON a.station_id = s.station_id
)
SELECT
    ms.station_name,
    w.description AS weather_condition
FROM
    RankedStations r
JOIN
    monitoring_stations ms ON r.station_id = ms.station_id
JOIN
    air_quality_data aq ON r.station_id = aq.station_id
JOIN
    weather_conditions w ON aq.weather_condition_id = w.weather_id
WHERE
    r.rank <= 3
ORDER BY
    r.region_id, r.rank;

WITH StationAverages AS (
    SELECT 
        station_id, 
        AVG(pm25) AS avg_pm25
    FROM air_quality_data
    GROUP BY station_id
),
TopStations AS (
    SELECT 
        station_id,
        avg_pm25
    FROM StationAverages
    ORDER BY avg_pm25 DESC
    LIMIT 5
),
SimilarStations AS (
    SELECT 
        ms.station_name,
        ts.avg_pm25,
        similarity.distance AS location_similarity
    FROM TopStations ts
    JOIN monitoring_stations ms ON ts.station_id = ms.station_id
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT 
            station_id,
            distance
        FROM monitoring_stations
        WHERE location_embedding MATCH '[0.1, 0.2, 0.3, ..., 0.384]' -- Replace with actual vector values
        ORDER BY distance
        LIMIT 5
    ) AS similarity ON ms.station_id = similarity.station_id
)
SELECT 
    station_name, 
    avg_pm25
FROM SimilarStations
ORDER BY avg_pm25 DESC;

SELECT
  ms.station_name,
  AVG(aqd.pm25) AS average_pm25
FROM
  air_quality_data aqd
INNER JOIN
  monitoring_stations ms ON aqd.station_id = ms.station_id
WHERE
  ms.operational_status = 'active'
  AND ms.region_id IN (
    SELECT region_id
    FROM regions
    WHERE region_name = 'RegionName' -- Replace 'RegionName' with the desired region name
  )
GROUP BY
  ms.station_name
HAVING
  AVG(aqd.pm25) > 15; -- Example condition for average PM2.5 concentration

WITH RecentAirQuality AS (
    SELECT 
        aqd.station_id, 
        aqd.pm25, 
        aqd.datetime,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY aqd.station_id ORDER BY aqd.datetime DESC) as rn
    FROM air_quality_data aqd
),
HighImpactWeatherStations AS (
    SELECT 
        ms.station_id, 
        ms.station_name, 
        ms.region_id,
        w.impact_level
    FROM monitoring_stations ms
    INNER JOIN weather_conditions w ON ms.station_id = w.weather_id
    WHERE w.impact_level = 'high'
),
StationRegionInfo AS (
    SELECT 
        hs.station_id, 
        hs.station_name,
        r.region_name
    FROM HighImpactWeatherStations hs
    INNER JOIN regions r ON hs.region_id = r.region_id
),
AveragePM25 AS (
    SELECT 
        ri.station_id, 
        ri.station_name, 
        ri.region_name, 
        AVG(ra.pm25) AS avg_pm25
    FROM StationRegionInfo ri
    INNER JOIN RecentAirQuality ra ON ri.station_id = ra.station_id
    WHERE ra.rn = 1
    GROUP BY ri.station_id, ri.station_name, ri.region_name
)
SELECT 
    station_id,
    station_name,
    region_name
FROM AveragePM25
ORDER BY avg_pm25 DESC
LIMIT 10;

WITH StationWeather AS (
    SELECT 
        a.station_id,
        m.station_name,
        wc.description AS weather_description,
        wc.impact_level
    FROM 
        air_quality_data a
    INNER JOIN monitoring_stations m ON a.station_id = m.station_id
    INNER JOIN weather_conditions wc ON a.weather_condition_id = wc.weather_id
),
AveragePollutants AS (
    SELECT 
        station_id,
        AVG(pm25) AS avg_pm25,
        AVG(pm10) AS avg_pm10
    FROM 
        air_quality_data
    GROUP BY 
        station_id
)
SELECT 
    sw.station_name,
    sw.weather_description,
    ap.avg_pm25
FROM 
    StationWeather sw
INNER JOIN AveragePollutants ap ON sw.station_id = ap.station_id
WHERE 
    ap.avg_pm25 > 25
ORDER BY 
    ap.avg_pm25 DESC
LIMIT 10;

WITH AvgPM25PerStation AS (
    SELECT
        a.station_id,
        m.station_name,
        AVG(a.pm25) AS avg_pm25
    FROM
        air_quality_data a
    JOIN
        monitoring_stations m ON a.station_id = m.station_id
    GROUP BY
        a.station_id
),
RankedStations AS (
    SELECT
        station_id,
        station_name,
        avg_pm25,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY avg_pm25 DESC) AS rank
    FROM
        AvgPM25PerStation
)
SELECT
    rs.station_name,
    wc.description AS weather_condition
FROM
    RankedStations rs
JOIN
    air_quality_data a ON rs.station_id = a.station_id
JOIN
    weather_conditions wc ON a.weather_condition_id = wc.weather_id
WHERE
    rs.rank <= 5
ORDER BY
    rs.avg_pm25 DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, AVG(aqd.pm25) AS average_pm25
FROM air_quality_data aqd
INNER JOIN monitoring_stations ms ON aqd.station_id = ms.station_id
INNER JOIN regions r ON ms.region_id = r.region_id
WHERE aqd.pm25 IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY r.region_name
HAVING AVG(aqd.pm25) > 25;

SELECT r.region_name, AVG(a.pm25) AS average_pm25
FROM air_quality_data a
INNER JOIN monitoring_stations m ON a.station_id = m.station_id
INNER JOIN regions r ON m.region_id = r.region_id
WHERE m.operational_status = 'active' AND a.weather_condition_id IN (
  SELECT weather_id 
  FROM weather_conditions 
  WHERE impact_level = 'high'
)
GROUP BY r.region_name;

WITH RECURSIVE StationHierarchy AS (
    SELECT station_id, station_name, region_id, 1 as level
    FROM monitoring_stations
    WHERE operational_status = 'active'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT s.station_id, s.station_name, s.region_id, sh.level + 1
    FROM monitoring_stations s
    JOIN StationHierarchy sh ON s.region_id = sh.region_id
),
WeatherImpact AS (
    SELECT aq.record_id, aq.station_id, wc.weather_id, wc.impact_level, aq.pm25, aq.datetime
    FROM air_quality_data aq
    JOIN weather_conditions wc ON aq.weather_condition_id = wc.weather_id
    WHERE wc.impact_level = 'high'
),
StationWeatherData AS (
    SELECT sh.station_id, sh.station_name, wi.datetime, wi.pm25
    FROM StationHierarchy sh
    INNER JOIN WeatherImpact wi ON sh.station_id = wi.station_id
),
RegionStats AS (
    SELECT sh.region_id, COUNT(sh.station_id) AS active_stations_count, AVG(sw.pm25) AS average_pm25
    FROM StationHierarchy sh
    INNER JOIN StationWeatherData sw ON sh.station_id = sw.station_id
    GROUP BY sh.region_id
)
SELECT rs.region_id,
    SUM(rs.average_pm25) OVER (ORDER BY rs.region_id) AS cumulative_average_pm25
FROM RegionStats rs
ORDER BY rs.region_id;

WITH StationAirQuality AS (
    SELECT
        a.record_id,
        a.station_id,
        a.datetime,
        a.pm25,
        a.pm10,
        m.station_name,
        m.location,
        m.latitude,
        m.longitude,
        m.region_id
    FROM
        air_quality_data a
    JOIN monitoring_stations m ON a.station_id = m.station_id
),

RegionAirQualitySummary AS (
    SELECT
        sa.region_id,
        AVG(sa.pm25) AS avg_pm25,
        AVG(sa.pm10) AS avg_pm10,
        MAX(sa.pm25) AS max_pm25,
        MAX(sa.pm10) AS max_pm10
    FROM
        StationAirQuality sa
    GROUP BY sa.region_id
),

AlertAnalysis AS (
    SELECT
        a.station_id,
        COUNT(*) AS total_alerts,
        SUM(CASE WHEN a.resolved = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS resolved_alerts
    FROM
        alerts a
    GROUP BY a.station_id
),

JoinAnalysis AS (
    SELECT
        ra.region_id,
        ra.avg_pm25,
        ra.avg_pm10,
        ra.max_pm25,
        ra.max_pm10,
        aa.total_alerts,
        aa.resolved_alerts
    FROM
        RegionAirQualitySummary ra
    LEFT JOIN AlertAnalysis aa ON ra.region_id = aa.station_id
)

SELECT
    ja.region_id,
    ja.avg_pm25
FROM
    JoinAnalysis ja
ORDER BY
    ja.avg_pm25 DESC;

WITH StationPM25 AS (
    SELECT 
        a.station_id, 
        AVG(a.pm25) AS avg_pm25
    FROM air_quality_data a
    GROUP BY a.station_id
    ORDER BY avg_pm25 DESC
    LIMIT 5
),
LatestAlerts AS (
    SELECT 
        al.station_id,
        al.datetime AS alert_datetime,
        al.description AS alert_description
    FROM alerts al
    INNER JOIN StationPM25 sp ON al.station_id = sp.station_id
    WHERE al.resolved = 0
    ORDER BY al.datetime DESC
),
WeatherConditionDesc AS (
    SELECT 
        w.weather_id,
        w.description AS weather_description
    FROM weather_conditions w
    WHERE w.weather_id IN (
        SELECT DISTINCT a.weather_condition_id
        FROM air_quality_data a
        INNER JOIN StationPM25 sp ON a.station_id = sp.station_id
    )
)
SELECT 
    m.station_name,
    m.location,
    al.alert_datetime,
    al.alert_description,
    wc.weather_description
FROM monitoring_stations m
INNER JOIN StationPM25 sp ON m.station_id = sp.station_id
LEFT JOIN LatestAlerts al ON m.station_id = al.station_id
LEFT JOIN WeatherConditionDesc wc ON wc.weather_id = (
    SELECT a.weather_condition_id
    FROM air_quality_data a
    WHERE a.station_id = m.station_id
    ORDER BY a.datetime DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
ORDER BY sp.avg_pm25 DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT r.region_name, AVG(aqd.pm25) AS average_pm25
FROM air_quality_data aqd
INNER JOIN monitoring_stations ms ON aqd.station_id = ms.station_id
INNER JOIN regions r ON ms.region_id = r.region_id
INNER JOIN weather_conditions wc ON aqd.weather_condition_id = wc.weather_id
WHERE ms.operational_status = 'active' AND wc.impact_level = 'high'
GROUP BY r.region_name;

WITH StationAvgPM25 AS (
    SELECT 
        a.station_id,
        m.station_name,
        r.region_name,
        AVG(a.pm25) AS avg_pm25
    FROM 
        air_quality_data a
    INNER JOIN 
        monitoring_stations m ON a.station_id = m.station_id
    INNER JOIN 
        regions r ON m.region_id = r.region_id
    GROUP BY 
        a.station_id
),
RankedStations AS (
    SELECT 
        station_id,
        station_name,
        region_name,
        avg_pm25,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY avg_pm25 DESC) AS rank
    FROM 
        StationAvgPM25
)
SELECT 
    station_name,
    region_name,
    avg_pm25
FROM 
    RankedStations
WHERE 
    rank <= 3;

SELECT 
  wc.description AS weather_condition,
  ms.station_name AS monitoring_station,
  AVG(aqd.pm25) AS average_pm25
FROM 
  air_quality_data aqd
INNER JOIN 
  monitoring_stations ms ON aqd.station_id = ms.station_id
LEFT JOIN 
  weather_conditions wc ON aqd.weather_condition_id = wc.weather_id
WHERE 
  ms.operational_status = 'active'
GROUP BY 
  wc.description, ms.station_name
HAVING 
  AVG(aqd.pm25) > 10;

SELECT 
    r.region_name,
    AVG(aqd.pm25) AS average_pm25
FROM 
    air_quality_data aqd
INNER JOIN 
    monitoring_stations ms ON aqd.station_id = ms.station_id
INNER JOIN 
    regions r ON ms.region_id = r.region_id
INNER JOIN 
    weather_conditions wc ON aqd.weather_condition_id = wc.weather_id
WHERE 
    ms.operational_status = 'active'
    AND wc.impact_level IN ('low', 'moderate')
GROUP BY 
    r.region_name
HAVING 
    AVG(aqd.pm25) > 10

WITH StationAlerts AS (
    SELECT
        a.station_id,
        COUNT(a.alert_id) AS total_alerts,
        SUM(CASE WHEN a.alert_level = 'high' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_alerts
    FROM alerts a
    WHERE a.resolved = 0
    GROUP BY a.station_id
),
StationData AS (
    SELECT
        aq.station_id,
        AVG(aq.pm25) AS avg_pm25,
        AVG(aq.pm10) AS avg_pm10
    FROM air_quality_data aq
    WHERE aq.datetime BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-12-31'
    GROUP BY aq.station_id
),
RankedStations AS (
    SELECT
        sd.station_id,
        ms.station_name,
        sd.avg_pm25,
        sd.avg_pm10,
        sa.total_alerts,
        sa.high_alerts,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY sa.high_alerts DESC, sd.avg_pm25 DESC) AS station_rank
    FROM StationData sd
    INNER JOIN StationAlerts sa ON sd.station_id = sa.station_id
    INNER JOIN monitoring_stations ms ON sd.station_id = ms.station_id
)
SELECT
    station_name,
    avg_pm25,
    avg_pm10,
    station_rank
FROM RankedStations
WHERE station_rank <= 10;

WITH WeatherImpactPM25 AS (
    SELECT 
        w.impact_level,
        m.region_id,
        AVG(aq.pm25) AS avg_pm25
    FROM air_quality_data aq
    JOIN weather_conditions w ON aq.weather_condition_id = w.weather_id
    JOIN monitoring_stations m ON aq.station_id = m.station_id
    GROUP BY w.impact_level, m.region_id
),
AlertCounts AS (
    SELECT 
        w.impact_level,
        m.region_id,
        COUNT(a.alert_id) AS alert_count
    FROM alerts a
    JOIN monitoring_stations m ON a.station_id = m.station_id
    JOIN air_quality_data aq ON m.station_id = aq.station_id
    JOIN weather_conditions w ON aq.weather_condition_id = w.weather_id
    GROUP BY w.impact_level, m.region_id
)
SELECT 
    wip.impact_level,
    SUM(wip.avg_pm25) OVER (PARTITION BY wip.region_id ORDER BY wip.impact_level) AS cumulative_avg_pm25
FROM WeatherImpactPM25 wip
JOIN AlertCounts ac ON wip.impact_level = ac.impact_level AND wip.region_id = ac.region_id
ORDER BY wip.region_id, wip.impact_level;

SELECT
  ms.station_name,
  wd.description AS weather_description,
  ROUND(AVG(aqd.pm25), 2) AS avg_pm25,
  COUNT(aqd.record_id) AS total_records
FROM air_quality_data aqd
INNER JOIN monitoring_stations ms ON aqd.station_id = ms.station_id
LEFT JOIN weather_conditions wd ON aqd.weather_condition_id = wd.weather_id
WHERE aqd.temperature > 15 AND ms.operational_status = 'active'
GROUP BY ms.station_name, wd.description
HAVING avg_pm25 > 25

SELECT r.region_name, AVG(aqd.pm25) AS average_pm25
FROM air_quality_data aqd
INNER JOIN monitoring_stations ms ON aqd.station_id = ms.station_id
INNER JOIN regions r ON ms.region_id = r.region_id
WHERE ms.operational_status = 'active'
GROUP BY r.region_name
HAVING COUNT(aqd.record_id) > 0;

SELECT
  a.record_id,
  m.station_name,
  r.region_name,
  AVG(a.pm25) AS average_pm25
FROM air_quality_data a
JOIN monitoring_stations m ON a.station_id = m.station_id
JOIN regions r ON m.region_id = r.region_id
JOIN weather_conditions w ON a.weather_condition_id = w.weather_id
WHERE w.impact_level = 'high' AND r.region_name LIKE '%urban%'
GROUP BY a.record_id, m.station_name, r.region_name
HAVING AVG(a.pm25) > 35;

WITH RankedAirQuality AS (
    SELECT 
        a.record_id, 
        a.station_id, 
        a.datetime, 
        a.pm25, 
        a.pm10, 
        a.temperature, 
        a.humidity, 
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.station_id ORDER BY a.pm25 DESC) AS pm25_rank
    FROM 
        air_quality_data a
    WHERE 
        a.pm25 > 35  -- Focus on records with PM2.5 levels above a significant threshold
),
StationInfo AS (
    SELECT 
        ms.station_id, 
        ms.station_name, 
        ms.location, 
        r.region_name
    FROM 
        monitoring_stations ms
    INNER JOIN 
        regions r ON ms.region_id = r.region_id
),
PollutantInfo AS (
    SELECT 
        p.pollutant_id, 
        p.pollutant_name
    FROM 
        pollutants p
    WHERE 
        p.unit = 'micrograms per cubic meter'
)
SELECT 
    s.station_name
FROM 
    RankedAirQuality ra
INNER JOIN 
    StationInfo s ON ra.station_id = s.station_id
INNER JOIN 
    PollutantInfo p ON p.pollutant_name = 'PM2.5'
WHERE 
    ra.pm25_rank <= 10  -- Get the top 10 PM2.5 readings per station
ORDER BY 
    ra.pm25 DESC;

SELECT
  datetime,
  pm25,
  pm10,
  temperature
FROM
  air_quality_data
WHERE
  pm25 > 50 OR pm10 > 100
ORDER BY
  datetime DESC;

SELECT 
    ms.station_name,
    AVG(aqd.pm25) AS average_pm25
FROM 
    air_quality_data aqd
INNER JOIN 
    monitoring_stations ms ON aqd.station_id = ms.station_id
WHERE 
    ms.operational_status = 'active'
    AND aqd.pm25 > 50
GROUP BY 
    ms.station_name
ORDER BY 
    average_pm25 DESC;

WITH WeatherImpact AS (
    SELECT w.weather_id, w.description, w.impact_level,
           COUNT(a.record_id) AS total_records
    FROM air_quality_data a
    JOIN weather_conditions w ON a.weather_condition_id = w.weather_id
    GROUP BY w.weather_id
),
StationData AS (
    SELECT s.station_id, s.station_name, s.region_id,
           AVG(a.pm25) AS avg_pm25, AVG(a.pm10) AS avg_pm10,
           AVG(a.temperature) AS avg_temperature, AVG(a.humidity) AS avg_humidity
    FROM air_quality_data a
    JOIN monitoring_stations s ON a.station_id = s.station_id
    GROUP BY s.station_id
),
RegionStats AS (
    SELECT r.region_id, r.region_name,
           COUNT(s.station_id) AS num_stations, 
           AVG(sd.avg_pm25) AS region_avg_pm25, AVG(sd.avg_pm10) AS region_avg_pm10
    FROM monitoring_stations s
    JOIN regions r ON s.region_id = r.region_id
    JOIN StationData sd ON s.station_id = sd.station_id
    GROUP BY r.region_id
)
SELECT wi.description AS weather_description, wi.impact_level, wi.total_records,
       rs.region_name, rs.num_stations, rs.region_avg_pm25, rs.region_avg_pm10
FROM WeatherImpact wi
JOIN RegionStats rs ON wi.weather_id < rs.region_id -- Assuming a logic to match or combine
ORDER BY wi.total_records DESC, rs.num_stations DESC
LIMIT 10;

WITH AveragePM25CTE AS (
    SELECT 
        station_id, 
        AVG(pm25) AS avg_pm25
    FROM 
        air_quality_data
    WHERE 
        datetime >= '2023-01-01' AND datetime <= '2023-12-31'
    GROUP BY 
        station_id
)
SELECT 
    ms.station_name, 
    ap.avg_pm25
FROM 
    AveragePM25CTE ap
INNER JOIN 
    monitoring_stations ms ON ap.station_id = ms.station_id
WHERE 
    ms.operational_status = 'active'
ORDER BY 
    ap.avg_pm25 DESC
LIMIT 5;

WITH RECURSIVE StationHierarchy AS (
    SELECT
        ms.station_id,
        ms.station_name,
        ms.region_id,
        ms.operational_status,
        1 AS level
    FROM monitoring_stations ms
    WHERE ms.operational_status = 'active'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        m.station_id,
        m.station_name,
        m.region_id,
        m.operational_status,
        sh.level + 1
    FROM monitoring_stations m
    JOIN StationHierarchy sh ON m.region_id = sh.region_id
    WHERE m.operational_status = 'active'
),
ActiveAlerts AS (
    SELECT
        a.alert_id,
        a.station_id,
        a.datetime,
        a.alert_level,
        a.description,
        a.resolved
    FROM alerts a
    WHERE a.resolved = 0
),
AlertImpacts AS (
    SELECT
        wa.weather_id,
        wa.description,
        wa.impact_level,
        COUNT(aa.alert_id) AS unresolved_alerts
    FROM ActiveAlerts aa
    INNER JOIN air_quality_data aqd ON aa.station_id = aqd.station_id
    INNER JOIN weather_conditions wa ON aqd.weather_condition_id = wa.weather_id
    GROUP BY wa.weather_id
),
StationReports AS (
    SELECT
        sr.station_id,
        r.generated_date,
        r.summary
    FROM reports r
    INNER JOIN monitoring_stations sr ON r.station_id = sr.station_id
    WHERE r.generated_date > DATE('now', '-1 month')
),
OperationalStatistics AS (
    SELECT
        sh.station_name,
        sh.level,
        SUM(aqd.pm25) OVER (PARTITION BY sh.region_id ORDER BY sh.level) AS cumulative_pm25,
        SUM(aqd.pm10) OVER (PARTITION BY sh.region_id ORDER BY sh.level) AS cumulative_pm10
    FROM StationHierarchy sh
    INNER JOIN air_quality_data aqd ON sh.station_id = aqd.station_id
)
SELECT
    os.station_name
FROM OperationalStatistics os
INNER JOIN StationReports sr ON os.station_name = sr.station_id
ORDER BY os.station_name;

SELECT pm25, pm10
FROM air_quality_data
WHERE temperature > 25
ORDER BY datetime DESC;

WITH StationInfo AS (
    SELECT 
        ms.station_id, 
        ms.station_name, 
        ms.region_id
    FROM monitoring_stations ms
    WHERE ms.operational_status = 'active'
),
WeatherImpact AS (
    SELECT 
        aq.station_id,
        wc.impact_level,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY aq.station_id) AS impact_count
    FROM air_quality_data aq
    JOIN weather_conditions wc ON aq.weather_condition_id = wc.weather_id
),
RecentAlerts AS (
    SELECT 
        a.station_id,
        a.alert_level,
        a.description
    FROM alerts a
    WHERE a.resolved = 0
    ORDER BY a.datetime DESC
    LIMIT 5
),
NearestStations AS (
    SELECT 
        station_id,
        distance
    FROM monitoring_stations
    WHERE location_embedding MATCH '[0.0, 0.0, 0.0, ..., 0.0]' -- Placeholder vector
    ORDER BY distance
    LIMIT 10
)
SELECT 
    si.station_name, 
    wi.impact_level, 
    ra.alert_level
FROM NearestStations ns
JOIN StationInfo si ON ns.station_id = si.station_id
LEFT JOIN WeatherImpact wi ON si.station_id = wi.station_id
LEFT JOIN RecentAlerts ra ON si.station_id = ra.station_id
ORDER BY ns.distance, wi.impact_count DESC;

WITH RECURSIVE PollutionSourceImpact AS (
    SELECT
        a.record_id,
        m.station_name,
        m.station_name_embedding,
        a.pm25,
        a.pm10,
        a.source_id,
        1 AS level
    FROM air_quality_data a
    JOIN monitoring_stations m ON a.station_id = m.station_id
    WHERE a.datetime BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-12-31'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        a.record_id,
        m.station_name,
        m.station_name_embedding,
        a.pm25,
        a.pm10,
        a.source_id,
        psi.level + 1
    FROM air_quality_data a
    JOIN PollutionSourceImpact psi ON a.source_id = psi.source_id
    JOIN monitoring_stations m ON a.station_id = m.station_id
),
WeatherConditionImpact AS (
    SELECT
        w.weather_id,
        w.description,
        a.record_id,
        a.pm25,
        a.pm10
    FROM air_quality_data a
    JOIN weather_conditions w ON a.weather_condition_id = w.weather_id
),
DataSourceReliability AS (
    SELECT
        ds.source_id,
        ds.source_name,
        ds.source_name_embedding,
        COUNT(a.record_id) AS data_count
    FROM air_quality_data a
    JOIN data_sources ds ON a.source_id = ds.source_id
    GROUP BY ds.source_id
)
SELECT
    m.station_name,
    ds.source_name,
    SUM(p.pm25 + p.pm10) OVER (PARTITION BY m.station_id) AS total_pollution
FROM PollutionSourceImpact p
JOIN WeatherConditionImpact w ON p.record_id = w.record_id
JOIN monitoring_stations m ON p.station_name_embedding = m.station_name_embedding
JOIN DataSourceReliability ds ON p.source_id = ds.source_id
WHERE ds.source_name_embedding MATCH '[0.1, 0.2, 0.3, ..., 0.4]' -- Replace with a real vector
ORDER BY total_pollution DESC;

WITH HighImpactWeather AS (
    SELECT weather_id, description
    FROM weather_conditions
    WHERE LOWER(impact_level) = 'high'
),
NearestStations AS (
    SELECT station_id, station_name
    FROM monitoring_stations
    WHERE location_embedding MATCH '[0.1, 0.2, 0.3, ..., 0.384]' -- Replace with a real 384-dimensional vector
    ORDER BY distance
    LIMIT 5
)
SELECT aq.datetime
FROM air_quality_data aq
INNER JOIN HighImpactWeather hw ON aq.weather_condition_id = hw.weather_id
INNER JOIN NearestStations ns ON aq.station_id = ns.station_id
WHERE aq.pm25 > 50 AND aq.humidity > 70
ORDER BY aq.datetime DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
  ms.station_name, 
  AVG(aqd.pm25) AS average_pm25, 
  AVG(aqd.pm10) AS average_pm10, 
  wc.description AS weather_condition
FROM air_quality_data aqd
INNER JOIN monitoring_stations ms ON aqd.station_id = ms.station_id
LEFT JOIN weather_conditions wc ON aqd.weather_condition_id = wc.weather_id
WHERE ms.operational_status = 'active'
GROUP BY ms.station_name, wc.description
HAVING AVG(aqd.pm25) > 0 OR AVG(aqd.pm10) > 0;

WITH HighAlertStations AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT a.station_id
    FROM alerts a
    WHERE a.alert_level = 'high'
),
AveragePM25 AS (
    SELECT m.station_name, AVG(aqd.pm25) AS avg_pm25
    FROM air_quality_data aqd
    INNER JOIN HighAlertStations has ON aqd.station_id = has.station_id
    INNER JOIN monitoring_stations m ON aqd.station_id = m.station_id
    GROUP BY m.station_name
)
SELECT avg_pm25
FROM AveragePM25
ORDER BY avg_pm25 DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    aq.record_id,
    ms.station_name,
    wc.description AS weather_description,
    AVG(aq.pm25) AS average_pm25
FROM 
    air_quality_data aq
INNER JOIN 
    monitoring_stations ms ON aq.station_id = ms.station_id
LEFT JOIN 
    weather_conditions wc ON aq.weather_condition_id = wc.weather_id
WHERE 
    aq.datetime BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-12-31'
GROUP BY 
    aq.record_id, ms.station_name, wc.description
HAVING 
    AVG(aq.pm25) > 35.0;

-- Define a recursive CTE to get a cumulative hierarchy of alerts for each station
WITH RECURSIVE AlertHierarchy AS (
    SELECT a.station_id, a.alert_id, a.alert_level, a.datetime, 1 AS level
    FROM alerts a
    WHERE a.resolved = 0
    UNION ALL
    SELECT ah.station_id, a.alert_id, a.alert_level, a.datetime, ah.level + 1
    FROM alerts a
    JOIN AlertHierarchy ah ON a.station_id = ah.station_id
    WHERE a.resolved = 0 AND a.datetime > ah.datetime
),

-- Calculate average PM25 concentrations by station and date
AvgPM25 AS (
    SELECT station_id, date(datetime) AS date, AVG(pm25) AS avg_pm25
    FROM air_quality_data
    GROUP BY station_id, date
),

-- Aggregate weather impacts by station
WeatherImpact AS (
    SELECT aqd.station_id, wc.description AS weather_description, wc.impact_level
    FROM air_quality_data aqd
    JOIN weather_conditions wc ON aqd.weather_condition_id = wc.weather_id
),

-- Combine air quality data with station details and region information
StationData AS (
    SELECT ms.station_id, ms.station_name, ms.operational_status, r.region_name,
           aqd.datetime, aqd.pm25, aqd.pm10, aqd.temperature, aqd.humidity,
           wi.weather_description, wi.impact_level
    FROM air_quality_data aqd
    JOIN monitoring_stations ms ON aqd.station_id = ms.station_id
    JOIN regions r ON ms.region_id = r.region_id
    LEFT JOIN WeatherImpact wi ON aqd.station_id = wi.station_id
)

-- Final query that selects the cumulative PM2.5 levels, average PM2.5, and alert hierarchy
SELECT sd.station_name, sd.region_name, sd.operational_status,
       SUM(sd.pm25) OVER (PARTITION BY sd.station_id ORDER BY sd.datetime) AS cumulative_pm25,
       ap.avg_pm25,
       ah.alert_level,
       ah.level AS alert_hierarchy_level
FROM StationData sd
LEFT JOIN AvgPM25 ap ON sd.station_id = ap.station_id AND date(sd.datetime) = ap.date
LEFT JOIN AlertHierarchy ah ON sd.station_id = ah.station_id;

WITH HighImpactWeather AS (
    SELECT weather_id, description
    FROM weather_conditions
    WHERE impact_level = 'high'
),
HighPM25Readings AS (
    SELECT station_id, MAX(pm25) as max_pm25
    FROM air_quality_data
    GROUP BY station_id
    HAVING max_pm25 > 100
)
SELECT ms.station_name, wi.description
FROM HighPM25Readings hpr
JOIN monitoring_stations ms ON hpr.station_id = ms.station_id
JOIN air_quality_data aq ON hpr.station_id = aq.station_id
JOIN HighImpactWeather wi ON aq.weather_condition_id = wi.weather_id
WHERE ms.operational_status = 'active'
ORDER BY hpr.max_pm25 DESC;

SELECT record_id, pm25, temperature
FROM air_quality_data
WHERE datetime > '2023-01-01'
ORDER BY datetime DESC;

WITH AvgPM25 AS (
    SELECT 
        m.station_name,

    FROM

)
SELECT

WITH StationWeatherCTE AS (
    SELECT 
        aq.record_id,
        ms.station_name,

        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ms.station_id ORDER BY aq.datetime DESC) AS weather_rank
    FROM air_quality_data aq

    JOIN weather_conditions wc ON aq.weather_condition_id = wc.weather_id

),
AlertStationCTE AS (

    WHERE a.resolved = 0
),
TopWeatherStations AS (
    SELECT station_name

    WHERE weather_rank = 1
),
TopAlertStations AS (
    SELECT station_name
    FROM AlertStationCTE
    WHERE alert_rank = 1
)
SELECT tws.station_name, tas.station_name
FROM TopWeatherStations tws
JOIN TopAlertStations tas ON tws.station_name = tas.station_name;

WITH MaxPM25 AS (

        station_id,

    FROM

    GROUP BY

),
MaxStation AS (

)
SELECT

FROM

SELECT ms.station_name, AVG(aqd.pm25) AS average_pm25
FROM air_quality_data aqd
INNER JOIN monitoring_stations ms ON aqd.station_id = ms.station_id
INNER JOIN regions r ON ms.region_id = r.region_id

GROUP BY ms.station_name
HAVING AVG(aqd.pm25) > 0;

WITH HighImpactWeather AS (

    FROM weather_conditions
    WHERE impact_level = 'high'
),
WeatherAirQuality AS (
    SELECT

    FROM air_quality_data aq
    INNER JOIN HighImpactWeather hw ON aq.weather_condition_id = hw.weather_id

),
StationAlerts AS (

WITH StationData AS (

    FROM monitoring_stations ms
),

WeatherImpact AS (

),

RecentAirQuality AS (

CombinedData AS (

)

SELECT

SELECT 
  ms.station_name, 
  wc.description AS weather_description,
  AVG(aqd.pm25) AS average_pm25
FROM 
  air_quality_data aqd
INNER JOIN

INNER JOIN

HAVING

WITH StationAirQuality AS (
    SELECT
        aq.record_id,
        s.station_name,
        aq.pm25,
        aq.pm10,
        aq.temperature,
        aq.humidity,
        aq.datetime,

    saq.rank = 1;

WITH HighestAlertCTE AS (

    WHERE resolved = 1
    GROUP BY station_id
)
SELECT ms.station_name
FROM HighestAlertCTE ha
JOIN monitoring_stations ms ON ha.station_id = ms.station_id
WHERE ha.max_alert_level = (
    SELECT MAX(max_alert_level)
    FROM HighestAlertCTE
);

SELECT ms.station_name, wc.description, AVG(aqd.pm25) AS average_pm25
FROM air_quality_data aqd
INNER JOIN monitoring_stations ms ON aqd.station_id = ms.station_id
INNER JOIN weather_conditions wc ON aqd.weather_condition_id = wc.weather_id
WHERE ms.operational_status = 'active' AND wc.impact_level = 'high'
GROUP BY ms.station_name, wc.description
HAVING AVG(aqd.pm25) > 25;

WITH AvgPM25 AS (
    SELECT
        a.station_id,
        AVG(a.pm25) AS avg_pm25
    FROM air_quality_data a
    JOIN monitoring_stations m ON a.station_id = m.station_id
    WHERE m.operational_status = 'active'
    GROUP BY a.station_id
),
TopStations AS (
    SELECT
        station_id,
        avg_pm25,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY avg_pm25 DESC) AS rank
    FROM AvgPM25
)
SELECT
    m.station_name,
    ts.avg_pm25,
    COALESCE(al.alert_level, 'No Alerts') AS latest_alert_level
FROM TopStations ts
JOIN monitoring_stations m ON ts.station_id = m.station_id
LEFT JOIN alerts al ON m.station_id = al.station_id AND al.datetime = (
    SELECT MAX(datetime)
    FROM alerts
    WHERE alerts.station_id = m.station_id
)
WHERE ts.rank <= 3;

WITH RECURSIVE WeatherImpactHierarchy AS (
    SELECT weather_id, description, impact_level, 1 AS level
    FROM weather_conditions
    WHERE impact_level = 'high'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT wc.weather_id, wc.description, wc.impact_level, wih.level + 1
    FROM weather_conditions wc
    JOIN WeatherImpactHierarchy wih ON wc.weather_id = wih.weather_id
),
StationPollutionStats AS (
    SELECT ms.station_id, ms.station_name, region_id, AVG(ad.pm25) AS avg_pm25, AVG(ad.pm10) AS avg_pm10
    FROM monitoring_stations ms
    INNER JOIN air_quality_data ad ON ms.station_id = ad.station_id
    GROUP BY ms.station_id, ms.station_name, region_id
),
RegionPollutionImpact AS (
    SELECT r.region_id, r.region_name, AVG(sp.avg_pm25) AS region_avg_pm25, AVG(sp.avg_pm10) AS region_avg_pm10
    FROM regions r
    INNER JOIN StationPollutionStats sp ON r.region_id = sp.region_id
    GROUP BY r.region_id, r.region_name
),
HighImpactWeatherStations AS (
    SELECT ms.station_id, ms.station_name, COUNT(wih.weather_id) AS high_impact_weather_count
    FROM monitoring_stations ms
    INNER JOIN air_quality_data ad ON ms.station_id = ad.station_id
    INNER JOIN WeatherImpactHierarchy wih ON ad.weather_condition_id = wih.weather_id
    GROUP BY ms.station_id, ms.station_name
)
SELECT 
    sp.station_name,
    (sp.avg_pm25 + sp.avg_pm10) / 2.0 AS avg_pollution_score,
    hiws.high_impact_weather_count
FROM StationPollutionStats sp
INNER JOIN HighImpactWeatherStations hiws ON sp.station_id = hiws.station_id
ORDER BY avg_pollution_score DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH StationWeatherData AS (
    SELECT
        aq.station_id,
        ms.station_name,
        aq.datetime,
        aq.pm25,
        wc.description AS weather_description,
        ds.source_name,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY aq.station_id ORDER BY aq.pm25 DESC) AS rank
    FROM air_quality_data aq
    JOIN monitoring_stations ms ON aq.station_id = ms.station_id
    JOIN weather_conditions wc ON aq.weather_condition_id = wc.weather_id
    JOIN data_sources ds ON aq.source_id = ds.source_id
    WHERE wc.impact_level = 'high' AND ms.operational_status = 'active'
)
SELECT station_name
FROM StationWeatherData
WHERE rank = 1;

-- CTE for summarizing air quality data by station and date
WITH AirQualitySummary AS (
    SELECT
        station_id,
        date(datetime) AS date,
        AVG(pm25) AS avg_pm25,
        AVG(pm10) AS avg_pm10
    FROM air_quality_data
    GROUP BY station_id, date(datetime)
),

-- CTE for fetching station information
StationInfo AS (
    SELECT
        ms.station_id,
        ms.station_name,
        ms.location,
        ms.latitude,
        ms.longitude,
        r.region_name
    FROM monitoring_stations AS ms
    JOIN regions AS r ON ms.region_id = r.region_id
),

-- Combine air quality summary with station information
CombinedData AS (
    SELECT
        aqs.station_id,
        aqs.date,
        aqs.avg_pm25,
        aqs.avg_pm10,
        si.station_name,
        si.location,
        si.latitude,
        si.longitude,
        si.region_name
    FROM AirQualitySummary AS aqs
    JOIN StationInfo AS si ON aqs.station_id = si.station_id
),

-- Final query to select and analyze the average PM2.5 level over time using window functions
FinalAnalysis AS (
    SELECT
        cd.station_id,
        cd.date,
        cd.avg_pm25,
        cd.station_name,
        cd.region_name,
        AVG(cd.avg_pm25) OVER (PARTITION BY cd.station_id ORDER BY cd.date) AS trend_avg_pm25
    FROM CombinedData AS cd
)

-- Select final result, focusing on one column: trend of average PM2.5
SELECT
    trend_avg_pm25
FROM FinalAnalysis
ORDER BY station_id, date;

WITH StationWeather AS (

TopStations AS (

SELECT

WITH StationDetails AS (

        ms.station_id, 
        ms.station_name,

    LEFT JOIN monitoring_stations_info msi ON msi.key = 'CREATE_VERSION'

WeatherImpact AS (

),
AirQualityMetrics AS (

KnnPollutants AS (

)

ORDER BY aqm.avg_pm25 DESC
LIMIT 10;

WITH 
WeatherImpact AS (

        w.weather_id,

),
StationPollutants AS (

),
AccessInfo AS (

CombinedData AS (

    LEFT JOIN AccessInfo ai ON sp.station_id = ai.station_id
)
SELECT

WeatherImpact AS (

PollutionAlerts AS (

RegionPollutionStats AS (

FinalStats AS (

WITH AvgPM25 AS (

StationPMData AS (

WITH WeatherImpact AS (

StationInfo AS (

HighImpactStations AS (

RegionStats AS (

FinalAnalysis AS (

AlertFrequencyCTE AS (

RecentAirQuality AS (

WeatherImpact AS (

),
StationWeatherImpact AS (

NearbyStations AS (

StationData AS (

WITH RECURSIVE WeatherImpactHierarchy AS (

StationQualityData AS (

RegionStats AS (

GROUP BY ms.station_name, wc.description
HAVING AVG(aqd.pm25) > 35.0;

SELECT ms.station_name, AVG(aq.pm25) AS average_pm25
  FROM air_quality_data aq
  INNER JOIN monitoring_stations ms ON aq.station_id = ms.station_id
  INNER JOIN alerts al ON ms.station_id = al.station_id
  WHERE al.resolved = 0
  GROUP BY ms.station_name
  HAVING AVG(aq.pm25) > 35

WITH LatestReadings AS (
    SELECT 
        a.record_id,
        a.station_id,
        a.datetime,
        a.pm25,
        a.pm10,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.station_id ORDER BY a.datetime DESC) AS rn
    FROM 
        air_quality_data a
)
SELECT 
    m.station_name, 
    l.pm25
FROM 
    LatestReadings l
JOIN 
    monitoring_stations m ON l.station_id = m.station_id
WHERE 
    l.rn = 1;

SELECT ms.station_name, ms.location, AVG(aqd.pm25) AS average_pm25
FROM air_quality_data aqd
INNER JOIN monitoring_stations ms ON aqd.station_id = ms.station_id
GROUP BY aqd.station_id
ORDER BY average_pm25 DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH StationAirQuality AS (
    SELECT aq.record_id, aq.station_id, aq.pm25, aq.pm10, ms.station_name, ms.region_id
    FROM air_quality_data aq
    JOIN monitoring_stations ms ON aq.station_id = ms.station_id
    WHERE aq.pm25 > 50 AND aq.pm10 > 100
),
WeatherImpact AS (
    SELECT wc.weather_id, wc.description, wc.impact_level, aq.weather_condition_id
    FROM air_quality_data aq
    JOIN weather_conditions wc ON aq.weather_condition_id = wc.weather_id
    WHERE wc.impact_level = 'high'
),
DataSourceInfo AS (
    SELECT ds.source_id, ds.source_name, ds.source_type
    FROM data_sources ds
    WHERE ds.source_type = 'government'
),
RegionInfo AS (
    SELECT r.region_id, r.region_name
    FROM regions r
)
SELECT 
    saq.station_name, wi.description
FROM StationAirQuality saq
JOIN WeatherImpact wi ON saq.record_id = wi.weather_condition_id
JOIN DataSourceInfo dsi ON saq.station_id = dsi.source_id
JOIN RegionInfo ri ON saq.region_id = ri.region_id
ORDER BY saq.station_name, wi.description;

WITH RecursiveStationHierarchy AS (
    SELECT station_id, station_name, region_id, installation_date, operational_status, 1 AS level
    FROM monitoring_stations
    WHERE operational_status = 'active'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT ms.station_id, ms.station_name, ms.region_id, ms.installation_date, ms.operational_status, rsh.level + 1
    FROM monitoring_stations ms
    JOIN RecursiveStationHierarchy rsh ON ms.region_id = rsh.region_id
),
StationAlertData AS (
    SELECT rsh.station_id, rsh.station_name, a.alert_level, a.datetime
    FROM RecursiveStationHierarchy rsh
    INNER JOIN alerts a ON rsh.station_id = a.station_id
    WHERE a.resolved = 0
),
AveragePMData AS (
    SELECT station_id, AVG(pm25) AS avg_pm25, AVG(pm10) AS avg_pm10
    FROM air_quality_data
    GROUP BY station_id
),
FilteredData AS (
    SELECT sad.station_name, apd.avg_pm25, apd.avg_pm10
    FROM StationAlertData sad
    INNER JOIN AveragePMData apd ON sad.station_id = apd.station_id
    WHERE sad.alert_level = 'high'
),
FinalData AS (
    SELECT fd.station_name, 
           SUM(fd.avg_pm25 + fd.avg_pm10) OVER (ORDER BY fd.station_name) AS cumulative_pollutants
    FROM FilteredData fd
)
SELECT cumulative_pollutants
FROM FinalData
ORDER BY cumulative_pollutants DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH AirQualityAggregates AS (
    SELECT
        aq.station_id,
        strftime('%Y-%m', aq.datetime) AS month,
        AVG(aq.pm25) AS avg_pm25,
        AVG(aq.pm10) AS avg_pm10,
        AVG(aq.temperature) AS avg_temperature,
        AVG(aq.humidity) AS avg_humidity
    FROM air_quality_data aq
    GROUP BY aq.station_id, month
),
TopStations AS (
    SELECT
        station_id,
        region_id,
        operational_status,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY region_id ORDER BY installation_date) AS station_rank
    FROM monitoring_stations
    WHERE operational_status = 'active'
),
WeatherImpact AS (
    SELECT
        wc.weather_id,
        COUNT(aq.record_id) AS impact_count
    FROM air_quality_data aq
    JOIN weather_conditions wc ON aq.weather_condition_id = wc.weather_id
    WHERE wc.impact_level = 'high'
    GROUP BY wc.weather_id
)
SELECT
    ta.station_id,
    ta.region_id,
    aa.month,
    aa.avg_pm25,
    aa.avg_pm10,
    aa.avg_temperature,
    aa.avg_humidity,
    wi.impact_count
FROM AirQualityAggregates aa
JOIN TopStations ta ON aa.station_id = ta.station_id
LEFT JOIN WeatherImpact wi ON aa.station_id = wi.weather_id
WHERE ta.station_rank <= 5
ORDER BY aa.month, ta.region_id, ta.station_id;

WITH RegionStations AS (
    SELECT 
        ms.station_id, 
        ms.station_name, 
        r.region_name, 
        ms.operational_status
    FROM monitoring_stations ms
    JOIN regions r ON ms.region_id = r.region_id
), 
StationData AS (
    SELECT 
        aq.station_id, 
        avg(aq.pm25) as avg_pm25, 
        avg(aq.pm10) as avg_pm10, 
        COUNT(aq.record_id) as num_records,
        aq.source_id
    FROM air_quality_data aq
    WHERE aq.datetime >= '2023-01-01' AND aq.datetime < '2024-01-01'
    GROUP BY aq.station_id, aq.source_id
),
DataSources AS (
    SELECT 
        ds.source_id, 
        ds.source_name, 
        ds.source_type
    FROM data_sources ds
    WHERE ds.source_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT source_id FROM StationData)
),
StationSourceInfo AS (
    SELECT 
        rs.region_name, 
        sd.avg_pm25, 
        sd.avg_pm10, 
        sd.num_records, 
        ds.source_name, 
        ds.source_type
    FROM RegionStations rs
    JOIN StationData sd ON rs.station_id = sd.station_id
    JOIN DataSources ds ON sd.source_id = ds.source_id
    WHERE rs.operational_status = 'active'
)
SELECT 
    region_name, 
    avg(avg_pm25) OVER (PARTITION BY region_name) as avg_pm25_by_region
FROM StationSourceInfo
ORDER BY avg_pm25_by_region DESC
LIMIT 10;

-- CTE to get high-impact weather conditions
WITH HighImpactWeather AS (
    SELECT weather_id
    FROM weather_conditions
    WHERE impact_level = 'high'
),

-- CTE to get average PM2.5 values per station on high-impact weather condition days
HighImpactPM25 AS (
    SELECT a.station_id, AVG(a.pm25) AS avg_pm25
    FROM air_quality_data a
    JOIN HighImpactWeather w ON a.weather_condition_id = w.weather_id
    GROUP BY a.station_id
)

-- Main query to select the station name and average PM2.5
SELECT s.station_name, h.avg_pm25
FROM HighImpactPM25 h
JOIN monitoring_stations s ON h.station_id = s.station_id
WHERE s.operational_status = 'active'
ORDER BY h.avg_pm25 DESC;

SELECT ms.station_name, AVG(aqd.pm25) AS average_pm25
FROM air_quality_data aqd
JOIN monitoring_stations ms ON aqd.station_id = ms.station_id
WHERE ms.operational_status = 'active' AND ms.region_id IN (
    SELECT region_id FROM regions WHERE region_name = 'Specific Region'
)
GROUP BY ms.station_name;

WITH StationData AS (
    SELECT 
        aq.record_id,
        ms.station_id,
        ms.station_name,
        ms.latitude,
        ms.longitude,
        r.region_name,
        aq.datetime,
        aq.pm25,
        aq.pm10,
        aq.temperature,
        aq.humidity,
        aq.wind_direction,
        aq.wind_speed,
        wc.description AS weather_description,
        ds.source_name,
        (
            SELECT COUNT(*)
            FROM alerts a
            WHERE a.station_id = ms.station_id 
            AND a.resolved = 0
        ) AS unresolved_alerts
    FROM air_quality_data aq
    JOIN monitoring_stations ms ON aq.station_id = ms.station_id
    JOIN regions r ON ms.region_id = r.region_id
    JOIN weather_conditions wc ON aq.weather_condition_id = wc.weather_id
    JOIN data_sources ds ON aq.source_id = ds.source_id
),
AggregatedData AS (
    SELECT
        sd.station_id,
        sd.station_name,
        sd.region_name,
        AVG(sd.pm25) AS avg_pm25,
        AVG(sd.pm10) AS avg_pm10,
        AVG(sd.temperature) AS avg_temperature,
        AVG(sd.humidity) AS avg_humidity,
        AVG(sd.wind_speed) AS avg_wind_speed
    FROM StationData sd
    GROUP BY sd.station_id, sd.region_name
),
CumulativeData AS (
    SELECT
        ad.station_id,
        ad.station_name,
        ad.region_name,
        SUM(ad.avg_pm25) OVER (ORDER BY ad.region_name) AS cumulative_pm25,
        SUM(ad.avg_pm10) OVER (ORDER BY ad.region_name) AS cumulative_pm10
    FROM AggregatedData ad
)
SELECT
    cd.station_name,
    cd.region_name,
    cd.cumulative_pm25,
    cd.cumulative_pm10
FROM CumulativeData cd
ORDER BY cd.region_name, cd.station_name;

WITH RecentRecords AS (
    SELECT record_id, station_id, datetime, pm25
    FROM air_quality_data
    WHERE datetime >= date('now', '-7 days')
),
StationDetails AS (
    SELECT s.station_id, s.station_name, r.region_name
    FROM monitoring_stations s
    INNER JOIN regions r ON s.region_id = r.region_id
)
SELECT rd.station_id, MAX(rd.pm25) AS max_pm25
FROM RecentRecords rd
INNER JOIN StationDetails sd ON rd.station_id = sd.station_id
GROUP BY rd.station_id
HAVING MAX(rd.pm25) > 50
ORDER BY max_pm25 DESC
LIMIT 5;

WITH AvgPM25Data AS (
    SELECT
        station_id,
        AVG(pm25) AS avg_pm25
    FROM air_quality_data
    GROUP BY station_id
),
TopStations AS (
    SELECT
        station_id,
        avg_pm25,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY avg_pm25 DESC) AS rank
    FROM AvgPM25Data
)
SELECT
    ms.station_name
FROM TopStations ts
JOIN monitoring_stations ms ON ts.station_id = ms.station_id
JOIN air_quality_data aqd ON ts.station_id = aqd.station_id
JOIN weather_conditions wc ON aqd.weather_condition_id = wc.weather_id
JOIN data_sources ds ON aqd.source_id = ds.source_id
WHERE ts.rank <= 5
GROUP BY ms.station_name;

WITH RegionalWeatherImpact AS (
    SELECT 
        aq.station_id,
        ms.region_id,
        wc.impact_level,
        MAX(aq.pm25) AS max_pm25
    FROM air_quality_data aq
    JOIN monitoring_stations ms ON aq.station_id = ms.station_id
    JOIN weather_conditions wc ON aq.weather_condition_id = wc.weather_id
    WHERE wc.impact_level IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY aq.station_id, ms.region_id, wc.impact_level
),
RegionStationHierarchy AS (
    SELECT 
        r.region_id,
        r.region_name,
        rw.station_id,
        rw.impact_level,
        rw.max_pm25,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_id ORDER BY rw.max_pm25 DESC) AS rank_in_region
    FROM RegionalWeatherImpact rw
    JOIN regions r ON rw.region_id = r.region_id
),
FinalImpactAnalysis AS (
    SELECT
        rsh.region_name,
        rsh.station_id,
        rsh.max_pm25,
        rsh.impact_level,
        rsh.rank_in_region
    FROM RegionStationHierarchy rsh
    WHERE rsh.rank_in_region = 1
)
SELECT region_name
FROM FinalImpactAnalysis;

WITH RECURSIVE StationHierarchy AS (
    SELECT ms.station_id, ms.station_name, ms.region_id, 1 AS level
    FROM monitoring_stations ms
    WHERE ms.operational_status = 'active'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT ms.station_id, ms.station_name, ms.region_id, sh.level + 1
    FROM monitoring_stations ms
    JOIN StationHierarchy sh ON ms.region_id = sh.region_id
),
RegionPMStats AS (
    SELECT sh.region_id,
           AVG(aqd.pm25) AS avg_pm25,
           AVG(aqd.pm10) AS avg_pm10
    FROM StationHierarchy sh
    JOIN air_quality_data aqd ON sh.station_id = aqd.station_id
    GROUP BY sh.region_id
),
WeatherImpact AS (
    SELECT wc.weather_id,
           wc.description,
           wc.impact_level,
           COUNT(aqd.record_id) AS impact_count
    FROM weather_conditions wc
    JOIN air_quality_data aqd ON wc.weather_id = aqd.weather_condition_id
    GROUP BY wc.weather_id
),
StationMaxPM AS (
    SELECT aqd.station_id,
           MAX(aqd.pm25) AS max_pm25,
           MAX(aqd.pm10) AS max_pm10
    FROM air_quality_data aqd
    GROUP BY aqd.station_id
)
SELECT rp.region_id, rp.avg_pm25, rp.avg_pm10
FROM RegionPMStats rp
JOIN WeatherImpact wi ON rp.region_id = wi.weather_id
JOIN StationMaxPM sm ON wi.weather_id = sm.station_id
WHERE wi.impact_level = 'high'
ORDER BY rp.avg_pm25 DESC, rp.avg_pm10 DESC;

WITH RegionAirQuality AS (
    SELECT 
        ms.region_id,
        avg(aqd.pm25) AS avg_pm25
    FROM 
        air_quality_data aqd
    JOIN 
        monitoring_stations ms ON aqd.station_id = ms.station_id
    WHERE 
        aqd.datetime BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-12-31'
    GROUP BY 
        ms.region_id
),
RankedRegions AS (
    SELECT 
        raq.region_id,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY raq.avg_pm25 DESC) AS rank
    FROM 
        RegionAirQuality raq
)
SELECT 
    r.region_name
FROM 
    RankedRegions rr
JOIN 
    regions r ON rr.region_id = r.region_id
WHERE 
    rr.rank <= 3;

WITH ActiveStations AS (
    SELECT station_id, region_id
    FROM monitoring_stations
    WHERE operational_status = 'active'
),
StationAirQuality AS (
    SELECT aq.station_id, ms.region_id, wc.description AS weather_description, aq.pm25
    FROM air_quality_data aq
    JOIN ActiveStations ms ON aq.station_id = ms.station_id
    LEFT JOIN weather_conditions wc ON aq.weather_condition_id = wc.weather_id
)
SELECT r.region_name, AVG(saq.pm25) AS average_pm25
FROM StationAirQuality saq
JOIN regions r ON saq.region_id = r.region_id
GROUP BY r.region_name
ORDER BY average_pm25 DESC;

SELECT 
  b.bug_id, 
  tm.name AS assigned_to, 
  fa.area_name AS functional_area,
  bs.status_name AS status,
  p.priority_level AS priority
FROM bugs b
INNER JOIN team_members tm ON b.assigned_to = tm.member_id
INNER JOIN functional_areas fa ON b.functional_area = fa.area_id
INNER JOIN bug_statuses bs ON b.status = bs.status_id
INNER JOIN priorities p ON b.priority_id = p.priority_id
WHERE b.report_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-12-31'
ORDER BY b.report_date;

SELECT tm.name AS team_member_name, COUNT(b.bug_id) AS high_priority_bug_count
FROM bugs b
INNER JOIN team_members tm ON b.assigned_to = tm.member_id
INNER JOIN priorities p ON b.priority_id = p.priority_id
WHERE p.priority_level = 'High'
GROUP BY tm.name
ORDER BY high_priority_bug_count DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT 
  tm.name AS team_member_name,
  p.priority_level AS priority_level,
  COUNT(brt.bug_id) AS resolved_bugs_count
FROM 
  bug_resolution_times brt
INNER JOIN 
  bugs b ON brt.bug_id = b.bug_id
INNER JOIN 
  priorities p ON b.priority_id = p.priority_id
INNER JOIN 
  team_members tm ON brt.resolved_by = tm.member_id
WHERE 
  p.priority_level = 'High'
GROUP BY 
  tm.name, p.priority_level
ORDER BY 
  resolved_bugs_count DESC;

WITH BugDetails AS (
    SELECT 
        b.bug_id,
        b.report_date,
        b.description,
        b.description_embedding,
        b.assigned_to,
        b.functional_area,
        b.priority_id,
        b.status,
        b.impact_level,
        tm.name AS assigned_to_name,
        fa.area_name AS functional_area_name,
        pr.priority_level AS priority_name
    FROM bugs b
    LEFT JOIN team_members tm ON b.assigned_to = tm.member_id
    LEFT JOIN functional_areas fa ON b.functional_area = fa.area_id
    LEFT JOIN priorities pr ON b.priority_id = pr.priority_id
),
ResolutionStats AS (
    SELECT
        brt.bug_id,
        brt.resolution_date,
        brt.resolution_time_days,
        tm.name AS resolved_by_name
    FROM bug_resolution_times brt
    LEFT JOIN team_members tm ON brt.resolved_by = tm.member_id
),
BugProjectDetails AS (
    SELECT 
        bp.bug_id,
        p.project_name,
        p.start_date,
        p.end_date,
        tm.name AS project_manager_name
    FROM bug_project_assignments bp
    LEFT JOIN projects p ON bp.project_id = p.project_id
    LEFT JOIN team_members tm ON p.project_manager_id = tm.member_id
),
RankedBugs AS (
    SELECT 
        bd.bug_id,
        bd.report_date,
        bd.assigned_to_name,
        bd.functional_area_name,
        bd.priority_name,
        bd.impact_level,
        rs.resolution_date,
        rs.resolved_by_name,
        bp.project_name,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY bd.assigned_to ORDER BY rs.resolution_time_days DESC) AS rank_by_resolution_time
    FROM BugDetails bd
    LEFT JOIN ResolutionStats rs ON bd.bug_id = rs.bug_id
    LEFT JOIN BugProjectDetails bp ON bd.bug_id = bp.bug_id
)
SELECT 
    bug_id
FROM RankedBugs
WHERE rank_by_resolution_time = 1
ORDER BY project_name;

SELECT
  ms.station_name,
  AVG(aqd.pm25) AS average_pm25
FROM
  air_quality_data aqd
INNER JOIN
  monitoring_stations ms ON aqd.station_id = ms.station_id
INNER JOIN
  weather_conditions wc ON aqd.weather_condition_id = wc.weather_id
WHERE
  ms.region_id = (SELECT region_id FROM regions WHERE region_name = 'Northern Region')
  AND wc.impact_level = 'high'
GROUP BY
  ms.station_name
HAVING
  AVG(aqd.pm25) > 35;

WITH BugSummary AS (
    SELECT 
        b.bug_id,
        b.report_date,
        b.description,
        b.assigned_to,
        b.priority_id,
        bs.status_name,
        p.priority_level,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY b.assigned_to ORDER BY b.report_date DESC) AS RecentBugRank
    FROM 
        bugs b
    INNER JOIN 
        bug_statuses bs ON b.status = bs.status_id
    INNER JOIN 
        priorities p ON b.priority_id = p.priority_id
    WHERE 
        b.report_date >= '2023-01-01'
        AND b.environment = 'production'
)
SELECT 
    tm.name AS team_member_name,
    bs.status_name AS bug_status
FROM 
    BugSummary bs
INNER JOIN
    team_members tm ON bs.assigned_to = tm.member_id
WHERE 
    bs.RecentBugRank <= 3
ORDER BY 
    tm.name, bs.status_name;

WITH BugDetails AS (
    SELECT 
        b.bug_id,
        b.description,
        b.priority_id,
        p.project_name,
        p.start_date,
        p.end_date
    FROM bugs b
    INNER JOIN bug_project_assignments bpa ON b.bug_id = bpa.bug_id
    INNER JOIN projects p ON bpa.project_id = p.project_id
),
ResolutionDetails AS (
    SELECT 
        brt.bug_id,
        brt.resolution_time_days,
        brt.resolution_date,
        tm.name AS resolver_name
    FROM bug_resolution_times brt
    INNER JOIN team_members tm ON brt.resolved_by = tm.member_id
),
CombinedDetails AS (
    SELECT 
        bd.bug_id,
        bd.description,
        bd.priority_id,
        bd.project_name,
        bd.start_date,
        bd.end_date,
        rd.resolution_time_days,
        rd.resolution_date,
        rd.resolver_name
    FROM BugDetails bd
    LEFT JOIN ResolutionDetails rd ON bd.bug_id = rd.bug_id
),
RankedBugs AS (
    SELECT 
        cd.bug_id,
        cd.description,
        cd.resolver_name,
        cd.project_name,
        cd.resolution_time_days,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY cd.resolution_time_days DESC) as rank
    FROM CombinedDetails cd
    WHERE cd.resolution_time_days IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
    rb.description, 
    tm.email
FROM RankedBugs rb
INNER JOIN team_members tm ON rb.resolver_name = tm.name
WHERE rb.rank = 1
ORDER BY rb.resolution_time_days DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH BugCTE AS (
    SELECT 
        b.bug_id,
        b.description,
        b.status,
        b.priority_id,
        tm.name AS assigned_team_member,
        COUNT(c.comment_id) AS comment_count
    FROM bugs b
    LEFT JOIN team_members tm ON b.assigned_to = tm.member_id
    LEFT JOIN comments c ON b.bug_id = c.bug_id
    WHERE b.report_date >= '2023-01-01'
    GROUP BY b.bug_id
),
VectorSearchResults AS (
    SELECT bug_id, distance
    FROM bugs
    WHERE description_embedding MATCH '[0.1, 0.2, 0.3, ...]'  -- random vector
    ORDER BY distance
    LIMIT 5
)
SELECT 
    bc.bug_id
FROM BugCTE bc
JOIN VectorSearchResults vsr ON bc.bug_id = vsr.bug_id
JOIN bug_statuses bs ON bc.status = bs.status_id
JOIN priorities p ON bc.priority_id = p.priority_id
WHERE p.priority_level = 'High' AND bs.status_name = 'Open'
ORDER BY vsr.distance, bc.comment_count DESC;

SELECT 
    tm.name AS team_member_name,
    COUNT(brt.bug_id) AS resolved_bugs_count
FROM 
    bug_resolution_times brt
JOIN 
    team_members tm ON brt.resolved_by = tm.member_id
GROUP BY 
    tm.name
ORDER BY 
    COUNT(brt.bug_id) DESC
LIMIT 5;
SELECT DISTINCT name FROM team_members;

SELECT b.bug_id
FROM bugs b
JOIN functional_areas fa ON b.functional_area = fa.area_id
WHERE b.report_date = (
  SELECT MAX(report_date)
  FROM bugs sub_b
  WHERE sub_b.functional_area = b.functional_area
)

SELECT 
  bug_id, 
  report_date, 
  reported_by, 
  description 
FROM 
  bugs
WHERE 
  priority_id = 1
ORDER BY 
  report_date DESC;

SELECT DISTINCT bug_id
FROM bugs;

SELECT 
    tm.name AS TeamMemberName,
    COUNT(brt.bug_id) AS ResolvedBugCount
FROM 
    team_members tm
INNER JOIN 
    bug_resolution_times brt ON tm.member_id = brt.resolved_by
GROUP BY 
    tm.name
ORDER BY 
    ResolvedBugCount DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT bug_id
FROM bugs
WHERE status = 1
ORDER BY report_date DESC;

SELECT bug_id
FROM bugs
ORDER BY report_date DESC
LIMIT 10;

WITH LatestBugCTE AS (
    SELECT 
        b.bug_id,
        b.description,
        b.functional_area,
        b.assigned_to,
        b.last_updated_date,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY b.functional_area ORDER BY b.last_updated_date DESC) AS rn
    FROM 
        bugs b
)
SELECT 
    lb.description
FROM 
    LatestBugCTE lb
JOIN 
    team_members tm ON lb.assigned_to = tm.member_id
WHERE 
    lb.rn = 1;

-- This query will analyze the bug data by functional area and priority.
WITH RECURSIVE FunctionalAreaHierarchy AS (
    SELECT
        fa.area_id,
        fa.area_name,
        1 AS level
    FROM functional_areas fa
    WHERE fa.area_id IS NOT NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        fa.area_id,
        fa.area_name,
        fah.level + 1
    FROM functional_areas fa
    JOIN FunctionalAreaHierarchy fah ON fa.area_id = fah.area_id
),
BugsInfo AS (
    SELECT
        b.bug_id,
        b.functional_area,
        b.priority_id

WITH HighPriorityUnresolvedBugs AS (

FunctionalAreaBugs AS (

KNNBugs AS (

WITH RecentBugStatus AS (

FunctionalAreaDetails AS (

PriorityDetails AS (

PriorityFunctionalAreaImpact AS (

KNNFunctionalAreaImpact AS (

WITH RecentBugs AS (

    FROM

    ORDER BY

    LIMIT 5

-- Main query to fetch required details

SELECT bug_id

SELECT 
    b.bug_id,

    tm.name AS assigned_team_member
  FROM bugs b
  INNER JOIN functional_areas fa ON b.functional_area = fa.area_id
  LEFT JOIN team_members tm ON b.assigned_to = tm.member_id

WITH RECURSIVE BugHierarchy AS (
    SELECT b.bug_id, b.functional_area, b.status, b.priority_id, 1 AS level
    FROM bugs b
    WHERE b.status = (SELECT status_id FROM bug_statuses WHERE status_name = 'New')
    UNION ALL
    SELECT b.bug_id, b.functional_area, b.status, b.priority_id, bh.level + 1
    FROM bugs b
    JOIN BugHierarchy bh ON b.regression_version = bh.bug_id
),
BugDetails AS (
    SELECT bh.bug_id, bh.level, f.area_name, s.status_name, p.priority_level
    FROM BugHierarchy bh
    INNER JOIN functional_areas f ON bh.functional_area = f.area_id
    INNER JOIN bug_statuses s ON bh.status = s.status_id
    INNER JOIN priorities p ON bh.priority_id = p.priority_id
),
ResolutionTimes AS (
    SELECT b.bug_id, r.resolution_date, r.resolution_time_days, t.name AS resolved_by
    FROM bugs b
    LEFT JOIN bug_resolution_times r ON b.bug_id = r.bug_id
    LEFT JOIN team_members t ON r.resolved_by = t.member_id
    WHERE r.resolution_time_days IS NOT NULL
),
FunctionalAreaImpacts AS (
    SELECT f.area_name, COUNT(b.bug_id) AS bug_count, 
        AVG(r.resolution_time_days) AS avg_resolution_time
    FROM bugs b
    INNER JOIN functional_areas f ON b.functional_area = f.area_id
    LEFT JOIN ResolutionTimes r ON b.bug_id = r.bug_id
    GROUP BY f.area_name
)
SELECT f.area_name, f.bug_count, f.avg_resolution_time
FROM FunctionalAreaImpacts f
ORDER BY f.avg_resolution_time DESC;

WITH ResolvedBugs AS (
    SELECT
        r.resolved_by,
        COUNT(r.bug_id) AS bug_count
    FROM
        bug_resolution_times r
    GROUP BY
        r.resolved_by
),
RankedResolvers AS (
    SELECT
        rb.resolved_by,
        tm.name,
        rb.bug_count,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY rb.bug_count DESC) as resolver_rank
    FROM
        ResolvedBugs rb
    JOIN
        team_members tm ON rb.resolved_by = tm.member_id
)
SELECT
    rr.name
FROM
    RankedResolvers rr
WHERE
    rr.resolver_rank <= 3;

WITH RecursiveBugHierarchy AS (
    SELECT b.bug_id, b.priority_id, b.assigned_to, 1 AS level
    FROM bugs b
    WHERE b.priority_id = (
        SELECT p.priority_id
        FROM priorities p
        ORDER BY LENGTH(p.priority_level) DESC
        LIMIT 1
    )
    UNION ALL
    SELECT b.bug_id, b.priority_id, b.assigned_to, rbh.level + 1
    FROM bugs b
    JOIN RecursiveBugHierarchy rbh ON b.assigned_to = rbh.assigned_to
),
TopBugs AS (
    SELECT b.bug_id, b.priority_id, b.impact_level
    FROM bugs b
    INNER JOIN RecursiveBugHierarchy rbh ON b.bug_id = rbh.bug_id
    WHERE b.impact_level = 'High'
    GROUP BY b.bug_id, b.priority_id, b.impact_level
    ORDER BY b.priority_id DESC, b.impact_level DESC
    LIMIT 10
),
TeamImpact AS (
    SELECT tm.name, tm.email, COUNT(tb.bug_id) AS bug_count
    FROM team_members tm
    LEFT JOIN bugs b ON tm.member_id = b.assigned_to
    LEFT JOIN TopBugs tb ON b.bug_id = tb.bug_id
    WHERE tb.bug_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY tm.name, tm.email
)
SELECT ti.name, ti.email, ti.bug_count
FROM TeamImpact ti
ORDER BY ti.bug_count DESC, ti.name;

WITH UnresolvedBugs AS (
    SELECT 
        b.bug_id, 
        b.description_embedding,
        p.priority_level,
        f.area_name,
        t.name AS assigned_to
    FROM bugs b
    JOIN priorities p ON b.priority_id = p.priority_id
    JOIN functional_areas f ON b.functional_area = f.area_id
    JOIN team_members t ON b.assigned_to = t.member_id
    WHERE b.status != (
        SELECT status_id 
        FROM bug_statuses 
        WHERE status_name = 'Resolved'
    )
),
TopPriorityBugs AS (
    SELECT 
        ub.bug_id,
        ub.area_name,
        ub.assigned_to
    FROM UnresolvedBugs ub
    ORDER BY ub.priority_level DESC
    LIMIT 3
)
SELECT 
    tp.bug_id, 
    tp.area_name,
    tp.assigned_to
FROM TopPriorityBugs tp
ORDER BY tp.bug_id;

SELECT tm.name
FROM team_members tm
INNER JOIN (
    SELECT assigned_to, COUNT(bug_id) AS bug_count
    FROM bugs
    GROUP BY assigned_to
    HAVING COUNT(bug_id) > 5
) AS bug_counts ON tm.member_id = bug_counts.assigned_to;

WITH RecursiveFunctionalAreas AS (
    SELECT area_id, area_name, description, 1 AS level
    FROM functional_areas
    WHERE area_id IS NOT NULL
),
BugAssignments AS (
    SELECT b.bug_id, b.report_date, b.assigned_to, b.priority_id, b.status,
           fa.area_name, fa.description AS area_description
    FROM bugs b
    INNER JOIN functional_areas fa ON b.functional_area = fa.area_id
),
BugComments AS (
    SELECT c.bug_id, COUNT(c.comment_id) AS comment_count,
           MAX(c.comment_date) AS last_comment_date
    FROM comments c
    GROUP BY c.bug_id
),
BugResolutionDetails AS (
    SELECT brt.bug_id, brt.resolution_time_days,
           tm.name AS resolved_by_name
    FROM bug_resolution_times brt
    LEFT JOIN team_members tm ON brt.resolved_by = tm.member_id
)
SELECT ba.bug_id, ba.report_date, ba.area_name, ba.area_description,
       tm.name AS assigned_to, ps.priority_level, bs.status_name,
       bc.comment_count, bc.last_comment_date,
       brd.resolution_time_days, brd.resolved_by_name,
       SUM(brd.resolution_time_days) OVER (PARTITION BY ba.priority_id ORDER BY ba.report_date DESC) AS cumulative_resolution_time
FROM BugAssignments ba
LEFT JOIN BugComments bc ON ba.bug_id = bc.bug_id
LEFT JOIN BugResolutionDetails brd ON ba.bug_id = brd.bug_id
INNER JOIN team_members tm ON ba.assigned_to = tm.member_id
INNER JOIN priorities ps ON ba.priority_id = ps.priority_id
INNER JOIN bug_statuses bs ON ba.status = bs.status_id
ORDER BY ba.report_date DESC;

WITH ProjectBugs AS (

HighPriorityBugs AS (

BugDetails AS (
